RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_.type:

  Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H) ≤ 2 * (RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_le._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries_card_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badLeftBoundaries G H) ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents G H).card →
    Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badRightBoundaries G H) ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents G H).card →
      (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents G H).card ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card →
        (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badLeftBoundaries G H ∪ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badRightBoundaries G H).card ≤
            Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badLeftBoundaries G H) +
              Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badRightBoundaries G H) →
          ¬Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badLeftBoundaries G H ∪ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badRightBoundaries G H) ≤
                2 * (RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card →
            False

{N : ℕ} →

        (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
          ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction.value:
fun {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))

  { toFun := RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap A η,
    invFun := RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap A fun (i : I) => Equiv.symm (η i), left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction._proof_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
    ∀ (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) (x : Fin N),
      RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap A (fun (i : I) => Equiv.symm (η i)) (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap A η x) = x

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction._proof_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction._proof_.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction.congr_s.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction_apply.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction_mem.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap.type:
{N : ℕ} →
  {I : Type u_1} → [Fintype I] → (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) → ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) → Fin N → Fin N
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap.value:
fun {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card))

  if hx : ∃ (i : I), x ∈ A i then
    let i := Classical.choose hx;
    ↑((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum (A i)) ((η i) ((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum (A i)).symm ⟨x, ⋯⟩)))
  else x

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap.eq_1.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap_apply_of_m.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap_apply_of_mem
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockMap_apply_of_m.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscentProba.type: ∀ {p : Bool → Prop}, (∀ (b : Bool), p b) = (p false ∧ p true)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscentProba.type: ∀ {a b c : Prop}, ((a ∧ b) ∧ c) = (a ∧ b ∧ c)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscent_cong.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport.eq_.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_disjoint_sameParity
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {e f : Fin (N - 1)},
  e ∉ G →
    f ∉ G →
      e ≠ f →
        RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryParity G e = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryParity G f →
          Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport G e) (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport G f)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_disjoint_sameParity._proof_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {e f : Fin (N - 1)},
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) % 2 =
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) % 2 →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight f) =
          RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) + 1 →
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) ≠
            RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) →
          ∀ ⦃i : Fin N⦄,
            RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) ∨
                RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) →
              RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) ∨
                  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight f) →
                False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_disjoint_sameParity._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundarySupport_dis.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_class_fact.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_class_factorization
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_class_fact.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (s : Finset (Fin (N - 1))),
  (∀ e ∈ s, e ∉ G) →
    (∀ e ∈ s, ∀ f ∈ s, RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryParity G e = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryParity G f) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ),
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
            ∏ e ∈ s,
              Real.exp
                (u *
                  ((if RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscent G e π then 1 else 0) -
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscent G e)))) =
          ∏ e ∈ s,
            RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
              Real.exp
                (u *
                  ((if RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscent G e π then 1 else 0) -
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundaryAscent G e)))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_stri.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_strict
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_stri.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {e f : Fin (N - 1)},
  e ∉ G →
    e < f →
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) <

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_stri.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_strict._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.boundary_index_stri.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {e f : Fin (N - 1)},
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
      ¬RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) <
            RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft f) →

              Filter.Tendsto

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges_card_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges_card_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges_card_le_boundary._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges_card_.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_component
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_co.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  i ≤ RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e →
    RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e ≤ j → RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j → e ∈ G

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_component._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.edge_mem_of_same_co.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i ≤ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) →
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j →
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
            RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
          False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightComponent
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
  ∀ e ∉ G, ∀ {i : Fin N}, i ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e → RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e ≤ i

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightComponent._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) {i : Fin N}, ¬↑e + 1 ≤ ↑i → ¬↑i ≤ ↑e → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightComponent._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.endpoint_le_rightCo.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) {i : Fin N},
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i ≤ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) →
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
          RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_same_component
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) {i j : Fin N},
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j →
    ¬(i ∈ H ↔ j ∈ H) →
      ∃ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges G H,
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_same_component._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (a b : Fin N), a ≤ b → ↑b - ↑a = 0 → ¬↑a = ↑b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_same_component._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (d : ℕ) (a b : Fin N),
  a ≤ b → ↑b - ↑a = d + 1 → ¬↑a < N - 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_same_component._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (d : ℕ) (a b : Fin N) (hab : a ≤ b) (hd : ↑b - ↑a = d + 1),
  RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft ⟨↑a, ⋯⟩ = a → ¬↑a + 1 ≤ ↑b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_same_component._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_crossing_of_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N} (d : ℕ) (a b : Fin N) (hab : a ≤ b) (hd : ↑b - ↑a = d + 1),
  RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft ⟨↑a, ⋯⟩ = a → ¬↑b - (↑a + 1) = d → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_separates.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_separates
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exists_separates.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)),

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) {u t : ℝ},
  0 < u →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ X ω) ≤
      Real.exp (-u * t) * RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => Real.exp (u * X ω)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov._simp_1_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.exp_markov._simp_1_.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, (Real.exp x ≤ Real.exp y) = (x ≤ y)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_add.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_add
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_add.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω + g ω) = RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_ascentCount_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_ascentCount_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_ascentCount_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ascentCount H π)) =
    ↑(Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (x : Ω) => c) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const._simp_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const._simp_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_const_mul.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => c * f ω) = c * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_indicator
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_indicator.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred A],
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if A ω then 1 else 0) = RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), f ω ≤ g ω) → RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mul_sq_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mul_sq_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_mul_sq_le.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω * g ω) ^ 2 ≤
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω ^ 2) * RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => g ω ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_prod_of_rela.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_prod_of_relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_prod_of_rela.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
    ∀ (f : I → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : I) (π σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N), (∀ x ∈ A i, ∀ y ∈ A i, π x < π y ↔ σ x < σ y) → f i π = f i σ) →
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
            ∏ i : I, f i π) =
          ∏ i : I, RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) (f i)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sub.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sub
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sub.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω - g ω) = RiffleLowerV2.expect P f - RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_sum.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {I : Type u_3} (s : Finset I) (f : I → Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, RiffleLowerV2.expect P (f i)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Nonempty Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) f = (∑ ω : Ω, f ω) / ↑(Fintype.card Ω)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform._sim.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.expect_uniform._sim.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.failure_envelope_te.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.failure_envelope_tendsto_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.failure_envelope_te.type: ∀ {a δ : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 < δ → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => Real.exp (-↑N ^ (a * (2 * δ)) / 144)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Finset (Fin N) → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H \ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H \ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_disjoint.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_disjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_disjoint.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_union.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_union
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_bad_union.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H ∪ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_double_charge
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  ∑ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
      ((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e).card - 1 + ((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e).card - 1)) ≤
    2 * Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_double_charge._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))).card =
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))) +
        1 →
    ¬(RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))).card - 1 =
          Finset.card
            (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))) →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_double_charge._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))).card =
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))) +
        1 →
    ¬(RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))).card - 1 =
          Finset.card
            (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))) →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_double_charge._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_boundary_doubl.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  ∑ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
        Finset.card
          (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))) ≤
      Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) →
    ∑ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
          Finset.card
            (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))) ≤
        Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) →
      ¬∑ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
                Finset.card
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft x))) +
              ∑ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
                Finset.card
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight x))) ≤
            2 * Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_left_charge_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_left_charge_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_left_charge_le.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  ∑ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))) ≤
    Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_right_charge_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_right_charge_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.good_right_charge_l.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  ∑ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H,
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))) ≤
    Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess.type: {N : ℕ} → Finset ℤ → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (δ : ℝ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) =>
  ∃ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
    ↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ) ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_event.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_event_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_event.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)) (good : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Prop)
  (A : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop) {ε : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ε →
    (∀ (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
        good G →
          1 - ε ≤
            RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
              A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.probability ρ good - ε ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ) A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_tv_lo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_tv_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_mixture_tv_lo.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)) (P : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)),
  P = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ →
    ∀ (good : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Prop) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop) {ε η : ℝ},
      0 ≤ ε →
        (∀ (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
            good G →
              1 - ε ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                  A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)) →
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) A ≤ η →
            RiffleLowerV2.probability ρ good - ε - η ≤ RiffleLowerV2.tv P (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_scan_ge_of_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_scan_ge_of_comparison
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graph_scan_ge_of_co.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentComparison →
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) {D δ : ℝ},
    0 < ↑H0.card →
      576 ≤ ↑H0.card ^ δ →
        24 * D ≤ ↑H0.card ^ δ →
          (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)), ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
            (∃ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q))) ≥
                  ↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ)) →
              1 - Real.exp (-↑H0.card ^ (2 * δ) / 144) ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                  RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)) (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Fin (N - 1) → Finset (Fin N)
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_endpoint
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
  ∀ e ∉ G, ∀ {i : Fin N}, i ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e → i ≤ RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_endpoint._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) {i : Fin N}, ¬↑i ≤ ↑e → ¬↑e + 1 ≤ ↑i → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_endpoint._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent_le_en.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) {i : Fin N},
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i →
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
          RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction..type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N), (Equiv.symm ρ).trans (Equiv.trans ρ π) = π

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftPositionAction..type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N), Equiv.trans ρ ((Equiv.symm ρ).trans π) = π

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
  ∀ e ∉ G, Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e) (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.left_right_disjoint.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) =
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) + 1 →
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) =
        RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.markov.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.markov
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.markov.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) →
    ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ f ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f / t

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (j : ℕ) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G j ↔ e ∈ G ∧ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) = j

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentEdges..type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (j : ℕ) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentEdges G j) =
    (e ∈ G ∧ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) = j)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin N),
  i ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G j ↔ RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = j

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_componentSet._s.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin N),
  (i ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G j) = (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = j)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H ↔
    e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e ⊆ H ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e ⊆ H

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) =
    (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e ⊆ H ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e ⊆ H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s \ t) = (a ∈ s ∧ a ∉ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_goodBoundaries..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundaries
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H ↔ e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H ∧ e ∉ G

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundaries._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_retainedBoundar.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H) = (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H ∧ e ∉ G)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTranslates
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (r : ℝ) (q : Fin (N + 1)),
  q ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslates H0 G r ↔
    r ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTranslates._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.mem_successfulTrans.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (r : ℝ) (q : Fin (N + 1)),
  (q ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslates H0 G r) =
    (r ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q))))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_tendsto_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.null_scan_envelope_.type: ∀ {β : ℝ}, 0 < β → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (↑N + 1) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ β)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.one_class_mgf.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_2} (P : PMF Ω) (s : Finset I) (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (u : ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
          ∏ i ∈ s, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
        ∏ i ∈ s,
          RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
            Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
    ∀ (u : ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
          Real.exp (u * ∑ i ∈ s, ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) ≤
        Real.exp (u ^ 2 * ↑s.card / 8)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform.type: {n : ℕ} → Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → Equiv.Perm (Fin n) ≃ Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (ρ η : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), (Equiv.trans ρ (Equiv.symm η)).symm.trans ρ = η

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.orderTransform._pro.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (ρ η : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), Equiv.trans ρ ((Equiv.symm η).trans ρ).symm = η

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.type: {N : ℕ} → Finset (Fin N) → Finset (Fin N) → Bool → Finset (Fin N)
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.value: fun {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)) (b : Bool) => if b = true then B else A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets.eq_1.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)) (b : Bool), RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets A B b = if b = true then B else A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)),
  Disjoint A B →
    ∀ (i j : Bool), i ≠ j → Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets A B i) (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets A B j)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets_disjoint._.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderBot α] {a b : α}, Disjoint a b = Disjoint b a

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (S₀ S₁ : Ω → ℝ) (B₀ B₁ : ℝ),
  (∀ (u : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => Real.exp (u * S₀ ω)) ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 * B₀ / 8)) →
    (∀ (u : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => Real.exp (u * S₁ ω)) ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 * B₁ / 8)) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => Real.exp (u * (S₀ ω + S₁ ω))) ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 * (B₀ + B₁) / 4)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf._simp_1_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.parity_mgf._simp_1_.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), Real.exp x * Real.exp y = Real.exp (x + y)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Finset (Fin N) → Finset ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) =>
  {j ∈ Finset.image (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G) H | ¬RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G j ⊆ H}

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_c.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_card_le_boundary
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_c.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents G H).card ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_subset_crossingImage
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents_s.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.partialComponents G H ⊆
    Finset.image (fun (e : Fin (N - 1)) => RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e))
      (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.crossingEdges G H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)) =>
  ρ.bind fun (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) =>
    PMF.map (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture.eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture.eq.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ =
    ρ.bind fun (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) =>
      PMF.map (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N))
  (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) (S : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop),
  (∀ (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) (π : Fin N ≃ Fin N),
      S (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction A hA η) π) ↔ S π) →
    ∀ (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          S π ∧ ∀ (i : I), RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) τ) =
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) S * ∏ i : I, 1 / ↑(A i).card.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_relativeOrder._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_and_rel.type: ∀ {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {f g : (x : α) → β x}, (f = g) = ∀ (x : α), f x = g x

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_false.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => False) = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_iUnion_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype I] (P : PMF Ω) (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ∃ (i : I), A i ω) ≤ ∑ i : I, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_le_one.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω → B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_not.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω) = 1 - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGra.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGraphMixture
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_pathGra.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (ρ : PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture ρ) A =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect ρ fun (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ τ x < τ y) =
    1 / ↑A.card.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativeOrder._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_relativ.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A σ) =
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ σ x < σ y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_tv
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_sub_le_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P Q : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability P A - RiffleLowerV2.probability Q A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.tv P Q

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_true.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_true
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_true.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => True) = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform_ascent
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_uniform.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (i j : Fin N),
  i ≠ j →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        π i < π j) =
      1 / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.probability_union_l.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∨ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A + RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_compon.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_component_failure
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.quantitative_compon.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ComponentComparison →
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) {M D δ : ℝ},
    0 < M →
      ↑H.card ≤ M →
        576 ≤ M ^ δ →
          24 * D ≤ M ^ δ →
            M ^ (1 / 2 + δ) ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) →
              ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary H).card ≤ D * √M →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ascentCount H (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π)) ≤
                      ↑(Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)) / 2 + M ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)) ≤
                  Real.exp (-M ^ (2 * δ) / 144)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrde.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrde.type: {N : ℕ} → (A : Finset (Fin N)) → Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrde.value: fun {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card)) => Classical.choose ⋯

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder.type: {N : ℕ} → (A : Finset (Fin N)) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card)
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
  Tuple.sort fun (i : Fin A.card) => π ↑((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum A) i)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrderIndepe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrderIndependence._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrderIndepe.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A σ) =
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ σ x < σ y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_block.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_blockAction
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_block.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)) (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
  (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (i : I),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction A hA η) π) =
    Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π) (Equiv.symm (η i))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_eq_if.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_eq_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_eq_if.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π = RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A σ ↔
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, π x < π y ↔ σ x < σ y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
    ∀ (F : ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) → ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          F fun (i : I) => RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π) =
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card))) F

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expect_prod
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
    ∀ (f : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card) → ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          ∏ i : I, f i (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π)) =
        ∏ i : I,
          RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
            f i (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expect_single
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_expec.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card) → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
      f (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card))) f

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber_card_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) →
    ∀ (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)),
      Nat.card { π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N // (fun (i : I) => RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π) = η } *
          ∏ i : I, (A i).card.factorial =
        N.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber_card_mul._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber_card_mul._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_fiber.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α], Fintype.card α = Nat.card α

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_lt_if.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_lt_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_lt_if.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (x y : Fin A.card),
  π ↑((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum A) x) < π ↑((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum A) y) ↔
    (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π)) x < (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π)) y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_reali.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_realize
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_reali.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A.card)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.realizeRelativeOrder A ρ) = ρ

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_stric.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_strictMono
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_stric.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A : Finset (Fin N)) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  StrictMono fun (i : Fin A.card) =>
    π ↑((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.positionEnum A) ((RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder A π) i))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weigh.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weighted_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weigh.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] (A : I → Finset (Fin N))
  (hA : ∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → ℝ),
  (∀ (η : (i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) (π : Fin N ≃ Fin N),
      w (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction A hA η) π) = w π) →
    ∀ (F : ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card)) → ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          w π * F fun (i : I) => RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder (A i) π) =
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) w *
          RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((i : I) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (A i).card))) F

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weigh.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weighted_expect._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.relativeOrder_weigh.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Finset (Fin N) → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries.value: fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) => RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H \ G

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries..name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries..type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H = RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H \ G

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries_card_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H) ≤ H.card

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card_partition
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) =
    Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) + Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) +
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card_partition._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) + Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H) =
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) →
    Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) + Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H) =
        Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H) →
      ¬Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) =
            Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H) + Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.goodBoundaries G H) +
              Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.badBoundaries G H) →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card_partition._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card_partition._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a : α} {s₁ s₂ : Finset α}, (a ∈ s₁ ∩ s₂) = (a ∈ s₁ ∧ a ∈ s₂)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card_partition._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retained_edges_card.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (H : Finset (Fin N)) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.retainedBoundaries G H) = (e ∈ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H ∧ e ∉ G)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Fin (N - 1) → Finset (Fin N)
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.componentSet G (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.separates_blockActi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.separates_blockAction
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.separates_blockActi.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin N)) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
  (η : (i : Bool) → Equiv.Perm (Fin (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets A B i).card)) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.Separates A B
      (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.blockAction (RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pairSets A B) ⋯ η) π) ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.Separates A B π

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_left_endpoin.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_left_endpoint_ge
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_left_endpoin.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
  ∀ e ∉ G,
    ∀ (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) {x : Fin N},
      x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.leftComponent G e → π x ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π) (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_right_endpoi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_right_endpoint_le
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.sorted_right_endpoi.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N),
  ∀ e ∉ G,
    ∀ (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) {y : Fin N},
      y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.rightComponent G e → (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π) (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) ≤ π y

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.subgaussian_tails.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) {B t : ℝ},
  0 < B →
    0 < t →
      (∀ (u : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => Real.exp (u * X ω)) ≤ Real.exp (u ^ 2 * B / 4)) →
        (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ X ω) ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / B) ∧
          (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => X ω ≤ -t) ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / B)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslate.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslates
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslate.type: {N : ℕ} → Finset ℤ → RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → ℝ → Finset (Fin (N + 1))
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslate.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (H0 : Finset ℤ) (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (r : ℝ) =>
  {q : Fin (N + 1) | r ≤ ↑(Finset.card (G ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)))}

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslate.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.successfulTranslates.eq_1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions.type: {N : ℕ} → Fin N → Fin N → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions._proo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions._proo.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (i j : Fin N) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  Equiv.trans (Equiv.swap i j) (Equiv.trans (Equiv.swap i j) π) = π

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.swapPositions i j =
    { toFun := fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) => Equiv.trans (Equiv.swap i j) π,
      invFun := fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) => Equiv.trans (Equiv.swap i j) π, left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.tv_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.tv_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.tv_le_one.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P Q : PMF Ω), RiffleLowerV2.tv P Q ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator_concentration
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_2} (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (s₀ s₁ : Finset I)
  (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), X ω = (c + ∑ i ∈ s₀, if A i ω then 1 else 0) + ∑ i ∈ s₁, if A i ω then 1 else 0) →
    (∀ (u : ℝ),
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
            ∏ i ∈ s₀, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
          ∏ i ∈ s₀,
            RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
              Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
      (∀ (u : ℝ),
          (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
              ∏ i ∈ s₁, Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) =
            ∏ i ∈ s₁,
              RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
                Real.exp (u * ((if A i ω then 1 else 0) - RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)))) →
        ∀ {M t : ℝ},
          0 < M →
            ↑s₀.card + ↑s₁.card ≤ M →
              0 < t →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ X ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P X) ≤
                    Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / M) ∧
                  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => X ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P X ≤ -t) ≤
                    Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / M)

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator_concentration._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type: ∀ {I : Type u_1} (s₀ s₁ : Finset I), s₀.card + s₁.card = 0 → ¬s₀.card = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator_concentration._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.two_class_indicator.type: ∀ {I : Type u_1} (s₀ s₁ : Finset I), s₀.card + s₁.card = 0 → ¬s₁.card = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_expect_equi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_expect_equiv
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_expect_equi.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [inst_2 : Nonempty Ω] [inst_3 : Nonempty Γ]
  (e : Ω ≃ Γ) (f : Γ → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) fun (ω : Ω) => f (e ω)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Γ) f

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_b.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_b.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.UniformScan →
  ∀ {N : ℕ},
    0 < N →
      ∀ (H0 : Finset ℤ) {a δ : ℝ},
        0 < a →
          0 < δ →
            ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2))) ≤
                (↑N + 1) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ (a * δ))

RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_eventually
RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.uniform_null_scan_e.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.UniformScan →
  ∀ (a δ ε : ℝ),
    0 < a →
      0 < δ →
        0 < ε →

RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N →
      ℝ →
        ℝ →
          {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} →
            {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} → RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (rho chiGood : ℝ) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k}
    {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  G.leftGood ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W ∧
    G.rightGood ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W ∧
      ↑G.leftGood < ↑G.rightGood ∧
        TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN G.leftGood) chiGood ∧
          TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN G.rightGood) chiGood ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reserveMinus < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reservePlus ∧
                (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), ↑j ≠ G.leftGood → G.reserveMinus j = G.central j) ∧
                  (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), ↑j ≠ G.rightGood → G.reservePlus j = G.central j) ∧
                    (∀ v ∈ {G.central, G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                        chiGood ^ 2 * ↑k ^ (-↑W.bridgeLength) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts v) ∧
                      0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ∧
                        RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ≤
                          2 * rho * Real.log ↑k + (Real.log ↑k + 2 * Real.log (1 / chiGood)) / TimeProfile.logScale N

    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W)
    (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>
  have q := ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega);
  have Hq := RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G) q;

    {y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G | 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount y omega}.card ≤
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges omega ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges Hq)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometr.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometry_scan_test
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometr.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta ε : ℝ),
  0 < eta →
    0 < ε →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        1 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (rho chi xi : ℝ) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
              (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
              RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ^ (1 / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 5) ≤
                        ↑(Finset.card
                            (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω ∩
                              RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges
                                (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G)
                                  ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) ω))))) -
                    ε ≤
                  RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collis.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collision_mean_lower
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collis.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi xi D : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
        D * ↑N ^ (-1 / 100) ≤ 1 / 2 →
          (∀ y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G,
              |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent y) -
                    RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y)| ≤
                D * ↑N ^ (-1 / 100) * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y)) →
            RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldMeanConstant *
                ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) ≤
              RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount (RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G))

  1 ≤ m →
