      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω - RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
        ∀ (i j : Fin N),
          ↑j < RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω + m →
            i < j → ¬↑i < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ)
  (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω ≤ ↑i →
    i < j → ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω - RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
        ∀ (i j : Fin N),
          ↑j < RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω + m →
            ¬↑j < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_se.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_selectedPiles
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_se.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi xi : ℝ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
  (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
    RiffleLowerV2.selectedPiles cuts (RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G) (min xi (min chi (1 / ↑k)))

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestCher.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestChernoffError_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestCher.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * ↑N ^ b)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.type:
∀ (b epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    0 < epsilon →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
              ↑N ^ b ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN →
                1 - epsilon ≤
                  RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean_uniform_scales
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.type:
∀ (b epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    0 < epsilon →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (mu : ℝ),
              ↑N ^ b ≤ mu →
                mu ≤ ↑N →
                  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ∧
                    RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ≤ N ∧
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b) ≤ mu / 2 ∧
                        Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * mu) +
                            RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError N b ≤
                          epsilon

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly.type: ∀ (k N0 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.value:
fun (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) =>
  ↑(N - RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b + 1) /
    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError N b) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError_tendsto._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  1 ≤ N →
    2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b →
      ¬N - RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b + 1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunL.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength_eventually_admissible
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunL.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    b ≤ 1 →
      ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ≤ N ∧
            ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b) ≤ ↑N ^ b / 2

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_edge_event_implies_scan
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (δ : ℝ)
  (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  ↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ) ≤
      ↑(Finset.card
          (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω ∩
            RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω)))) →
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_edge_event_implies_scan._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω ≤ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w ω ≤ N →
    ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω < N + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._.type: ∀ (k No Nm Nl Ns Ne N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean_le_population
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N), RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN ≤ ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq_actualGraphMixture
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture (RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw cuts)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_la.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_lalley_test
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_la.type:
∀ (a δ D ε : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < δ →
      0 ≤ D →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            1 ≤ N0 ∧
              ∀ N ≥ N0,
                ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ),
                  ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
                    (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
                      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                            fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                            RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)) -
                          ε ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_sc.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_scan_success
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_sc.type:
∀ (a δ D ε : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < δ →
      0 ≤ D →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ),
                ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
                  (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
                    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                          fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)) -
                        ε ≤
                      RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)))

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ (a r c : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < c → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => ↑N ^ a * Real.exp (-c * ↑N ^ r)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability_actualGraphLaw
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw cuts) A =
    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      A (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability_increasingRun_le
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  m ≤ N →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.HasIncreasingRun π m) ≤
      ↑(N - m + 1) / ↑m.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability_intersection_lower
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability P A + RiffleLowerV2.probability P B - 1 ≤
    RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω

RiffleLowerV2.F.name: RiffleLowerV2.F
RiffleLowerV2.F.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → 0 < N → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.F.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (α s u : ℝ) =>
  (α + 3) / 2 * RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s - RiffleLowerV2.B cuts hN α s u -
    2 * RiffleLowerV2.B cuts hN 2 u (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K)

RiffleLowerV2.F.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.F.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.F.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (α α_1 : ℝ),
      α = α_1 →
        ∀ (s s_1 : ℝ),
          s = s_1 → ∀ (u u_1 : ℝ), u = u_1 → RiffleLowerV2.F cuts hN α s u = RiffleLowerV2.F cuts_1 hN α_1 s_1 u_1

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbedding.type: {A : Type u_1} → {B : Type u_2} → {C : Type u_3} → (A → C) → (B → C) → Type (max 0 u_1 u_2)
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbedding.value: fun {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} (f : A → C) (g : B → C) => { e : A ↪ B // ∀ (x : A), g (e x) = f x }

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.abs_expect_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.abs_expect_le
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.abs_expect_le.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  |RiffleLowerV2.expect P f| ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => |f ω|

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroniProduc.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroniProduct._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroniProduc.type:
∀ {α : Sort u_1} (P Q : Prop) [inst : Decidable P] (a b : α) [inst_1 : Decidable Q],
  (if P then if Q then a else b else b) = if P ∧ Q then a else b

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_eq_fa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_eq_factorial_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_eq_fa.type:
∀ (m n : ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m n =
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialCoefficient r * RiffleLowerV2.falling n r

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_expec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_expect_error
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_expec.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (μ ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
  (∀ r ≤ m, |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r) - μ ^ r| ≤ ε * μ ^ r) →
    |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω)) -
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ r * ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial| ≤
      ε * ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_product_expect_error
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℕ) (μ ν ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
  (∀ (r s : ℕ),
      r + s ≤ 2 * m →
        |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r * RiffleLowerV2.falling (Y ω) s) -
              μ ^ r * ν ^ s| ≤
          ε * μ ^ r * ν ^ s) →
    |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω) * RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (Y ω)) -
          (∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ r * ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial) *
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, (-1) ^ s * ↑(s - 1) * ν ^ s / ↑s.factorial| ≤
      (ε * ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑(r - 1) * μ ^ r / ↑r.factorial) *
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑(s - 1) * ν ^ s / ↑s.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_product_expect_error._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_product_expect_error._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_produ.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_small.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_small
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_small.type: ∀ (m n : ℕ), n < 2 → RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m n = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_succ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_succ
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.bonferroni_succ.type:
∀ (m n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m → RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni (m + 1) n = RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m n + (-1) ^ (m + 1) * ↑m * ↑(n.choose (m + 1))

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralCompariso.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralComparison._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralCompariso.type: ∀ (m : ℕ), 2 ≤ m → ∀ r ≤ m, ¬r + 0 ≤ 2 * m → False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralCompariso.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralComparison._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.centralCompariso.type: ∀ (m : ℕ), 2 ≤ m → ∀ s ≤ m, ¬0 + s ≤ 2 * m → False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.choose_eq_fallin.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.choose_eq_falling_div
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.choose_eq_fallin.type: ∀ (n r : ℕ), ↑(n.choose r) = RiffleLowerV2.falling n r / ↑r.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      (f : A → C) →
        (g : B → C) →
          RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g ≃ ((c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c })
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.value:
fun {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} (f : A → C) (g : B → C) =>
  {
    toFun := fun (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) (c : C) =>
      { toFun := fun (x : { x : A // f x = c }) => ⟨↑e ↑x, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ },
    invFun := fun (h : (c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c }) =>
      ⟨{ toFun := fun (x : A) => ↑((h (f x)) ⟨x, ⋯⟩), inj' := ⋯ }, ⋯⟩,
    left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) (c : C) (x : { x : A // f x = c }), g (↑e ↑x) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_10
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) ⦃x y : A⦄
  (he :
    ↑({ toFun := fun (x_1 : { x_1 : A // f x_1 = f x }) => ⟨↑e ↑x_1, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨x, ⋯⟩) =
      ↑({ toFun := fun (x : { x : A // f x = f y }) => ⟨↑e ↑x, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨y, ⋯⟩)),
  ↑⟨x, ⋯⟩ = ↑⟨y, ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_11
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) (x : A),
  g ↑({ toFun := fun (x_1 : { x_1 : A // f x_1 = f x }) => ⟨↑e ↑x_1, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨x, ⋯⟩) = f x

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_12
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g),
  ⟨{ toFun := fun (x : A) => ↑({ toFun := fun (x_1 : { x_1 : A // f x_1 = f x }) => ⟨↑e ↑x_1, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨x, ⋯⟩),

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_13
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (h : (c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c }) (c : C) (x : { x : A // f x = c }),
  g (↑⟨{ toFun := fun (x : A) => ↑((h (f x)) ⟨x, ⋯⟩), inj' := ⋯ }, ⋯⟩ ↑x) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_15
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (h : (c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c }),
  (fun (c : C) =>
      {
        toFun := fun (x : { x : A // f x = c }) =>
          ⟨↑⟨{ toFun := fun (x : A) => ↑((h (f x)) ⟨x, ⋯⟩), inj' := ⋯ }, ⋯⟩ ↑x, ⋯⟩,

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_2} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) (c : C) (x y : { x : A // f x = c }),
  ⟨↑e ↑x, ⋯⟩ = ⟨↑e ↑y, ⋯⟩ → x = y

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_3
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type: ∀ {A : Type u_2} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (x : A), f x = f x

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_4
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (h : (c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c }) ⦃x y : A⦄,
  ↑((h (f x)) ⟨x, ⋯⟩) = ↑((h (f y)) ⟨y, ⋯⟩) → f y = f x

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_6
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (h : (c : C) → { x : A // f x = c } ↪ { y : B // g y = c }) (x : A), g ↑((h (f x)) ⟨x, ⋯⟩) = f x

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_7
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) (x : A) (x_1 : { x_1 : A // f x_1 = f x }), g (↑e ↑x_1) = f x

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_8
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddingsEquiv._proof_9
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_1} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
  (e : RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) ⦃x y : A⦄,
  ↑({ toFun := fun (x_1 : { x_1 : A // f x_1 = f x }) => ⟨↑e ↑x_1, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨x, ⋯⟩) =
      ↑({ toFun := fun (x : { x : A // f x = f y }) => ⟨↑e ↑x, ⋯⟩, inj' := ⋯ } ⟨y, ⋯⟩) →

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddings_card
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (f : A → C)
  (g : B → C),
  Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) =
    ∏ c : C, (Fintype.card { y : B // g y = c }).descFactorial (Fintype.card { x : A // f x = c })

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbeddings_natCard
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.coloredEmbedding.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [inst : Fintype C] (f : A → C) (g : B → C),
  Nat.card (RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings f g) =
    ∏ c : C, (Nat.card { y : B // g y = c }).descFactorial (Nat.card { x : A // f x = c })

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_facto.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_factorial_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_log_facto.type:
∀ {k N R : ℕ} (n m : Fin k → ℕ) {c : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < N →
      ∑ a : Fin k, m a = R →
        (∀ (a : Fin k), 0 < m a → c * ↑N ≤ ↑(n a)) →
          2 * ↑R ≤ c * ↑N →
            0 < ∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (n a) (m a) ∧
              0 < ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n a) ^ m a ∧
                |Real.log ((∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (n a) (m a)) / ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n a) ^ m a)| ≤
                  ↑R ^ 2 / (c * ↑N)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_request_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_request_probability
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.column_request_p.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] (f : A → Fin k)
  (e : A ↪ Fin N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) fun (a : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) =>
      if ∀ (x : A), ↑a (e x) = f x then 1 else 0) =
    (∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) (Nat.card { x : A // f x = a })) /
      RiffleLowerV2.falling N (Fintype.card A)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_word.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_wordCount_eq_residualWordMean
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_word.type:
∀ {k N K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective p.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
        ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
          RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
              (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                ↑(RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card))
              (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
            RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_word.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_wordCount_eq_residualWordMean._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.conditional_word.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, b < N → ¬1 ≤ N - b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.eventual_factori.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.eventual_factorial_budgets._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.eventual_factori.type: ∀ (N1 N : ℕ), N ≥ max N1 2 → N1 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_add.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_add
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_add.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω + g ω) = RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferron.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferroni
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferron.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω)) =
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m,
      RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialCoefficient r *
        RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferron.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferroni_product
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_bonferron.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (X ω) * RiffleLowerV2.bonferroni m (Y ω)) =
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m,
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m,
        RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialCoefficient r * RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialCoefficient s *
          RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) r * RiffleLowerV2.falling (Y ω) s

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ), (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (x : Ω) => c) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const._si.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_const_mul.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => c * f ω) = c * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_div
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_div.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω / c) = RiffleLowerV2.expect P f / c

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ},

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mul_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mul_const
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_mul_const.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ),

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder_le
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (μ ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
  |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) m) - μ ^ m| ≤ ε * μ ^ m →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.bonferroniRemainder m (X ω)) ≤
      (1 + ε) * RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m μ

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder_product_le
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_remainder.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℕ) (μ ν ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
  |(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) m * RiffleLowerV2.falling (Y ω) m) -
          μ ^ m * ν ^ m| ≤
      ε * μ ^ m * ν ^ m →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.bonferroniRemainder m (X ω) * RiffleLowerV2.bonferroniRemainder m (Y ω)) ≤
      (1 + ε) * (RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m μ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m ν)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sub.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sub
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sub.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.expect_sum.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {ι : Type u_3} (P : PMF Ω) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, RiffleLowerV2.expect P (f i)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct_eq_requests
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct.type:
∀ {k N K d : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ),
  Function.Injective w →
    ∀ (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
      RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct w r ω =
        ∑ e : (i : Fin d) × Fin (r i) ↪ Fin N,
          if ∀ (x : (i : Fin d) × Fin (r i)), RiffleLowerV2.rowWord ω (e x) = w x.fst then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct_eq_requests._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorialProduct.type: ∀ {R : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : ι → ℕ) (s : Finset ι), ∏ i ∈ s, ↑(f i) = ↑(∏ i ∈ s, f i)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchm.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchmark_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchm.type:
∀ {N k K d : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ),
  ∏ i : Fin d, (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts (w i)) ^ r i =
    (↑N ^ ∑ i : Fin d, r i) *
      ∏ j : Fin K, (∏ a : Fin k, ↑(cuts.count j a) ^ RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a) / ↑N ^ ∑ i : Fin d, r i

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchm.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchmark_identity._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.factorial_benchm.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ) (f : ι → M),

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.value: fun (n r : ℕ) => RiffleLowerV2.falling n r / ↑n ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ (n r : ℕ), RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection n r = RiffleLowerV2.falling n r / ↑n ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {n r : ℕ}, 0 < n → r ≤ n → 0 < RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection n r

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type:
∀ {n r : ℕ},
  0 < n →
    r ≤ n →
      RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection n (r + 1) =
        RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection n r * (1 - ↑r / ↑n)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrection_succ._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.fallingCorrectio.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.groupedEmbedding.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.groupedEmbeddingsEquiv
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.groupedEmbedding.type:
{I : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      (r : I → ℕ) →
        (w : I → C) →
          Function.Injective w →
            (g : B → C) →
              ((i : I) → Fin (r i) ↪ { y : B // g y = w i }) ≃
                RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.ColoredEmbeddings (fun (x : (i : I) × Fin (r i)) => w x.fst) g
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.groupedEmbedding.value:
fun {I : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} (r : I → ℕ) (w : I → C) (hw : Function.Injective w) (g : B → C) =>
  {

    (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 < n j) →

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean_lo.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {M M' : ℝ} {n n' : Fin K → ℝ},
  0 < M →
    0 < M' →
      (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 < n j) →
        (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 < n' j) →
          ∀ {a b : ℝ},
            |Real.log (M' / M)| ≤ b →
              (∀ (j : Fin K), |Real.log (n' j / n j)| ≤ a) →
                |Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean M' n' / RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean M n)| ≤
                  b + ↑K * (a + b)

  (∀ i ∈ s, |M i - T i| ≤ ε * T i) → |∑ i ∈ s, a i * M i - ∑ i ∈ s, a i * T i| ≤ ε * ∑ i ∈ s, |a i| * T i

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.probability_poly.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.probability_polynomial_error
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.probability_poly.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop) (U D : Ω → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), (0 ≤ U ω - if A ω then 1 else 0) ∧ (U ω - if A ω then 1 else 0) ≤ D ω) →
    |RiffleLowerV2.probability P A - RiffleLowerV2.expect P U| ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P D

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.product_remainde.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.product_remainder
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.product_remainde.type:
∀ (u v a b dx dy : ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    a ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ b →
        b ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ u - a ∧ u - a ≤ dx → 0 ≤ v - b ∧ v - b ≤ dy → 0 ≤ u * v - a * b ∧ u * v - a * b ≤ dx + dy + dx * dy

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.rare_pointwise.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.rare_pointwise
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.rare_pointwise.type:

  (RiffleLowerV2.falling n 2 / 2 - RiffleLowerV2.falling n 3 / 3 ≤ if 2 ≤ n then 1 else 0) ∧
    (if 2 ≤ n then 1 else 0) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.falling n 2 / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.relativeFactoria.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.relativeFactorial_finite
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.relativeFactoria.type:
∀ {N M K k R : ℕ} (n m : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) {c : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < N →
      c * ↑N ≤ ↑M →
        (∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, m j a = R) →
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), 0 < m j a → c * ↑N ≤ ↑(n j a)) →
            2 * ↑R ≤ c * ↑N →
              2 / c * (↑K + 1) * ↑R ^ 2 / ↑N ≤ 1 →
                |(RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean (RiffleLowerV2.falling M R) fun (j : Fin K) =>
                        ∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (n j a) (m j a)) -
                      RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean (↑M ^ R) fun (j : Fin K) => ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n j a) ^ m j a| ≤
                  4 / c * (↑K + 1) * ↑R ^ 2 / ↑N *
                    RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.numericalMean (↑M ^ R) fun (j : Fin K) => ∏ a : Fin k, ↑(n j a) ^ m j a

    invFun := fun (a : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) => ⟨fun (i : Fin N) => ↑a ((Equiv.symm σ) i), ⋯⟩,
    left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestColumnEqu.type:

  (a : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) (l : Fin k), {i : Fin N | ↑a (σ i) = l}.card = cuts.count j l

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestColumnEqu.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestColumnEquiv._proof_4
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestColumnEqu.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_column_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_column_product
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_column_p.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (f : (j : Fin K) → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      ∏ j : Fin K, f j (ω j)) =
    ∏ j : Fin K, RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) (f j)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_probabil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_probability
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.request_probabil.type:
∀ {k N K d : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ)
  (e : (i : Fin d) × Fin (r i) ↪ Fin N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      if ∀ (x : (i : Fin d) × Fin (r i)), RiffleLowerV2.rowWord ω (e x) = w x.fst then 1 else 0) =
    ∏ j : Fin K,
      (∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) (RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a)) /
        RiffleLowerV2.falling N (∑ i : Fin d, r i)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_eq_card
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_e.type:
∀ {k K d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a = Fintype.card { x : (i : Fin d) × Fin (r i) // List.Vector.get (w x.fst) j = a }

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_l.type:
∀ {k K d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a ≤ ∑ i : Fin d, r i

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_pos_selected._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_p.type:
∀ {k K d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k),

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requestedCount_s.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requested_monomi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requested_monomial
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requested_monomi.type:
∀ {k K d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ) (j : Fin K) (n : Fin k → ℝ),
  ∏ a : Fin k, n a ^ RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a = ∏ i : Fin d, n (List.Vector.get (w i) j) ^ r i

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.requested_monomi.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualBudget_t.type:

  Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * (1 + 1 / c) * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) * ↑b0 / ↑N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualConditio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualConditionalExpect
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualConditio.type:
∀ {k N K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  Function.Injective r.row →
    0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
      ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
        (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
          ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
            Function.Injective e →
              (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                ∀ (F : (Fin (N - b) → Fin K → Fin k) → ℝ),
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                        F fun (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K) => TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                    RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                      fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => F (TimeProfile.sampleRow η)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualMeanComp.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (b0 N1 N b : ℕ), b ≤ b0 → 2 * b0 + 2 ≤ N → ¬2 * b ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualMean_fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualMean_finite
RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.residualMean_fin.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  {c : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < N →
      2 * b ≤ N →
        2 * ↑b ≤ c * ↑N →
          (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
            2 * (1 + 1 / c) * (↑K + 1) * ↑b / ↑N ≤ 1 →
              |RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w - ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w| ≤
                4 * (1 + 1 / c) * (↑K + 1) * ↑b / ↑N * (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)

RiffleLowerV2.Factorial.uniform_expect._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec.name: RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec
RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N →
      ℝ →
        ℝ →
          ℝ →
            ℝ →
              (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) →
                (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) → RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (eta rho chiGood xi : ℝ) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  have b := RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N);
  have ellp := RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G;
  have hp := RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType;
  have ht := RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.tailType;
  have h := RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G;
  have z := RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G;
  have g := RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G;
  have Hrel := RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G;
  have M := ↑Hrel.card;
  have Y := RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G;
  have c := min xi (min chiGood (1 / ↑k));
  RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts G.ambient ∧
    RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) = ↑N ^ b ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) xi 2 G.tailType ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) W.theta
              (min (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) (RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) / 1000) G.prefixType ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) 2
                (min (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) (RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) / 1000) G.tailType ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec cuts hN rho chiGood G ∧
                b / 2 + 2 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ ellp ∧
                  hp ≤ ellp - RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧
                    RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ h ∧
                      Real.exp (-2) * ↑N ^ h ≤ M ∧
                        M ≤ 2 * ↑N ^ h ∧
                          ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3) ≤ M ∧
                            M ≤ ↑N ∧
                              (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                                  ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N Hrel ↑↑q)).card ≤ 4 * √M) ∧
                                RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ g - h / 2 ∧
                                  z ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta ∧
                                    ↑Y.card = ↑N ^ (hp + ht) ∧
                                      (∀ y ∈ Y,
                                          Real.exp (-2) * ↑N ^ z < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y ∧
                                            ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y ≤ ↑N ^ z) ∧
                                        (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                                            ↑N ^ (b / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) ≤
                                                RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts
                                                  (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reserveMinus) ∧
                                              ↑N ^ (b / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) ≤
                                                RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts
                                                  (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reservePlus)) ∧
                                          0 < c ∧
                                            (∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ (j : Fin K), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get y j)) / ↑N) ∧
                                              ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                                                ∀ v ∈ {G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                                                  ∀ (j : Fin ↑(RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v).fst),
                                                    c ≤
                                                      ↑(cuts.count ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩
                                                            (List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v).snd
                                                              j)) /
                                                        ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.bridge_grid_c.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.bridge_grid_cost_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.bridge_grid_c.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {mu bl : ℕ} {rho : ℝ},
        0 < rho →
          bl = ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ →
            mu + bl ≤ K →
              have u := RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu;
              have v := RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl);
              have d := (2 * rho + 1 / TimeProfile.logScale N) * Real.log ↑k;
              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 u v ∧
                RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 u v ≤ d ∧
                  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN 2 u v ∧ RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN 2 u v ≤ d

    0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ≤
          (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl) - RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) * Real.log ↑k →
      Prop)
  (x :
    0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ≤
        (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl) - RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) * Real.log ↑k),
  (∀ (hj0 : 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)))
      (hjle :
        RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ≤
          (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl) - RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) * Real.log ↑k),
      motive ⋯) →
    motive x

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.bridge_log_bo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    0 < N →
      2 ≤ k →
        ∀ {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
          (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {rho chi : ℝ},
          0 < rho →

                  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ∧
                    RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G ≤
                      2 * rho * Real.log ↑k + (Real.log ↑k + 2 * Real.log (1 / chi)) / TimeProfile.logScale N

        RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts w → ∀ (j : Fin K), 1 / ↑k ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.canonical_pre.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.canonical_prefixMean_eq_rpow_beta
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.canonical_pre.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts w →
        ∀ m ≤ K,
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) =
            ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N m)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFamily_lo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFamily_localized_of_endpoint_reserves
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFamily_lo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k}
  {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reserveMinus < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central →
        RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reservePlus →
          ∀ (e : ℝ) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
            (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                          RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x| ≤
                    e ∧
                  |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                            (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)| ≤
                      e ∧
                    e + 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reserveMinus) omega) ∧
                      e + 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reservePlus) omega)) →
              ∀ y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G,
                ∀ (i : Fin N),
                  RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i = y →
                    i ∈
                      RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G)
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamily_card
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)

  (RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G).card =
    (RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G).card * (RiffleLowerV2.coldTailFamily cuts hN P W G).card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamily_card_rpow
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
  (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {xi : ℝ},
  RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType →
    RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) xi 2 G.tailType →
      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G).card =
        ↑N ^
          (RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType +
            RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.tailType)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamily_mass_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldFullFamil.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
      (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {xi : ℝ},
      W.ms ≤ W.mu →
        W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) =
              ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N) →
            RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType →
              RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) xi 2 G.tailType →
                0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts G.central →
                  ∀ y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G,
                    Real.exp (-2) * ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y ∧
                      ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y ≤ ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalization_failure_le_envelope
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
      2 ≤ N →
        ∀ {T eta rho chi xi : ℝ},
          0 < T →
            0 < eta →
              ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
                (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
                RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chi W →
                  RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
                    ↑K ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                      4 * ↑k * T * TimeProfile.logScale N + 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) →
                        4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                          16 ≤ ↑N ^ (5 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                            (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                fun (omega : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                ¬RiffleLowerV2.ColdLocalization hN P W G omega) ≤
                              2 * (T + 1) * ↑N ^ (1 + T * Real.log ↑k) *
                                Real.exp (-↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) / 8)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalization_failure_le_prefixFailure
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),

                  4 * ↑k * T * TimeProfile.logScale N + 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) →
                    4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                      16 ≤ ↑N ^ (5 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                        (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                            fun (omega : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                            ¬RiffleLowerV2.ColdLocalization hN P W G omega) ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalization_of_prefix_event
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldLocalizat.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),

                    4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeS.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeSet_estimates
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeS.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W)
      {xi kap : ℝ},
      0 < kap →
        12 / kap ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N →
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) =
              ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N) →
            RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType →
              RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N) / 2 + 2 * kap ≤ RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G →
                RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType ≤
                    RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G - kap →
                  kap / 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G →
                    Real.exp (-2) * ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G ≤
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ∧
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ≤
                          2 * ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G ∧
                        ↑N ^ (kap / 3) ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ∧
                          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ≤ ↑N ∧
                            ∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                              ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G)
                                        ↑↑q)).card ≤
                                4 * √↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeS.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeSet_estimates._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeS.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
