RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldRelativeS.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), Real.exp x * Real.exp y = Real.exp (x + y)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_mem_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_mem_translate
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_mem_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k}
  {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reserveMinus < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central →
        RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reservePlus →
          ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
            ∀ (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (e : ℝ) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
              |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                        RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x| ≤
                  e →
                |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                          (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)| ≤
                    e →
                  e + 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reserveMinus) omega) →
                    e + 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reservePlus) omega) →
                      ∀ (i : Fin N),
                        RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i = RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z →
                          i ∈
                            RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G)
                              ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank_barriers
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reserveMinus < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central →
        RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.central < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList G.reservePlus →
          ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
            (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
            (i : Fin N),
            RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i = RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z →
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
                      RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega +
                    RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reserveMinus) omega ≤
                  ↑i ∧
                ↑i + 1 + RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reservePlus) omega ≤
                  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
                    RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank_barriers._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.mu ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank_barriers._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.ms ≤ W.mu → W.mu ≤ K → ¬W.ms ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank_barriers._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i : Fin N),
  ↑i <
      RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
        (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
          (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
            (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
        omega →
    ¬↑i + 1 ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
            (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
              (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
            omega →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank_barriers._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.coldWord_rank.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.mu (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z)) omega =
        RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
          RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.mu (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z)) omega =
        RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
          RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega →
    RiffleLowerV2.upperRank
          (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
            (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
              (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
          omega ≤
        ↑i →
      ↑i + 1 ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
            (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
              (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
            omega →
        RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.mu (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z)) omega ≤
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
              (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
                  (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
              omega →
          RiffleLowerV2.upperRank
                (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                    (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                omega ≤
              RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.mu (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.central z)) omega →
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
                        (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                    omega +
                  RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
                        (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                    omega =
                RiffleLowerV2.upperRank
                  (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                    (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
                      (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                  omega →
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                          (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                      omega +
                    RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                          (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                      omega =
                  RiffleLowerV2.upperRank
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                        (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                    omega →
                ¬(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
                            RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega +
                          RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount
                            (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                              (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reserveMinus
                                (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                            omega ≤
                        ↑i ∧
                      ↑i + 1 +
                          RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount
                            (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt (W.mu + W.bridgeLength)
                              (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x G.reservePlus
                                (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.ambient)))
                            omega ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) omega +
                          RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) →
                  False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected_digits
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
      (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {xi chi : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        0 < chi →
          RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts G.ambient →
            RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType →
              RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) xi 2 G.tailType →
                (∀ v ∈ {G.central, G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                    ∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), min chi (1 / ↑k) ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (v j)) / ↑N) →
                  have c := min xi (min chi (1 / ↑k));
                  0 < c ∧
                    (∀ y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G,
                        ∀ (j : Fin K), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get y j)) / ↑N) ∧
                      ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                        ∀ v ∈ {G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                          ∀ (j : Fin ↑(RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v).fst),
                            c ≤ ↑(cuts.count ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v).snd j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected_digits._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cold_selected.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.collision_exp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.collision_exponent_buffers
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.collision_exp.type:
∀ {b jp hp jt ht jps hps jts hts ellb dj dh kap kap0 err : ℝ},
  0 < kap →
    0 < kap0 →
      kap0 ≤ kap / 100 →
        err ≤ kap0 / 1000 →
          |jps - jp| + |hps - hp| ≤ err →
            |jts - (jt - dj)| + |hts - (ht - dh)| ≤ err →
              0 ≤ dj →
                dj ≤ kap0 / 50 →
                  dh ≤ kap0 / 50 →
                    0 ≤ ellb →
                      ellb ≤ kap0 / 50 →
                        kap ≤ 2 * b - 2 * jp - 2 * jt + hp + ht - (b - jp + hp) / 2 →
                          b - jp - jt < kap0 →
                            kap / 2 ≤ 2 * (b - jps - jts - ellb) + hps + hts - (b - jps + hps) / 2 ∧
                              b - jps - jts - ellb ≤ 2 * kap0

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_card
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → b ≤ K → (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b).card = b - a

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_card._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → ∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b)), a ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < b → ¬↑↑j - a < b - a → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_card._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → b ≤ K → ∀ (j : Fin (b - a)), ¬a + ↑j < K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_card._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → ∀ (j : Fin (b - a)), ¬(a ≤ a + ↑j ∧ a + ↑j < b) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_card._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_car.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b)), a ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < b → ¬a + (↑↑j - a) = ↑↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_dis.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_disjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_dis.type: ∀ {K a b c : ℕ}, Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b) (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K b c)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_dis.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_disjoint._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_dis.type: ∀ {K a b c : ℕ} ⦃j : Fin K⦄, a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b → b ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < c → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_siz.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_size
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_siz.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {T : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        ∀ (a b : ℕ), ↑(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) a b).card ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_union
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.type:
∀ {K a b c : ℕ},
  a ≤ b → b ≤ c → RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b ∪ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K b c = RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a c

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_union._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.type: ∀ {K a b c : ℕ}, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → ∀ (j : Fin K), ¬(a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b ∨ b ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < c ↔ a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < c) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_union._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.columnSet_uni.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.count_fractio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.count_fraction_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.count_fractio.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K), 0 < N → ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ d : Fin k, ↑(cuts.count j d) / ↑N = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cylinder_mass.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cylinder_mass
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.cylinder_mass.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] (p : α → β → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : α), ∑ d : β, p j d = 1) →
    ∀ (S : α → Prop) (z : α → β),
      (∑ y : α → β, if ∀ (h : α), S h → y h = z h then RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass p y else 0) =
        ∏ h : α, if S h then p h (z h) else 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.deterministic.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.deterministicColdGeometry._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.deterministic.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (Nt Ns N : ℕ) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu → W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T → ¬W.ms ≤ TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.type:
∀ (N k K : ℕ) (kap b : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError N k K kap b =
    ↑N ^ (kap / 4) * ((2 * √(↑k * ↑K) + 1) * ↑N ^ (b / 2) + 2 * ↑k * ↑K + 1)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError_le
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {T kap b : ℝ},
      0 < T →
        0 < kap →
          4 * kap ≤ b →
            ↑K ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
              4 * ↑k * T * TimeProfile.logScale N + 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (kap / 4) →
                RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError N k K kap b ≤ ↑N ^ (b / 2 + kap / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N),
      2 ≤ k →
        ∀ {eta rho chi : ℝ},
          0 < rho →
            0 < chi →
              ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts a →
                  ∀ (Dp Dt : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                    RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chi W →
                      ∃ (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
                        G.ambient = a ∧
                          G.prefixType = Dp ∧
                            G.tailType = Dt ∧
                              RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec cuts hN rho chi G ∧
                                ∀ v ∈ {G.central, G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                                  ∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)),
                                    min chi (1 / ↑k) ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (v j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {K : ℕ} {rho : ℝ} (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (gL gR : Fin K),
  W.mu ≤ ↑gL → ↑gL < ↑gR → ¬W.mu ≤ ↑gR → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type: ∀ {k N : ℕ} {K : ℕ} {rho : ℝ} (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (gL gR : Fin K), ↑gL < ↑gR → ↑gL = ↑gR → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry._proof_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {N : ℕ} {K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {rho : ℝ} (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (gL gR : Fin K),
      gL ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W →
        gR ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W → ∀ (loL hiL loR hiR : Fin k), ¬1 ≤ k → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry._proof_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {N : ℕ} {K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {rho : ℝ} (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (gL gR : Fin K),
      gL ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W →
        gR ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W → ∀ (loL hiL loR hiR : Fin k), ¬0 < k → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridgeGeometry._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_bridge.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geometry_scalar_thresholds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (eta rho chi : ℝ),
      0 < eta →
        0 < chi →
          2 * rho * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 100 →
            ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
              2 ≤ N0 ∧
                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                  N0 ≤ N →
                    (2 * rho + 1 / TimeProfile.logScale N) * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 50 ∧
                      2 * rho * Real.log ↑k + (Real.log ↑k + 2 * Real.log (1 / chi)) / TimeProfile.logScale N ≤
                          RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 50 ∧
                        12 / RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
                          ∀ (b ell : ℝ),
                            b / 2 + 2 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ ell →
                              ↑N ^ (b / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) ≤
                                Real.exp (-1) * chi ^ 2 * ↑k ^ (-1) * ↑N ^ (ell - 2 * rho * Real.log ↑k)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geometry_scalar_thresholds._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.type: ∀ (k Nr Nl Np N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geometry_scalar_thresholds._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_geomet.type: ∀ (k Nr Nl Np N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_locali.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_localization_thresholds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_locali.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (T kap : ℝ),
  0 < kap →
    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
      2 ≤ N0 ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ),
          N0 ≤ N →
            4 * ↑k * T * TimeProfile.logScale N + 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (kap / 4) ∧ 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (kap / 2) ∧ 16 ≤ ↑N ^ (5 * kap / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_li.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_linear_rpow_threshold
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_li.type: ∀ (a B C : ℝ), 0 < a → ∃ (N0 : ℕ), 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ), N0 ≤ N → B * TimeProfile.logScale N + C ≤ ↑N ^ a

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_li.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_linear_rpow_threshold._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_log_li.type: ∀ (Nt N : ℕ), max 2 Nt ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_small_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_small_type_cutoff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_small_.type: ∀ (k : ℕ), 2 ≤ k → ∀ (B err : ℝ), 0 < err → ∃ (xi : ℝ), 0 < xi ∧ xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) ∧ B * xi * Real.log (1 / xi) ≤ err

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_unifor.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_uniform_type_data
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.exists_unifor.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T err : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < err →
          ∃ (xi : ℝ),
            0 < xi ∧
              xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) ∧
                ∃ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                  P.IsRegular xi 1 ∧
                    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                      2 ≤ N0 ∧
                        ∀ (N K : ℕ),
                          N0 ≤ N →
                            ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (I : Finset (Fin K)),
                              ↑I.card ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                                ∀ alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4,
                                  ∃ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                                    RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D ∧
                                      RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha err D

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.finite_weight.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.finite_weight_error
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.finite_weight.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (S : Finset ι) (mu value : ι → ℝ) (A M D : ℝ),
  0 ≤ A →
    0 ≤ M →
      0 ≤ D →
        (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ mu i) →
          ↑S.card ≤ D →
            ∑ i ∈ S, mu i ≤ M →
              (∀ i ∈ S, |value i - mu i| ≤ A * (√(mu i) + 1)) → |∑ i ∈ S, (value i - mu i)| ≤ A * (√D * √M + D)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
    (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) →
      (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) → 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega → Fin (N - 1)
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
    (hw : 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega) =>
  ⟨RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega, ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
    RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤ N →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega -
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
        ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega < N - 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega → RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega < N - 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge_injective
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  Function.Injective fun (w : { w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K // 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega }) =>
    RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge omega ↑w ⋯

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge_words
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (hw : 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega),
  RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega
        (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft (RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge omega w hw)) =
      w ∧
    RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega
        (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight (RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge omega w hw)) =
      w

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge_words._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
    RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤ N →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega -
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
        ¬(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega <
                RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega) →
          False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeatedWordEdge_words._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.firstRepeated.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
    RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤ N →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega -
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w omega →
        ¬(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega + 1 ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega + 1 <
                RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega) →
          False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass.type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → [Fintype α] → (α → β → ℝ) → (α → β) → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass.value: fun {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Fintype α] (p : α → β → ℝ) (y : α → β) => ∏ j : α, p j (y j)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass..name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass..type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] (p : α → β → ℝ) (y : α → β),

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass_.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] (p : α → β → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : α), ∑ d : β, p j d = 1) → ∑ y : α → β, RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass p y = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.geometry_expo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.geometry_exponent_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.geometry_expo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi : ℝ},
        0 < eta →
          0 < rho →
            ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
              (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
              RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chi W →
                RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) W.theta
                    (RiffleLowerV2.Localization.geometryError eta) G.prefixType →
                  RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) 2
                      (RiffleLowerV2.Localization.geometryError eta) G.tailType →
                    RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec cuts hN rho chi G →
                      (2 * rho + 1 / TimeProfile.logScale N) * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 50 →
                        2 * rho * Real.log ↑k + (Real.log ↑k + 2 * Real.log (1 / chi)) / TimeProfile.logScale N ≤
                            RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta / 50 →
                          have b := RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N);
                          have ellp := RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G;
                          have hp := RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType;
                          have h := RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G;
                          have z := RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G;
                          have g := RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G;
                          b / 2 + 2 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ ellp ∧
                            hp ≤ ellp - RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧
                              RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ h ∧
                                RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ g - h / 2 ∧ z ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_Ico_subset
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ (a b : ℤ), RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (Finset.Ico a b) ⊆ {a - 1, b - 1}

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_Ico_subset._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Finset.Ico a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x < b)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_Ico_subset._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} {a b : α}, (a ∈ insert b s) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ s)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_biUnion_subset
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (H : α → Finset ℤ),
  RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (S.biUnion H) ⊆ S.biUnion fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (H a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_inter_subset
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type:
∀ (H J : Finset ℤ),

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_inter_subset._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_inter_subset._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {a : α} {s₁ s₂ : Finset α}, (a ∈ s₁ ∩ s₂) = (a ∈ s₁ ∧ a ∈ s₂)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_intervalUnion_card_le
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (l r : α → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (S.biUnion fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (l a) (r a))).card ≤ 2 * S.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_translate
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type:
∀ (H : Finset ℤ) (q : ℤ),
  RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (Finset.image (fun (z : ℤ) => z + q) H) =
    Finset.image (fun (z : ℤ) => z + q) (RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary H)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_translate._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ (q z : ℤ), ¬z - q + q = z → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_translate._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ (q z : ℤ), ¬z + 1 - q = z - q + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_translate._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ (q a : ℤ), ¬a + q + 1 - q = a + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_union_subset
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type:
∀ (H J : Finset ℤ),
  RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary (H ∪ J) ⊆ RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary H ∪ RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary J

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBoundary_union_subset._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerBounda.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_card_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type:
∀ {l r : ℝ},
  l ≤ r → r - l - 1 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r).card ∧ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r).card ≤ r - l + 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_card_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ {l r : ℝ}, l ≤ r → ↑(RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r).card = ↑⌈r⌉ - ↑⌈l⌉

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_disjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ {l r l' r' : ℝ}, r ≤ l' → Disjoint (RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r) (RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l' r')

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_eq_Ico
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ (l r : ℝ), RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r = Finset.Ico ⌈l⌉ ⌈r⌉

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_eq_Ico._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Finset.Ico a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x < b)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_eq_Ico._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Ring α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : FloorRing α] {z : ℤ} {a : α}, (⌈a⌉ ≤ z) = (a ≤ ↑z)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOpen_eq_Ico._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.integerHalfOp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Ring α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : FloorRing α] {z : ℤ} {a : α}, (z < ⌈a⌉) = (↑z < a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.intervalUnion.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.intervalUnion_card_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.intervalUnion.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (l r : α → ℝ),
  (∀ a ∈ S, l a ≤ r a) →
    ((↑S).PairwiseDisjoint fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (l a) (r a)) →
      ∑ a ∈ S, (r a - l a) - ↑S.card ≤ ↑(S.biUnion fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (l a) (r a)).card ∧
        ↑(S.biUnion fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (l a) (r a)).card ≤ ∑ a ∈ S, (r a - l a) + ↑S.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_bridge_lt
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
        (v v' : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
        (z z' : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
        RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList v < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList v' →
          List.take (W.mu + W.bridgeLength) (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z)) <
            List.take (W.mu + W.bridgeLength) (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v' z'))

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_digit_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (c : ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin K), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get G.ambient j)) / ↑N) →
    (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W)), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N) →
      (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (v j)) / ↑N) →
        (∀ (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (z j)) / ↑N) →
          ∀ (j : Fin K), c ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_ambient
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
      (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
      (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (j : Fin K),
      ↑j < W.ms → List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) j = List.Vector.get G.ambient j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_ambient._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (j : Fin K), ↑j < W.ms → W.ms ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < W.mu → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_ambient._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData},
  W.ms ≤ W.mu → ∀ (j : Fin K), ↑j < W.ms → W.mu ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < W.mu + W.bridgeLength → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_ambient._proof_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData},
  W.ms ≤ W.mu → ∀ (j : Fin K), ↑j < W.ms → W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_bridge
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)),
  List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) ↑j = v j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_bridge._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)),
  W.mu ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < W.mu + W.bridgeLength → W.ms ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < W.mu → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_prefix
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W)),
  List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) ↑j = x j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_tail
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  List.Vector.get (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) ↑j = z j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_tail._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < K → W.ms ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < W.mu → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_get_tail._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < K → W.mu ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < W.mu + W.bridgeLength → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_injective
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)),
  Function.Injective
    fun
      (xz :
        RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) ×
          RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) =>
    RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G xz.1 v xz.2

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_mass
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
        (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
        (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
        RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) =
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) * RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x *
              RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts v *
            RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts z

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_mass._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.mu ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_take_mu_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
        (v v' : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
        (z z' : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
        List.take W.mu (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z)) =
          List.take W.mu (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v' z'))

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_take_mu_eq._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.mu ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_take_mu_eq._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.joinColdWord_.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} (j : Fin K), ¬↑j < W.ms → ¬W.ms ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.localized_col.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.localized_collisions_supply_edges
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.localized_col.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (Y : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K))
  (H : Finset (Fin N)),
  (∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ (i : Fin N), RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i = y → i ∈ H) →
    {y ∈ Y | 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount y omega}.card ≤
      Finset.card (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges omega ∩ RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges H)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.lowerRank_pre.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.lowerRank_prefixAt
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.lowerRank_pre.type:
∀ {k N K m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  m ≤ K →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
      RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega =
        {i : Fin N |
            List.take m (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i)) < List.take m (List.Vector.toList w)}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.map_lt_map_if.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.map_lt_map_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.map_lt_map_if.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] (L : List α),
  List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : α) => x1 < x2) L →
    ∀ (f g : α → β), List.map f L < List.map g L ↔ ∃ j ∈ L, f j < g j ∧ ∀ h ∈ L, h < j → f h = g h

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpow_geometryEllB
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
      (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts G.central →
        RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts G.central = ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllB cuts G)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpow_geometryEllB._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_eq_rpo.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False
