RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_le_one_of_positive_population
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_le_one.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I), RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_nonnegative
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_nonneg.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_restri.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_restrictWord
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_restri.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (I : Finset (Fin K)) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord I w) = ∏ j ∈ I, ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.massOn_sum.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∀ (I : Finset (Fin K)), ∑ y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I, RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts y = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ} {j : Fin K}, j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b ↔ a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_columnSet.type: ∀ {K a b : ℕ} {j : Fin K}, (j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b) = (a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBoundary
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBo.type: ∀ (H : Finset ℤ) (z : ℤ), z ∈ RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary H ↔ z ∈ H ∧ z + 1 ∉ H ∨ z ∉ H ∧ z + 1 ∈ H

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBoundary._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerBo.type: ∀ (H : Finset ℤ) (z : ℤ), (z ∈ RiffleLowerV2.integerBoundary H) = (z ∈ H ∧ z + 1 ∉ H ∨ z ∉ H ∧ z + 1 ∈ H)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHalfOpen
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHa.type: ∀ (l r : ℝ) (z : ℤ), z ∈ RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r ↔ l ≤ ↑z ∧ ↑z < r

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHalfOpen._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.mem_integerHa.type: ∀ (l r : ℝ) (z : ℤ), (z ∈ RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen l r) = (l ≤ ↑z ∧ ↑z < r)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_eq_o.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_eq_of_get
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_eq_o.type:
∀ {k K m : ℕ} {a b : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K},
  m ≤ K →
    (∀ (j : Fin K), ↑j < m → List.Vector.get a j = List.Vector.get b j) →
      RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m a = RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m b

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_join.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_joinColdWord
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_join.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
        (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
        (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) = RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_join.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_joinColdWord._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_join.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.ms ≤ W.mu → W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.ms ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_toLi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_toList
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixAt_toLi.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  m ≤ K → List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m a).snd = List.take m (List.Vector.toList a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_a.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_add_lowerRank
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_a.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w omega + RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w omega = RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_a.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_add_lowerRank._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixCount_a.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w omega ≤ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega →
    RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega - RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w omega = RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w omega →
      ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w omega + RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w omega = RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_prefixAt_eq_prod
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (m : ℕ) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  m ≤ K →
    RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m a) =
      ∏ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K 0 m, ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get a j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_prefixAt_eq_prod._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_prefixAt_eq_prod._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_pr.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) =
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) *
            RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight
              (fun (h : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (e : Fin k) => ↑(cuts.count (↑h) e) / ↑N) x j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), ¬↑↑j + 1 ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), l ≤ ↑↑j → ∀ (h : Fin K), ↑h < l → h = ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (h : Fin K), ↑h < l → l ≤ ↑h ∧ ↑h < m → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), l ≤ ↑↑j → ∀ (h : Fin K), ↑h < l → ¬↑h < ↑↑j + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (h : Fin K), ¬(↑h ≤ ↑↑j ↔ ↑h < ↑↑j + 1) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sidePrefix._proof_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_si.type:
∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)),
  ↑↑j < m → ∀ (h : Fin K), ¬↑h < l → ¬(l ≤ ↑h ∧ ↑h < m) → ↑h < ↑↑j + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_split
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMass_sp.type:
∀ {k N K a b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  a ≤ b →
    b ≤ K →
      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt b w) =
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt a w) *
          RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b) w)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_le_population
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_le.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∀ (v : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K), RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v ≤ ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_sidePrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefixMean_si.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) =
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) *
            RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight
              (fun (h : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (e : Fin k) => ↑(cuts.count (↑h) e) / ↑N) x j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_cold_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {T eta rho chi xi : ℝ},
      0 < T →
        0 < eta →
          ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
            (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
            RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chi W →
              RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
                ↑K ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  4 * ↑k * T * TimeProfile.logScale N + 4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) →
                    4 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                      16 ≤ ↑N ^ (5 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) →
                        ∀ (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
                          RiffleLowerV2.allPrefixEvent (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) omega →
                            have b := RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N);
                            have e := RiffleLowerV2.Localization.endpointError N k K (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) b;
                            (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                                |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                                        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                                          RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x| +
                                    |↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount G.ambient W.ms W.mu x omega) -
                                        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) *
                                          (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)| ≤
                                  e) ∧
                              ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                                e + 2 ≤
                                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reserveMinus)
                                        omega) ∧
                                  e + 2 ≤
                                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x G.reservePlus) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_cold_bounds._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_event_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.mu ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_expone.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_exponent_buffers
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_expone.type:
∀ {b jp hp jstar hstar kap err : ℝ},
  0 < kap →
    err ≤ kap / 1000 →
      hp ≤ jp →
        jp ≤ b / 2 - 3 * kap →
          kap ≤ b - jp + hp →
            |jstar - jp| + |hstar - hp| ≤ err →
              b / 2 + 2 * kap ≤ b - jstar ∧ hstar ≤ b - jstar - kap ∧ kap / 2 ≤ b - jstar + hstar

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_b.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_b.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w omega ≤ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega ∧ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w omega ≤ N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_b.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_bounds_of_take_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prefix_rank_b.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (a w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
        List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) →
          ∀ (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
            RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIntervals_card_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (S : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I)) {mu Q : ℝ},
  0 ≤ mu →
    (∀ x ∈ S, Real.exp (-1) * Q ≤ mu * RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ∧ mu * RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ Q) →
      ↑S.card * (Real.exp (-1) * Q - 1) ≤
          ↑(S.biUnion fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (mu * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x)
                  (mu * (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x))).card ∧
        ↑(S.biUnion fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (mu * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x)
                  (mu * (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x))).card ≤
          ↑S.card * (Q + 1)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIntervals_card_le_population
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (S : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I)) {mu : ℝ},
      0 ≤ mu →
        mu ≤ ↑N →
          (S.biUnion fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (mu * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x)
                  (mu * (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x))).card ≤
            N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIntervals_pairwiseDisjoint
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probabilityIn.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (S : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I)) {mu : ℝ},
  0 ≤ mu →
    (↑S).PairwiseDisjoint fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.integerHalfOpen (mu * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x)
        (mu * (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x))

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_a.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_add_complement
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_a.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P A + RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (omega : Ω) => ¬A omega) = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_g.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_ge_one_sub_failure
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.probability_g.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop) {e : ℝ},
  (∀ (omega : Ω), A omega → B omega) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (omega : Ω) => ¬A omega) ≤ e → 1 - e ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_columnSe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_columnSet_split
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_columnSe.type:
∀ {K a b c : ℕ} (f : Fin K → ℝ),
  a ≤ b →
    b ≤ c →
      ∏ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a c, f j =
        (∏ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b, f j) * ∏ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K b c, f j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_subtype_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_subtype_dite
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.prod_subtype_.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (I : Finset α) (f : ↥I → ℝ),
  (∏ j : α, if hj : j ∈ I then f ⟨j, hj⟩ else 1) = ∏ j : ↥I, f j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipTranslate
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (H : Finset ℤ) (q : ℤ),
  RiffleLowerV2.rankSet (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H q) =
    Finset.image (fun (z : ℤ) => z + q) H ∩ Finset.Ico 1 (↑N + 1)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipTranslate._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.type: ∀ (N : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (i : Fin N), ¬RiffleLowerV2.manuscriptRank i - q + q = RiffleLowerV2.manuscriptRank i → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipTranslate._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.type: ∀ (N : ℕ) (q z a : ℤ), 1 ≤ z → z < ↑N + 1 → ¬(z - 1).toNat < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipTranslate._proof_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.type: ∀ (N : ℕ) (q z a : ℤ), 1 ≤ z → ¬↑(z - 1).toNat + 1 = z → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipTranslate._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.rankSet_clipT.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrder α] {a b x : α}, (x ∈ Finset.Ico a b) = (a ≤ x ∧ x < b)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpoint._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpo.type: ∀ (N K l m : ℕ), ¬0 < N → ¬N = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpoint_identities
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeEndpo.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount a l m x omega) -
              RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x =
            ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
              ∑ d : Fin k with d < x j,
                (↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d)) ∧
          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount a l m x omega) -
              RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) *
                (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) =
            ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega) -
                RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) -
              ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
                ∑ d : Fin k with x j < d,
                  (↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega) -
                    RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d))

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
    RiffleLowerV2.Word k K →
      (l m : ℕ) → RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (l m : ℕ)
    (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>
  {i : Fin N |
      List.take l (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i)) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x <
          RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList
            (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i))}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (l m : ℕ)
  (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount a l m x omega =
    {i : Fin N |
        List.take l (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i)) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x <
            RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList
              (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i))}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount_eq_side_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreat.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount a l m x omega) =
          ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
            ∑ d : Fin k with x j < d, ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLowerCount_eq_side_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount a l m x omega) =
          ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
            ∑ d : Fin k with d < x j, ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLowerCount_eq_side_sum._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  (∃ (j : ↥I), x j < y j ∧ ∀ h < j, x h = y h) = (RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList y)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLowerMean_eq_side_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) * RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x =
          ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
            ∑ d : Fin k with d < x j, RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLowerMean_eq_side_sum._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeLower.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {K l m : ℕ}, ¬0 < N → ¬N = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → {I : Finset (Fin K)} → RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) =>
  ∑ y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I with RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList y,
    RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts y

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter cuts x =
    ∑ y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I with RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList y,
      RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts y

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter_eq_sideWeight
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassA.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
      RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter cuts x =
        ∑ j : ↥I,
          ∑ d : Fin k with x j < d,
            RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight (fun (h : ↥I) (e : Fin k) => ↑(cuts.count (↑h) e) / ↑N) x j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassBefore_add_mass_le_of_lt
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} {x y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I},
  RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList y →
    RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts y

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassBefore_add_mass_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
      RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassBefore_eq_sideWeight
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
      RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x =
        ∑ j : ↥I,
          ∑ d : Fin k with d < x j,
            RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight (fun (h : ↥I) (e : Fin k) => ↑(cuts.count (↑h) e) / ↑N) x j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassBefore_eq_sideWeight._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  (∃ (j : ↥I), x j < y j ∧ ∀ h < j, x h = y h) = (RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList x < RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList y)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassBefore_nonnegative
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassB.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMass_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMass_total
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMass_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
      RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x +
          RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeMassAfter cuts x =
        1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpperMean_eq_side_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) *
            (RiffleLowerV2.relativeMassBefore cuts x + RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) =
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) -
            ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
              ∑ d : Fin k with x j < d, RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpperMean_eq_side_sum._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {K l m : ℕ}, ¬0 < N → ¬N = 0 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper_add_greater
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount a l m x omega) +
            ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeGreaterCount a l m x omega) =
          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper_add_greater._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relativeUpper.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoidWithOne R] (p : ι → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred p]
  (s : Finset ι), ↑{x ∈ s | p x}.card = ∑ x ∈ s, if p x then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank_decomposition
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (a w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)),
        List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) →
          RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) w = x →
            ∀ (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega =
                  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega +
                    RiffleLowerV2.relativeLowerCount a l m x omega ∧
                RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega =
                  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a) omega +
                    RiffleLowerV2.relativeUpperCount a l m x omega

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank_decomposition._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {s t : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ s ∪ t) = (a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank_decomposition._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank_decomposition._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.relative_rank.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix_mean
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  W.ms ≤ W.mu →
    W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
        (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W)),
        RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v) =
          RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) * RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x *
            RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts v

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix_mean._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}, W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K → ¬W.mu ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix_mean_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
        (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {rho chi xi : ℝ},
        0 < rho →
          0 < chi →
            W.ms ≤ W.mu →
              W.mu + W.bridgeLength ≤ K →
                W.bridgeLength = ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ →
                  RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) =
                      ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N) →
                    RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) xi W.theta G.prefixType →
                      RiffleLowerV2.BridgeSpec cuts hN rho chi G →
                        ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldPrefixFamily cuts hN P W G,
                          ∀ v ∈ {G.central, G.reserveMinus, G.reservePlus},
                            Real.exp (-1) * chi ^ 2 * ↑k ^ (-1) *
                                ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G - 2 * rho * Real.log ↑k) ≤
                              RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.reservePrefix G x v)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix_mean_lower._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ k →
    0 < N →
      ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
        (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {rho : ℝ}, ¬0 < k → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix_mean_lower._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reservePrefix.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ k →
    0 < N →
      ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
        (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) {rho : ℝ}, ¬1 ≤ k → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reserve_count.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reserve_count_dominates
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.reserve_count.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {kap b e : ℝ},
      0 < kap →
        4 * kap ≤ b →
          e ≤ ↑N ^ (b / 2 + kap / 2) →
            4 ≤ ↑N ^ (kap / 2) →
              16 ≤ ↑N ^ (5 * kap / 2) →
                ∀ (v : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
                  ↑N ^ (b / 2 + kap) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v →
                    ∀ (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
                      RiffleLowerV2.allPrefixEvent (kap / 4) omega → e + 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount v omega)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join_bridge
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W) (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) = v

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join_prefix
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) = x

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join_tail
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.restrict_join.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) (RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z) = z

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.selected_digi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.selected_digit_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.selected_digi.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  {xi alpha : ℝ} (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D →
    ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D, ∀ (j : ↥I), xi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch.type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → [LT α] → (α → β) → (α → β) → α → β → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch.value: fun {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LT α] (x y : α → β) (j : α) (d : β) => y j = d ∧ ∀ h < j, y h = x h

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_iff.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_iff_coordinates
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_iff.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] (x y : α → β) (j : α) (d : β),
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d ↔ ∀ h ≤ j, y h = if h = j then d else x h

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_uni.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_unique
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch_uni.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] {x y : α → β} {j q : α} {d e : β},
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d →
    RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y q e → d ≠ x j → e ≠ x q → j = q

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_le
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      l ≤ m →
        m ≤ K →
          ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (R : Fin k → Fin k → Prop),
            (∀ (d e : Fin k), R d e → d ≠ e) →
              ∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
                  ∑ d : Fin k with R d (x j), RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_le._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMean_sum_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ} (a v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k),
        List.take (↑(RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d).fst) (List.Vector.toList v) =
            List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d).snd ↔
          List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) v) j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), ¬↑↑j + 1 ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), l ≤ ↑↑j → ∀ (q : Fin K), ↑q < l → q = ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (q : Fin K), ↑q < l → l ≤ ↑q → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), l ≤ ↑↑j → ∀ (q : Fin K), ↑q < l → ¬↑q < ↑↑j + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), ¬↑↑j < ↑↑j + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type: ∀ {K l m : ℕ} (j q : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)), ↑↑q < ↑↑j → ¬↑↑q < ↑↑j + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ} (v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k) (q : Fin K),
  ↑q < ↑↑j + 1 → ↑q ≠ ↑↑j → ¬↑q < ↑↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_coordinates._proof_1_9
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sidePrefix_co.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ} (v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (d : Fin k),
  ↑↑j < m → ∀ (q : Fin K), ↑q < ↑↑j + 1 → ¬(l ≤ ↑q ∧ ↑q < m) → ¬↑q < l → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight.type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → [Fintype α] → [LinearOrder α] → (α → β → ℝ) → (α → β) → α → β → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight.value:
fun {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Fintype α] [LinearOrder α] (p : α → β → ℝ) (x : α → β) (j : α) (d : β) =>
  ∏ h : α, if h ≤ j then p h (if h = j then d else x h) else 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq_massOn_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) (j : ↥I) (d : Fin k),
      RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight (fun (h : ↥I) (e : Fin k) => ↑(cuts.count (↑h) e) / ↑N) x j d =
        ∑ y : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I,
          if RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d then RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts y else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] (p : α → β → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : α), ∑ d : β, p j d = 1) →
    ∀ (x : α → β) (j : α) (d : β),
      RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight p x j d =
        ∑ y : α → β,
          if RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d then RiffleLowerV2.Localization.functionMass p y else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq_sum._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_eq.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] (x y : α → β) (j : α) (d : β),
  RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d = ∀ h ≤ j, y h = if h = j then d else x h

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_no.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight_no.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] (p : α → β → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : α) (d : β), 0 ≤ p j d) → ∀ (x : α → β) (j : α) (d : β), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight p x j d

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.side_error_bo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.side_error_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.side_error_bo.type:
∀ {k N K l m : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      l ≤ m →
        m ≤ K →
          ∀ (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (A : ℝ),
            0 < A →
              (∀ (v : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
                  |↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount v omega) - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v| ≤
                    A * (√(RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts v) + 1)) →
                ∀ (R : Fin k → Fin k → Prop),
                  (∀ (d e : Fin k), R d e → d ≠ e) →
                    |∑ j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m),
                          ∑ d : Fin k with R d (x j),
                            (↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d) omega) -
                              RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.sidePrefix a l m x j d))| ≤
                      A * (√(↑k * ↑K) * √(RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt l a)) + ↑k * ↑K)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sortedWord_fu.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sortedWord_full_rank_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sortedWord_fu.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (i : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i = w ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega ≤ ↑i ∧
      ↑i < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) omega

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_le_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type:
∀ {k N K m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  m ≤ K →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i : Fin N),
      ↑i < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega ↔
        List.take m (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i)) ≤ List.take m (List.Vector.toList w)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_le_iff._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_le_iff._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_lt_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type:
∀ {k N K m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  m ≤ K →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i : Fin N),
      ↑i < RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega ↔
        List.take m (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord omega i)) < List.take m (List.Vector.toList w)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_lt_iff._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_lt_iff._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sorted_take_l.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_massOn_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_massOn_eq_one
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_massOn_eq.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∀ (I : Finset (Fin K)), ∑ x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I, RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideMatch.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideMatch
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideMatch.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : Fintype β]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq β] (x y : α → β) (R : β → β → Prop),
  (∀ (d e : β), R d e → d ≠ e) →
    (∑ j : α, ∑ d : β with R d (x j), if RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x y j d then 1 else 0) =
      if ∃ (j : α), R (y j) (x j) ∧ ∀ h < j, y h = x h then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideWeigh.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideWeight_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sum_sideWeigh.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
  (p : α → β → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : α), ∑ d : β, p j d = 1) →
    (∀ (j : α) (d : β), 0 ≤ p j d) →
      ∀ (x : α → β) (R : β → β → Prop),
        (∀ (d e : β), R d e → d ≠ e) →
          ∑ j : α, ∑ d : β with R d (x j), RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideWeight p x j d ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.tail_grid_cos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.tail_grid_cost_sub
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.tail_grid_cos.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (mu bl : ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) =
      RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) -
        RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) ∧
    RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl)) (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) =
      RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) -
        RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN 2 (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N mu) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N (mu + bl))

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_map_f.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_map_finRange
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_map_f.type:
∀ {k K m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  List.take m (List.Vector.toList w) = List.map (fun (j : Fin m) => List.Vector.get w ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩) (List.finRange m)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_take_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_take_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_eq_take_.type:
∀ {k K l : ℕ},
  l ≤ K →
    ∀ (v a : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList a) ↔
        ∀ (j : Fin K), ↑j < l → List.Vector.get v j = List.Vector.get a j

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_le_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_le_split
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_le_split.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ},
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
        List.take m (List.Vector.toList v) ≤ List.take m (List.Vector.toList w) ↔
          List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) < List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) ∨
            List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) v) ≤
                RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) w)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ},
  l ≤ m →
    m ≤ K →
      ∀ (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
        List.take m (List.Vector.toList v) < List.take m (List.Vector.toList w) ↔
          List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) < List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) ∨
            List.take l (List.Vector.toList v) = List.take l (List.Vector.toList w) ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) v) <
                RiffleLowerV2.wordOnList (RiffleLowerV2.restrictWord (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m) w)

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.type: ∀ {k K l : ℕ} {m : ℕ} (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : Fin K), ¬↑j < l → ∀ (q : Fin K), ↑q < l → ¬↑q < ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.type: ∀ {k K l : ℕ} {m : ℕ} (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : Fin K), ¬↑j < l → ¬l ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ} (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)) (q : Fin K),
  ¬↑q < l → ¬l ≤ ↑q → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_split.type:
∀ {k K l m : ℕ} (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : ↥(RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K l m)),
  l ≤ ↑↑j ∧ ↑↑j < m → ∀ (q : Fin K), ↑q < ↑↑j → ¬↑q < m → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_.type:
∀ {k K m : ℕ},
  m ≤ K →
    ∀ (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      List.take m (List.Vector.toList v) < List.take m (List.Vector.toList w) ↔
        ∃ (j : Fin K),
          ↑j < m ∧
            List.Vector.get v j < List.Vector.get w j ∧
              ∀ (h : Fin K), ↑h < ↑j → List.Vector.get v h = List.Vector.get w h

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_iff._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.take_lt_take_.type: ∀ {k K m : ℕ}, m ≤ K → ∀ (v w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (j : Fin m) (q : Fin K), ↑q < ↑j → ¬↑q < m → False

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.typeApproxima.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.typeApproximation_grid
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.typeApproxima.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {a b : ℕ},
      a ≤ b →
        ∀ (alpha err : ℝ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
          RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b) alpha err D →
            |RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D -
                    RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN alpha (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N a) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N b)| +
                |RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b) D -
                    RiffleLowerV2.H cuts hN alpha (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N a) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N b)| ≤
              err

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.upperRank_pre.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.upperRank_prefixAt
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.upperRank_pre.type:
∀ {k N K m : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K},
  m ≤ K →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (omega : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt m w) omega =
        {i : Fin N |
            List.take m (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord omega i)) ≤ List.take m (List.Vector.toList w)}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Localization.weighted_side.name: RiffleLowerV2.Localization.weighted_side_partition
RiffleLowerV2.Localization.weighted_side.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [inst_2 : Fintype β]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq β] [inst_4 : Fintype Ω] (x : α → β) (y : Ω → α → β) (A : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ)
  (R : β → β → Prop),
  (∀ (d e : β), R d e → d ≠ e) →
    (∑ ω : Ω, if A ω ∧ ∃ (j : α), R (y ω j) (x j) ∧ ∀ h < j, y ω h = x h then f ω else 0) =
      ∑ j : α,
        ∑ d : β with R d (x j), ∑ ω : Ω, if A ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Localization.sideMatch x (y ω) j d then f ω else 0

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.bridgeCei.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.bridgeCeiling_spec
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.bridgeCei.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {eta : ℝ},
      0 < eta →
        0 < RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.bridgeCeiling k eta ∧
          ∀ rho ≤ RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.bridgeCeiling k eta,
            2 * rho * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 (eta / 2) / 100

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (Nt : ℕ),
  2 ≤ Nt →
    ∀ (Nl Nc : ℕ),
      ¬2 ≤
            max Nt
              (max
                (RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.transferThreshold (Real.log ↑k)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta))
                (max Nl Nc)) →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (Nt Nl Nc N : ℕ),
  max Nt
        (max
          (RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.transferThreshold (Real.log ↑k)
            (RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta))
          (max Nl Nc)) ≤
      N →
    ¬Nt ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (Nt Nl Nc N : ℕ),
  max Nt
        (max
          (RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.transferThreshold (Real.log ↑k)
            (RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta))
          (max Nl Nc)) ≤
      N →
    Nt ≤ N →
      ¬RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.transferThreshold (Real.log ↑k)
              (RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta) ≤
            N →
        False

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (Nt Nl Nc N : ℕ),
  max Nt
        (max
          (RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.transferThreshold (Real.log ↑k)
            (RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta))
          (max Nl Nc)) ≤
      N →
    Nt ≤ N → ¬Nl ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable._proof_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta : ℝ) (Nt Nl Nc N : ℕ),
  max Nt
        (max

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscopicIntegrable_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.macroscop.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta : ℝ),
      0 < T →
        0 < eta →
          ∃ (chiPartition : ℝ),
            0 < chiPartition ∧
              chiPartition < 1 / ↑k ∧
                ∃ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
                  P.IsRegular chiPartition 1 ∧
                    ∃ (rho0 : ℝ),
                      0 < rho0 ∧
                        2 * rho0 * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 (eta / 2) / 100 ∧
                          ∀ (rho : ℝ),
                            0 < rho →
                              rho ≤ rho0 →
                                ∃ (phi0 : ℝ),
                                  0 < phi0 ∧
                                    ∀ (phi : ℝ),
                                      0 < phi →
                                        phi ≤ phi0 →
                                          ∀ (chiGood gamma : ℝ),
                                            0 < chiGood →
                                              0 < gamma →
                                                ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k),
                                                  RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
                                                    ∀ (cuts : (N : ℕ) → RiffleLowerV2.Targets.HorizonCuts k N T),
                                                      (∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                                                          ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N),
                                                            TimeProfile.AlmostLike (cuts N) ⋯ μ P T rho phi ∧
                                                              TimeProfile.LocalGood (cuts N) ⋯ chiGood gamma rho 0 T) →
                                                        eta ≤
                                                            max (RiffleLowerV2.macroBeta μ T)
                                                              (RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ T) →
                                                          Filter.Tendsto
                                                            (fun (N : ℕ) =>
                                                              RiffleLowerV2.tv
                                                                (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw (cuts N))
                                                                (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N))
                                                            Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.small_bet.name: RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.small_beta_forces_cold
RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.small_bet.type:
∀ {eta betaFinite lambda0 lambda1 lambdaFinite d : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    d ≤ RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta / 4 →
      |betaFinite - lambda0| ≤ RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta + d →
        |lambdaFinite - lambda1| ≤ 13 / 2 * RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta + 14 * d →
          betaFinite < RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 (eta / 2) →
            eta ≤ max lambda0 lambda1 → lambda0 < eta ∧ eta / 2 ≤ lambdaFinite

RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferA.type:

      RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta < RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 (eta / 2) / 10 ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.MacroscopicLower.transferAccuracy eta < eta / 100

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_singleton.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_singleton
RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_singleton.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_swap.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_swap
RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_swap.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (P : PMF α) (Q : PMF β) (F : α → β → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (a : α) => RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (F a)) =

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Nonempty α] (f : α → ℝ),

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform._simp_1_1

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform_const

RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform_const._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.expect_uniform_const.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α], (Fintype.card α = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Model.inversionEquiv._proo.type: ∀ (N : ℕ) (e : Fin N ≃ Fin N), e.symm.symm = e

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:

    ∀ (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber f g) (i : Fin N), f (((Equiv.symm τ).trans ↑ρ) i) = f i

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {W : Type u_1} (f g : Fin N → W) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  (∀ (i : Fin N), f (τ i) = g i) →
    ∀ (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyStabilizer f) (i : Fin N), f ((Equiv.trans τ ↑ρ) i) = g i

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_3
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {W : Type u_1} (f g : Fin N → W) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (hτ : ∀ (i : Fin N), f (τ i) = g i)
  (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber f g) (i : Fin N),
  f ((Equiv.trans τ ↑⟨(Equiv.symm τ).trans ↑ρ, ⋯⟩) i) = g i

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_4
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {W : Type u_1} (f g : Fin N → W) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (hτ : ∀ (i : Fin N), f (τ i) = g i)
  (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber f g), ⟨Equiv.trans τ ↑⟨(Equiv.symm τ).trans ↑ρ, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = ρ

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_5
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {W : Type u_1} (f g : Fin N → W) (τ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (hτ : ∀ (i : Fin N), f (τ i) = g i)
  (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyStabilizer f) (i : Fin N), f (((Equiv.symm τ).trans ↑⟨Equiv.trans τ ↑ρ, ⋯⟩) i) = f i

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEquiv._proof_6
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiberEq.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyAssignmentFiber_c.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_3
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_4
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_5
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {W : Type u_1} (f : Fin N → W) (η : (w : W) → Equiv.Perm { i : Fin N // f i = w }) (w : W) (i : Fin N),

RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._proof_6
RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyStabilizerEquiv._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.key_eq_of_componentI.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (f : Fin N → α) {i j : Fin N} (a b : Fin N), ↑b - ↑a = 0 → a ≤ b → ¬↑a = ↑b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Model.key_eq_of_componentI.type: ∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (f : Fin N → α) {i j : Fin N} (d : ℕ) (a b : Fin N), 0 < ↑b → ¬↑b - 1 ≤ ↑b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Model.key_eq_of_componentI.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (f : Fin N → α) {i j : Fin N} (d : ℕ) (a b : Fin N),

RiffleLowerV2.Model.map_uniform_equiv.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_expect_eq_gra.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_even.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_event
RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_even.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : Fin N → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (A : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω = w ∧ A (RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ω)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      if RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω = w then
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
          A (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) π)
      else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_expe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Model.matrix_multiset_expe.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (F : (Fin N → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      F (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω) (RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ω)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
        F (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω) (RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) π)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (l : List (Fin K)) (hj : j ∉ l) =>

    toFun := fun (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>
      Function.update ω j
        ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω))) (ω j)),
    invFun := fun (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>
      Function.update ω j ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω)) (ω j)),
    left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯ }

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear..name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear..type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (l : List (Fin K)),
  j ∉ l →
    ∀ (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
      Function.update
          (Function.update ω j
            ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω))) (ω j)))
          j
          ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j
              (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l
                (Function.update ω j
                  ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω)))
                    (ω j)))))
            (Function.update ω j
              ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (Equiv.symm (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω))) (ω j))
              j)) =
        ω

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear..name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear..type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (l : List (Fin K)),
  j ∉ l →
    ∀ (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
      Function.update
          (Function.update ω j
            ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω)) (ω j)))
          j
          ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j
              (Equiv.symm
                (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l
                  (Function.update ω j
                    ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω)) (ω j))))))
            (Function.update ω j
              ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.columnEquiv cuts j (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalListSort l ω)) (ω j)) j)) =
        ω

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (l : List (Fin K)) (hj : j ∉ l)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalInverseList.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalInverseList
RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalInverseList.type: {k N K : ℕ} → {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} → List (Fin K) → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N
RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalInverseList.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (l : List (Fin K)) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>

{k N K : ℕ} →
  (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) →
    (x : List (Fin K)) →
      List.below (motive := fun (x : List (Fin K)) => x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
          x →
        x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts
RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalPullback._f.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (x : List (Fin K))
    (f :
      List.below (motive := fun (x : List (Fin K)) => x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
        x)
    (x_1 : x.Nodup) =>
  (match (motive :=
      (x : List (Fin K)) →
        x.Nodup →
          List.below (motive := fun (x : List (Fin K)) =>
              x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) x →
            RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
      x, x_1 with
    | [], x =>
      fun
        (x :
          List.below (motive := fun (x : List (Fin K)) =>
            x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) []) =>
      Equiv.refl (RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
    | j :: l, h =>
      fun
        (x :
          List.below (motive := fun (x : List (Fin K)) =>
            x.Nodup → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts ≃ RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (j :: l)) =>
      (x.1 ⋯).trans (RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalColumnShear cuts j l ⋯))
    f

RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalPullback.mat.value:
fun {K : ℕ} (motive : (x : List (Fin K)) → x.Nodup → Sort u_1) (x : List (Fin K)) (x_1 : x.Nodup)

    (h_2 : (j : Fin K) → (l : List (Fin K)) → (h : (j :: l).Nodup) → motive (j :: l) h) =>
