RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ →
    ∀
      (τ :
        RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω)
          (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm σ))),
      RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) (Equiv.symm ↑τ) = σ

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFiberEquiv._proof_3
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ →
    ∀ (π : RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ),
      RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) (Equiv.symm ↑⟨Equiv.symm ↑π, ⋯⟩) = σ

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFiberEquiv._proof_4
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (hσ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ)
  (π : RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ), ⟨Equiv.symm ↑⟨Equiv.symm ↑π, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = π

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFiberEquiv._proof_5
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (hσ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ)
  (τ :
    RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω) (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm σ)))
  (i : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω ((Equiv.symm ↑⟨Equiv.symm ↑τ, ⋯⟩) i) = RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω ((Equiv.symm σ) i)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFiberEquiv._proof_6
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleComponentFibe.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (hσ : RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ)
  (τ :
    RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω) (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm σ))),
  ⟨Equiv.symm ↑⟨Equiv.symm ↑τ, ⋯⟩, ⋯⟩ = τ

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleEdges_relabel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleEdges_relabel
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffleEdges_relabel.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.sampleRelabel cuts ρ) ω) = RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreasing_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreas.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ ↔
    ∀ (i j : Fin N), i < j → RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i = RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω j → σ i < σ j

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreasing_iff._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_blockIncreas.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i j : Fin N),
  (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) i =
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) j) =
    (RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i = RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω j)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentInd.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentIndex_eq_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentInd.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) i =
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) j ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i = RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω j

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentInd.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentIndex_lt_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentInd.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) i <
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) j ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i < RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω j

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSort_fiber_card
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ →
    Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ) =
      ∏ w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K, {i : Fin N | RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i = w}.card.factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSort_fiber_card._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α], Fintype.card α = Nat.card α

RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSort_fiber_card_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Model.shuffle_componentSor.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ) =
    if RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ then
      ∏ w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K, {i : Fin N | RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω i = w}.card.factorial
    else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_cons.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_cons
RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_cons.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (f : Fin N → α) (g : Fin N → List α),
  (Tuple.sort fun (i : Fin N) => f i :: g i) =
    Equiv.trans (Tuple.sort fun (i : Fin N) => f ((Tuple.sort g) i)) (Tuple.sort g)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_preserves_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_preserves_first
RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_preserves_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] (c : Fin N → α) (v : Fin N → β),
  Monotone c → ∀ (i : Fin N), c ((Tuple.sort fun (j : Fin N) => toLex (c j, v j)) i) = c i

RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_second_str.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_second_strict
RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_pair_second_str.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (c : Fin N → α) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  Monotone c →
    ∀ {i j : Fin N},
      i < j →
        c i = c j →
          π ((Tuple.sort fun (q : Fin N) => toLex (c q, π q)) i) <
            π ((Tuple.sort fun (q : Fin N) => toLex (c q, π q)) j)

RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_relabel_compone.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_relabel_componentSort
RiffleLowerV2.Model.sort_relabel_compone.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (f : Fin N → α) (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  Tuple.sort (f ∘ ⇑ρ) =
    RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.Model.keyEdges (f ∘ ⇑(Tuple.sort f)))
      (Equiv.trans (Tuple.sort f) (Equiv.symm ρ))

RiffleLowerV2.Model.sortedWord_relabel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.sortedWord_relabel
RiffleLowerV2.Model.sortedWord_relabel.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.sampleRelabel cuts ρ) ω) = RiffleLowerV2.sortedWord ω

RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_physicalP.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_physicalPullback
RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_physicalP.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.physicalPullbackEquiv cuts) ω) = RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverse ω

RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_relabel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_relabel
RiffleLowerV2.Model.stableSort_relabel.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (ρ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ((RiffleLowerV2.Model.sampleRelabel cuts ρ) ω) =
    RiffleLowerV2.componentSort (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω) (Equiv.trans (RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ω) (Equiv.symm ρ))

RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_expect_equiv.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_expect_equiv
RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_expect_equiv.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : Nonempty α] [inst_3 : Nonempty β]
  (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) fun (a : α) => f (e a)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype β) f

RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_pi_expect_pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_pi_expect_prod
RiffleLowerV2.Model.uniform_pi_expect_pr.type:
∀ {T : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype T] {A : T → Type u_2} [inst_1 : (t : T) → Fintype (A t)]
  [inst_2 : ∀ (t : T), Nonempty (A t)] (f : (t : T) → A t → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((t : T) → A t)) fun (ω : (t : T) → A t) => ∏ t : T, f t (ω t)) =
    ∏ t : T, RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (A t)) (f t)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_covariance_le_complement
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  |(RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) -
        RiffleLowerV2.probability P A * RiffleLowerV2.probability P B| ≤
    RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬B ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.benchmark_lower_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.benchmark_lower_at_tau
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.benchmark_lower_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {μ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 →
      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < μ →
        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision μ

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal_absolute
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (A : ℝ),
        0 < A ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                        |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) -
                              RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤
                          A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal_absolute._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal_absolute._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.type:
∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ),
  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N →
    2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
      ∀ r ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N, ¬r ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_t.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_term_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_t.type:
∀ {D C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ D →
    0 ≤ C →
      ∀ {N : ℕ},
        1 ≤ N →
          1 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N →
            TimeProfile.logScale N ^ 3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 50) →
              ∀ {μ ν : ℝ},
                0 ≤ μ →
                  0 ≤ ν →
                    μ + ν ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + μ) * (1 + ν) * Real.exp (μ + ν) ≤
                        4 * D * (C + 1) * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_absolute
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (A : ℝ),
        0 < A ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    w ≠ v →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                          ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                            ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                              |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                      RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                                    RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) *
                                      RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v)| ≤
                                A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_absolute._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
  0 < t →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f / t ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
          1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) + η / t ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.coarseMomentErro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.coarseMomentError_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.coarseMomentErro.type:
∀ (D C : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) * (↑N ^ (1 / 5)) ^ 2 / ↑N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.collision_succes.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.collision_success
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.collision_succes.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (W : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)),
                    RiffleLowerV2.selectedPiles cuts W c →
                      0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) →
                        1 - 4 / RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) -
                            4 * D * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤
                          RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                            fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                            RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) / 2 ≤
                              RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalColli.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalCollisionStability._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalColli.type: ∀ (b0 N1 M0 N2 N b : ℕ), b < N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalProba.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalProbability_eq_expect_indicator
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditionalProba.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability P A B = RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => if A ω then 1 else 0) B

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_full.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_fullWord_empty_singleton_tail
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_full.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective p.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
        ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
          RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
              (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card < 2)
              (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) ≤
            2 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∀ (b0 : ℕ),
        ∃ (D : ℝ),
          0 < D ∧
            ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
              b0 < N0 ∧
                2 ≤ N0 ∧
                  ∀ N ≥ N0,
                    ∀ (k K b : ℕ),
                      b ≤ b0 →
                        ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                          ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
                            Function.Injective p.row →
                              0 <
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
                                ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                                  (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                                    ∀ (r : ℕ),
                                      ↑r ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) →
                                        |RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                  RiffleLowerV2.falling
                                                    (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card) r)
                                                (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) -
                                              RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w ^ r| ≤
                                          D * (↑K + 1) * ↑r ^ 2 / ↑N *
                                            RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → Finset ι → (ι → Ω → Prop) → Ω → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.value: fun {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω) => ∑ i ∈ W, if A i ω then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount.eq_1.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω),
  RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω = ∑ i ∈ W, if A i ω then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount_nonne.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount_nonne.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central_error_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.type:
∀ (D C : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        ∀ N ≥ N0,
          (∀ (μ ν : ℝ),
              0 ≤ μ →
                μ ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                  0 ≤ ν →
                    ν ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + μ) * (1 + ν) * Real.exp (μ + ν) +
                          3 *
                            (RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) μ +
                                RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ν +
                              RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) μ *
                                RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ν) ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralConstant D C * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)) ∧
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                t ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                  RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + t) * Real.exp t +
                      3 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) t ≤
                    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralConstant D C * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central_scales
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.type:
∀ (D C : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        ∀ N ≥ N0,
          2 ≤ N ∧
            1 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
              2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ∧
                Even (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ∧
                  2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N ∧
                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N) ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) ∧
                      ↑N ^ (1 / 25) / 4 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ∧
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ≤ ↑N ∧
                          3 * TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) * Real.log 2 ∧
                            TimeProfile.logScale N ^ 3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 50) ∧
                              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N ∧
                                RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_margina.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_marginal_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_margina.type:
∀ (D C A : ℝ),
  ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
    ∀ N ≥ N0,
      2 ≤ N ∧
        10 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
            9 * D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) / ↑N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ∧
              A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 3 ∧
                2 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N / 2) +
                      (1 + RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N) *
                        Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N) ≤
                    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N / 2 ∧
                  3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_nonrare.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_nonrare_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_nonrare.type:
∀ (A : ℝ),
  ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
    ∀ N ≥ N0,
      2 ≤ N ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
            A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 5 ∧
              2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 3 / 4

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pair_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pa.type:
∀ (c C D H : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < H →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        ∀ N ≥ N0,
          3 ≤ N ∧
            0 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
                H * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                  9 * D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) / ↑N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ∧
                    3 ≤ c * ↑N ∧ 3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residual_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.type:
∀ (c C D : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    ∀ (b0 M0 : ℕ),
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        b0 < N0 ∧
          2 ≤ N0 ∧
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ b ≤ b0,
                b < N ∧
                  2 ≤ N - b ∧
                    M0 ≤ N - b ∧
                      2 * ↑b ≤ c * ↑N ∧
                        ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) ∧
                          TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.logScale (N - b) ∧
                            RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau (N - b) ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ∧
                              RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                                D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) * ↑b0 / ↑N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residual_budgets._proof_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (b0 M0 N1 N b : ℕ), b ≤ b0 → M0 + b0 ≤ N → b < N → ¬M0 ≤ N - b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residual_budgets._proof_1_9
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.type: ∀ (c : ℝ) (b0 M0 N1 N b : ℕ), b < N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_const.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_const_mul_rpow_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_const.type: ∀ (a r q : ℝ), r < q → ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a * ↑N ^ r ≤ ↑N ^ q

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_log_a.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_log_affine_mul_rpow_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_log_a.type: ∀ (a b r q : ℝ), r < q → ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (a * TimeProfile.logScale N + b) * ↑N ^ r ≤ ↑N ^ q

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_negat.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_negative_rpow_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventually_negat.type: ∀ {r e : ℝ}, r < 0 → 0 < e → ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑N ^ r ≤ e

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_word_law
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective p.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount p j a) ∧
            (∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (F : ℕ → ℝ),
                RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      F (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card))
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
                  RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                    fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => F (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w η)) ∧
              (∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : ℕ → Prop),
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                        A (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card))
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                      fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => A (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w η)) ∧
                ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                  ↑(N - b) * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass residual w = RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exp_logScale_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exp_logScale_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exp_logScale_mul.type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, 0 < N → ∀ (a : ℝ), Real.exp (TimeProfile.logScale N * a) = ↑N ^ a

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) = ∑ i ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount_sq
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω ^ 2) =
    ∑ i ∈ W, ∑ j ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => (if A ω then 1 else 0) * if B ω then 1 else 0) =
    RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forci.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forci.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      if RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e) ω then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_e.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e))

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted_event_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b * if A ω then 1 else 0) =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        A ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e) ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → Prop)
  (δ : ℝ),
  (∀ (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
      0 <
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
          (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e))) →
    (∀ (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
        |RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A
                (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e)) -
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A| ≤
          δ * RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A) →
      |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b * if A ω then 1 else 0) -
            (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) *
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A| ≤
        (δ *
            RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) *
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_singleton_tail
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_s.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω < 2) ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_complement
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  0 < N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          ¬RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω) ≤
        2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_complement._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b : α}, (¬a ≤ b) = (b < a)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) → TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.logScale (N - b)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ¬0 < N - b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.log_affine_mul_r.type: ∀ (a b r : ℝ), r < 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (a * TimeProfile.logScale N + b) * ↑N ^ r) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_succe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_success
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_succe.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        1 - 1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) - η / t ^ 2 ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => (1 - t) * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f < f ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError.value: fun (D C : ℝ) (N : ℕ) => D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) * ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N) ^ 2 / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonn.type: ∀ {D C : ℝ}, 0 ≤ D → 0 ≤ C → ∀ {N : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_relative
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (k K : ℕ),
              ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                  w ≠ v →
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
                          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v →
                            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                    RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)| ≤
                              128 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N *
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                  (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_relative._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probabil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probability_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probabil.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  0 < N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 16 →
      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
        |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) -
                RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤
            8 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) →
          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 2 / 2 ≤
            RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N < 4 * (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4) + 4 →
      ¬2 ≤ 2 * (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
    ¬RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_fac.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_fac.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      ∀ (r : ℕ),
                        ↑r ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) →
                          |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                  fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                  RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) r) -
                                (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r| ≤
                            D * (↑K + 1) * ↑r ^ 2 / ↑N * (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_fac.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_fac.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    w ≠ v →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                          ∀ (r s : ℕ),
                            ↑(r + s) ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) →
                              |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) r *
                                        RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount v ω) s) -
                                    (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r *
                                      (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v) ^ s| ≤
                                D * (↑K + 1) * ↑(r + s) ^ 2 / ↑N *
                                  ((↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r * (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v) ^ s)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of_benchmark
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of.type:
∀ {p q joint f g ε δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f →
    0 ≤ g →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ δ →
            |p - f| ≤ ε * f → |q - g| ≤ ε * g → |joint - f * g| ≤ δ * f * g → |joint - p * q| ≤ 4 * (δ + 3 * ε) * p * q

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_elasticity
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ {t : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    0 ≤ t * deriv RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t / RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ∧
      t * deriv RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t / RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ≤ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → Real.exp (-t) * t ^ 2 / 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_lower_min
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → Real.exp (-1) / 2 * min (t ^ 2) 1 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_rare
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ (t : ℝ),
  0 ≤ t → t ^ 2 / 2 - t ^ 3 / 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ∧ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ≤ t ^ 2 / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_scale_compare
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 < x → x ≤ y → x ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision y ≤ y ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_stability
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ {x y δ : ℝ},
  0 < x →
    0 < y →
      0 ≤ δ →
        δ ≤ 1 →
          |y - x| ≤ δ * x →
            |RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision y - RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x| ≤
              3 * δ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder_exp_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ≤ ↑m * Real.exp (2 * t - ↑m * Real.log 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder_le_inverse
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    ↑m ≤ ↑N →
      3 * TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ ↑m * Real.log 2 →
        ∀ {t : ℝ},
          0 ≤ t →
            t ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ∧ RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ≤ ↑N ^ (-1)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
      1 - 1 / RiffleLowerV2.expect P f - η ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 0 < f ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefixCount_fullPrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount p (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) = {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefixCount_fullPrefix._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefixCount_fullPrefix._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_le_left
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_le_right
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_cong.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_congr
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_cong.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω ↔ B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A = RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_fals.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_false
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_fals.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => False) = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_le_o.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_le_o.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω → B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_nonn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_nonn.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_not.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_not
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_not.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω) = 1 - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_true.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_true
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_true.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => True) = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_marginal_re.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_marginal_relative
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_marginal_re.type:
∀ {μ τ η p E2 E3 : ℝ},
  0 < μ →
    μ ≤ τ →
      τ ≤ 1 / 2 →
        0 ≤ η →
          η ≤ τ →
            |E2 - μ ^ 2| ≤ η * μ ^ 2 →
              |E3 - μ ^ 3| ≤ η * μ ^ 3 →
                E2 / 2 - E3 / 3 ≤ p →
                  p ≤ E2 / 2 → |p - RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision μ| ≤ 8 * τ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision μ

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relati.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relative_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relati.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            2 ≤ N0 ∧
              ∀ N ≥ N0,
                ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                  ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                      w ≠ v →
                        (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                          (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                            ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N →
                              |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                      RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                        (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                        (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)| ≤
                                D * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N *
                                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relati.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relative_uniform._proof_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.rare_pair_relati.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N4 N : ℕ), 3 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixCount_fullPrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixCo.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount p (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
    RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixMe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixMean_fullPrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualPrefixMe.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts p (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) =
    RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualWordMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualWordMean_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residualWordMean.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  {c : ℝ},
  b < N →
    ↑b < c * ↑N →
      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
        0 < RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residual_selecte.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residual_selected_piles
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.residual_selecte.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)
  (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
  (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount p j a) →
    ∀ {c : ℝ},
      0 < c →
        2 * ↑b ≤ c * ↑N →
          (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
            ∀ (j : Fin K), c / 2 * ↑(N - b) ≤ ↑(residual.count j (List.Vector.get w j))

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.type: {N k K b : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K → (Fin b ↪ Fin N) → RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.value: fun {N k K b : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N) => { row := ⇑e, word := fun (x : Fin b) => w }

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e = { row := ⇑e, word := fun (x : Fin b) => w }

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription_row_injective
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescrip.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
  Function.Injective (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e).row

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
  b ≤ N →
    (∀ (j : Fin K), b ≤ cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) →
      0 <
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
          (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e))

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing_probability
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_forcing.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e)) =
    ∏ j : Fin K, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) b / RiffleLowerV2.falling N b

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_prescri.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_prescribed_other_count
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWord_prescri.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
  w ≠ v → {q : Fin b | (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e).word q = v}.card = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_pow.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_pow
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_pow.type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, 0 < N → ∀ (r : ℕ), RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ r = ↑N ^ (-1 / 100 * ↑r)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_sub_le_two_t.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_sub_le_two_tau
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau_sub_le_two_t.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 0 < N → ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) → RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau (N - b) ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.two_mul_bonferro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.two_mul_bonferroniOrder_le._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.two_mul_bonferro.type:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4 * 4 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
    ¬2 * (2 * (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4)) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniformOccupancy.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniformOccupancy._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniformOccupancy.type: ∀ (Nr : ℕ), 2 ≤ Nr → ∀ (Nn Nm N : ℕ), Nr ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (k K : ℕ),
              ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                  (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                    |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) -
                          RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤
                      8 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N *
                        RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.uniform_marginal.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_collisi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_collisionCount_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_collisi.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (W : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)) (η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ η →
    (∀ w ∈ W,
        ∀ v ∈ W,
          w ≠ v →
            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                    RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)| ≤
              η * RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) ≤
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) +
          η * RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eq.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.variance P f = (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω ^ 2) - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCount
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCo.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.variance P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) =
    ∑ i ∈ W,
      ∑ j ∈ W,
        ((RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω) -
          RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j))

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCount_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCo.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ η →
    (∀ i ∈ W,
        ∀ j ∈ W,
          i ≠ j →
            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j)| ≤
              η * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) ≤
        RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) +
          η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.variance P f

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.weighted_rare_sa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.weighted_rare_sandwich
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.weighted_rare_sa.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (A : Ω → Prop),
  ((RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) 2 * if A ω then 1 else 0) / 2 -
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) 3 * if A ω then 1 else 0) / 3 ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 2 ≤ X ω ∧ A ω) ∧
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 2 ≤ X ω ∧ A ω) ≤
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.falling (X ω) 2 * if A ω then 1 else 0) / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.wordMean_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.wordMean_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.wordMean_pos.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) {c : ℝ},
  0 < c →
    0 < N → (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) → 0 < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Alm.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.AlmostLike.timeCellCount_error
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Alm.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {hN : 0 < N} {mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k}
  {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {T rho phi : ℝ},
  TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts hN mu P T rho phi →
    2 ≤ N →
      0 < rho →
        ∀ {a : ℝ},
          0 ≤ a →
            (∃ (z : ℤ), a = rho * ↑z) →
              a + rho ≤ T →
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
                  |↑(RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timeCellCount cuts hN P a (a + rho) i) /
                          TimeProfile.logScale N -
                        ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..a + rho, TimeProfile.cellMass mu P i t| ≤
                    phi * rho + 2 / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.BorelPartition.cell_mass_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (nu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (TimeProfile.Simplex k))
  (i : Fin P.cellCount), 0 ≤ (↑nu (P.cell i)).toReal ∧ (↑nu (P.cell i)).toReal ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.BorelPartition.measurableSet_cell
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (i : Fin P.cellCount), MeasurableSet (P.cell i)

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.BorelPartition.sum_cell_mass
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.Bor.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (nu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (TimeProfile.Simplex k)),
  ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, (↑nu (P.cell i)).toReal = 1

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.cel.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.cellMass_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.cel.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (t : ℝ),
  0 ≤ TimeProfile.cellMass mu P i t ∧ TimeProfile.cellMass mu P i t ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.finite_integral_envelope
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure nu] (h : ι → Ω → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ) (F : Ω → ℝ) {M omega : ℝ},
  0 ≤ M →
    0 ≤ omega →
      (∀ (i : ι) (t : Ω), 0 ≤ h i t) →
        (∀ (t : Ω), ∑ i : ι, h i t = 1) →
          (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ r i ∧ r i ≤ M) →
            (∀ (t : Ω), 0 ≤ F t) →
              (∀ (t : Ω), F t ≤ omega + ∑ i : ι, r i * h i t) →
                ∫ (t : Ω), F t ∂nu ≤ (M + omega) * nu.real Set.univ - ∑ i : ι, (M - r i) * ∫ (t : Ω), h i t ∂nu

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.finite_integral_envelope._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.finite_integral_envelope._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.finite_integral_envelope_of_counts
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure nu] (h : ι → Ω → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ) (F : Ω → ℝ) {M omega : ℝ},
  0 ≤ M →
    0 ≤ omega →
      (∀ (i : ι) (t : Ω), 0 ≤ h i t) →
        (∀ (t : Ω), ∑ i : ι, h i t = 1) →
          (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ r i ∧ r i ≤ M) →
            (∀ (t : Ω), 0 ≤ F t) →
              (∀ (t : Ω), F t ≤ omega + ∑ i : ι, r i * h i t) →
                ∀ (c : ι → ℝ) {d e : ℝ},
                  0 ≤ d →
                    (∀ (i : ι), |c i - ∫ (t : Ω), h i t ∂nu| ≤ d) →
                      nu.real Set.univ - ∑ i : ι, c i ≤ e →
                        ∫ (t : Ω), F t ∂nu ≤
                          ∑ i : ι, r i * c i + omega * nu.real Set.univ + M * (e + ↑(Fintype.card ι) * d)

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.finite_integral_envelope_of_counts._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.fin.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.int.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.interval_integral_envelope_of_counts
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.int.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (a b : ℝ),
  a ≤ b →
    ∀ (h : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) {M omega : ℝ},
      0 ≤ M →
        0 ≤ omega →
          (∀ (i : ι) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ h i t) →
            (∀ (t : ℝ), ∑ i : ι, h i t = 1) →
              (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ r i ∧ r i ≤ M) →
                (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ F t) →
                  (∀ (t : ℝ), F t ≤ omega + ∑ i : ι, r i * h i t) →
                    ∀ (c : ι → ℝ) {d e : ℝ},
                      0 ≤ d →
                        (∀ (i : ι), |c i - ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, h i t| ≤ d) →
                          b - a - ∑ i : ι, c i ≤ e →
                            ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, F t ≤
                              ∑ i : ι, r i * c i + omega * (b - a) + M * (e + ↑(Fintype.card ι) * d)

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem_timePositions
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.type:
∀ {N K : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} {j : Fin K},
  j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b ↔
    a < TimeProfile.columnTime N j ∧ TimeProfile.columnTime N j ≤ b

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem_timePositions._simp_1
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.type:
∀ {N K : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} {j : Fin K},
  (j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b) =
    (a < TimeProfile.columnTime N j ∧ TimeProfile.columnTime N j ≤ b)

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem_timePositions_iff_floor
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.mem.type:
∀ {N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {a b : ℝ},
      0 ≤ a →
        a ≤ b →
          ∀ (j : Fin K),
            j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b ↔
              ⌊a * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ < ↑j + 1 ∧ ↑j + 1 ≤ ⌊b * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one_sided_quadrature
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {T rho phi M omega a b : ℝ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ),
  0 ≤ T →
    0 < rho →
      0 ≤ phi →
        0 ≤ M →
          0 ≤ omega →
            (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
              (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), |f p - f (P.rep (P.classify p))| ≤ omega) →
                TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ mu P T rho phi →
                  0 ≤ a →
                    a ≤ b →
                      b ≤ T →
                        ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑(mu t) ≤
                          (∑
                                j ∈
                                  RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) a
                                    b,
                                f (cuts.profile ⋯ j)) /
                              TimeProfile.logScale N +
                            RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.quadratureError N T rho phi P.cellCount M omega

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one_sided_quadrature_representative
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.one.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {T rho phi M omega a b : ℝ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ),
  0 ≤ T →
    0 < rho →
      0 ≤ phi →
        0 ≤ M →
          0 ≤ omega →
            (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
              (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), |f p - f (P.rep (P.classify p))| ≤ omega) →
                TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ mu P T rho phi →
                  0 ≤ a →
                    a ≤ b →
                      b ≤ T →
                        ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑(mu t) ≤
                          (∑
                                j ∈
                                  RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) a
                                    b,
                                f (P.rep (P.classify (cuts.profile ⋯ j)))) /
                              TimeProfile.logScale N +
                            RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.quadratureError N T rho phi P.cellCount M omega

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.pro.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.probability_integral_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.pro.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (nu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (TimeProfile.Simplex k)) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ) {M : ℝ},
  0 ≤ M →
    (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
      0 ≤ ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑nu ∧ ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑nu ≤ M

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.pro.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.probability_integral_le_cell_sum
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.pro.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (nu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (TimeProfile.Simplex k))
  (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ) {M omega : ℝ},
  0 ≤ M →
    0 ≤ omega →
      (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
        (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), |f p - f (P.rep (P.classify p))| ≤ omega) →
          ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑nu ≤ omega + ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, f (P.rep i) * (↑nu (P.cell i)).toReal

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.qua.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.quadratureError
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.qua.type: ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.qua.value:
fun (N : ℕ) (T rho phi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (M omega : ℝ) =>
  2 * omega * T + M * ↑m * phi * T + 2 * M * rho + (omega + M + 2 * M * ↑m) * ↑(⌊T / rho⌋₊ + 1) / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.qua.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.quadratureError.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.qua.type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (T rho phi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (M omega : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.quadratureError N T rho phi m M omega =
    2 * omega * T + M * ↑m * phi * T + 2 * M * rho +
      (omega + M + 2 * M * ↑m) * ↑(⌊T / rho⌋₊ + 1) / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum_cellMass
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (t : ℝ),
  ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, TimeProfile.cellMass mu P i t = 1

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum_timeCellCount
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (a b : ℝ),
  ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timeCellCount cuts hN P a b i =
    (RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b).card

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum_timeCellCount_real
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (a b : ℝ),
  ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount,
      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timeCellCount cuts hN P a b i) / TimeProfile.logScale N =
    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b).card / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.tim.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timeCellCount
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.tim.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → 0 < N → (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) → ℝ → ℝ → Fin P.cellCount → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.tim.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (a b : ℝ)
    (i : Fin P.cellCount) =>
  {j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N K a b | P.classify (cuts.profile hN j) = i}.card

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.tim.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timeCellCount.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.tim.type:

∀ {N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {t : ℝ},
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K →
          RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N ⌊t * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ ∈ Set.Icc 0 (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) ∧
            0 ≤ t - RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N ⌊t * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ ∧
              t - RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N ⌊t * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ ≤ 1 / TimeProfile.logScale N

∀ {k : ℕ},

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.integrable.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.integrable_of_continuous_bounded
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.integrable.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (ν : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (TimeProfile.Simplex k)) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ) {M : ℝ},
  Continuous f → (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) → MeasureTheory.Integrable f ↑ν

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.integrable.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profileMax.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profileMaxCost_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profileMax.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (t : ℝ),
      0 ≤ TimeProfile.profileMaxCost μ t ∧ TimeProfile.profileMaxCost μ t ≤ Real.log ↑k

RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profilePsi.name: RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profilePsi_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.profilePsi.type:

    ∀ (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (t : ℝ) {α : ℝ},
