    {j : Fin K} →
      RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {j : Fin K} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
    (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) =>
  ⟨fun (i : Fin N) => ↑c ((Equiv.symm σ) i), ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel._pr.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {j : Fin K} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) (a : Fin k), {x : Fin N | ↑c ((Equiv.symm σ) x) = a}.card = cuts.count j a

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel.eq_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel.eq_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {j : Fin K} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel σ c = ⟨fun (i : Fin N) => ↑c ((Equiv.symm σ) i), ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEquiv
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
    {j : Fin K} →
      RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j ≃ TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEquiv._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {j : Fin K} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel (Equiv.symm σ) (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel σ c) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEquiv._proof_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabelEqui.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {j : Fin K} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N)
  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel σ (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnRelabel (Equiv.symm σ) c) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_count_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_count_le
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_count_le.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), cuts.count j a ≤ N

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_intersecti.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_intersection_transform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_intersecti.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k) (A : Finset (Fin N)) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) fun (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) =>
        s ^ (A ∩ {i : Fin N | ↑c i = a}).card) ≤
      (1 - ↑(cuts.count j a) / ↑N + ↑(cuts.count j a) / ↑N * s) ^ A.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k)
  (f : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample Finset.univ (cuts.count j a) → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF cuts j) fun (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) =>
      f (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.columnDigitSubset a c)) =
    (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw Finset.univ (cuts.count j a) ⋯).expect f

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_expect._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.type: ∀ {α : Sort u} {p : α → Prop} {a1 a2 : { x : α // p x }}, (a1 = a2) = (↑a1 = ↑a2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_expect._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.column_subset_exp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.existsComplementE.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.existsComplementEnumeration
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.existsComplementE.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  Function.Injective r.row →
    ∃ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
      Function.Injective e ∧ ∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.exists_canonicalM.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.exists_canonicalMaxWord
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.exists_canonicalM.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∃ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K), RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_add.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_add
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_add.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω + g ω) = RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_const_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_const_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_const_mul.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => c * f ω) = c * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), f ω ≤ g ω) → RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P g

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.expect_nonneg.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.half_mean_of_tran.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.half_mean_of_transform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.half_mean_of_tran.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (μ : ℝ),
  (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => s ^ X ω) ≤ Real.exp (μ * (s - 1))) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X ω) ≤ μ / 2) ≤ Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * μ)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_intersection_transform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.type:
∀ (M d : ℕ) (Ω : Fin d → Type u_1) [inst : (j : Fin d) → Fintype (Ω j)] [inst_1 : ∀ (j : Fin d), Nonempty (Ω j)]
  (S : (j : Fin d) → Ω j → Finset (Fin M)) (q : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ q j ∧ q j ≤ 1) →
    (∀ (j : Fin d) (A : Finset (Fin M)) (s : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Ω j)) fun (ω : Ω j) => s ^ (A ∩ S j ω).card) ≤
            (1 - q j + q j * s) ^ A.card) →
      ∀ (A : Finset (Fin M)) (s : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((j : Fin d) → Ω j)) fun (ω : (j : Fin d) → Ω j) =>
              s ^ (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin A S ω).card) ≤
            (1 - ∏ j : Fin d, q j + (∏ j : Fin d, q j) * s) ^ A.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_intersection_transform._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop}, (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), P i) = (P 0 ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), P i.succ)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_intersection_transform._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.independent_inter.type: ∀ {a b c : Prop}, ((a ∧ b) ∧ c) = (a ∧ b ∧ c)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithi.type:
{M d : ℕ} →
  {Ω : Fin d → Type u_1} → Finset (Fin M) → ((j : Fin d) → Ω j → Finset (Fin M)) → ((j : Fin d) → Ω j) → Finset (Fin M)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithi.type:
∀ {M d : ℕ} {Ω : Fin d → Type u_1} (A : Finset (Fin M)) (S : (j : Fin d) → Ω j → Finset (Fin M))
  (ω : (j : Fin d) → Ω j), RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin A S ω = {i ∈ A | ∀ (j : Fin d), i ∈ S j (ω j)}

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_trans.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_transform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_trans.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (X : Ω → ℕ) (μ : ℝ),
  (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => s ^ X ω) ≤ Real.exp (μ * (s - 1))) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => X ω < 2) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-μ / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_trans.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_transform._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.less_two_of_trans.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} (X : Ω → ℕ) (ω : Ω), X ω < 2 → ¬(X ω = 0 ∨ X ω = 1) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq.type:
∀ {M m : ℕ} (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M),
  Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) {i : Fin M | ↑i < m} = {i : Fin M | ↑((Equiv.symm σ) i) < m}

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α ↪ β} {s : Finset α} {b : β}, (b ∈ Finset.map f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.map_initial_eq._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.markov.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.markov
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.markov.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) →
    ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t → (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ f ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f / t

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalMean_eq_rp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalMean_eq_rpow_beta
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalMean_eq_rp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts ⋯ = ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts ⋯ (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalWordTail.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalWordTail
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.maximalWordTail.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  ∃ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
    RiffleLowerV2.IsCanonicalMaxWord cuts w ∧
      RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w * ↑N = RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          ↑m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN / 2 →
            (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω < m) ≤
              Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.type: {M : ℕ} → (B : Finset (Fin M)) → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M → RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample Finset.univ B.card
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.value: fun {M : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin M)) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) => ⟨Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) B, ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset._proof.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset._proof.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin M)) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M),
  Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) B ∈ Finset.powersetCard B.card Finset.univ

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset.eq_1.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin M)) (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset B σ = ⟨Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) B, ⋯⟩

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_intersection_transform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_inter.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (A B : Finset (Fin M)) {s : ℝ},
  0 < s →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation M) fun (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) =>
        s ^ (A ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) B).card) ≤
      (1 - ↑B.card / ↑M + ↑B.card / ↑M * s) ^ A.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subset_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.type:
∀ {M : ℕ} (B : Finset (Fin M)) (f : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample Finset.univ B.card → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation M) fun (σ : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) =>
      f (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permSubset B σ)) =
    (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw Finset.univ B.card ⋯).expect f

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subset_expect._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.type: ∀ {α : Sort u} {p : α → Prop} {a1 a2 : { x : α // p x }}, (a1 = a2) = (↑a1 = ↑a2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subset_expect._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.permutation_subse.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → Fin K → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin K) =>
  if h : ↑j < ↑w.fst then ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w.snd ⟨↑j, h⟩)) / ↑N else 1

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction cuts w j =
    if h : ↑j < ↑w.fst then ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w.snd ⟨↑j, h⟩)) / ↑N else 1

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin K),
      0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction cuts w j ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction cuts w j ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction_product
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFract.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
  ∏ j : Fin K, RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnFraction cuts w j = RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) →
    RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → (j : Fin K) → TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j → Finset (Fin N)
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin K)
    (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j) =>
  if h : ↑j < ↑w.fst then {i : Fin N | ↑c i = List.Vector.get w.snd ⟨↑j, h⟩} else Finset.univ

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet.e.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin K)
  (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments cuts j),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet cuts w j c =
    if h : ↑j < ↑w.fst then {i : Fin N | ↑c i = List.Vector.get w.snd ⟨↑j, h⟩} else Finset.univ

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_eq_ze.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_eq_zero_of_mass_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_eq_ze.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w = 0 → ∀ (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts), RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_intersectionWithin
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω =
    (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin Finset.univ (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet cuts w) ω).card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_intersectionWithin._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_intersectionWithin._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixCount_inter.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailureEnve.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailureEnvelope_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailureEnve.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (T ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * (T + 1) * ↑N ^ (1 + T * Real.log ↑k) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ ε / 8)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailure_le_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailure_le_envelope
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixFailure_le_.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    2 ≤ k →
      ∀ {T : ℝ},
        0 < T →
          ↑K ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
            ∀ (ε : ℝ),
              RiffleLowerV2.prefixFailure N k K ε ≤ 2 * (T + 1) * ↑N ^ (1 + T * Real.log ↑k) * Real.exp (-↑N ^ ε / 8)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixMean_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixMean_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixMean_nonneg.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (s : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              s ^ RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω) ≤
            (1 - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w + RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w * s) ^ N ∧
          (1 - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w + RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w * s) ^ N ≤
            Real.exp (RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts w * (s - 1))

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixTransform._.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.intersectionWithin Finset.univ (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefixColumnSet cuts w) ω).card =
    RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_exact.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_exact
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_exact.type: ∀ (k K : ℕ), Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) = ∑ n : Fin (K + 1), k ^ ↑n

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le.type: ∀ {k K : ℕ}, 1 ≤ k → Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) ≤ (K + 1) * k ^ K

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le_of_cuts
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_card_le_of.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K), 0 < N → Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) ≤ (K + 1) * k ^ K

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_coordinate.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_coordinates_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_coordinate.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts)
  (i : Fin N),
  List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord ω i)) = List.Vector.toList w.snd ↔
    ∀ (j : Fin ↑w.fst), TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω i (Fin.castLE ⋯ j) = List.Vector.get w.snd j

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_failure_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_failure_of_prefixTails
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prefix_failure_of.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.PrefixTails →
  ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ),
        0 < ε →
          ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
            (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                ↑N ^ ε * (√(RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts w) + 1) ≤
                  |↑(RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω) - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts w|) ≤
              2 * Real.exp (-↑N ^ ε / 8)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixC.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixC.type: {N k K b : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixC.value:
fun {N k K b : ℕ} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) =>
  {q : Fin b | List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.toList (r.word q)) = List.Vector.toList w.snd}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixC.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixC.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount r w =
    {q : Fin b | List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.toList (r.word q)) = List.Vector.toList w.snd}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_iUnio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_iUnion_le
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_iUnio.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {I : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype I] (P : PMF Ω) (A : I → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ∃ (i : I), A i ω) ≤ ∑ i : I, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_mono.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_mono.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω → B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_nonne.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_nonne.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_union.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_union_le
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.probability_union.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∨ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A + RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prod_prefix_exten.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prod_prefix_extension
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prod_prefix_exten.type: ∀ {d K : ℕ}, d ≤ K → ∀ (f : Fin d → ℝ), (∏ j : Fin K, if hj : ↑j < d then f ⟨↑j, hj⟩ else 1) = ∏ j : Fin d, f j

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualColumnInd.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualColumnIndependence
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualColumnInd.type:
∀ {k N K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective r.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
            ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
              Function.Injective e →
                (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                  ∀ (f : Fin K → (Fin (N - b) → Fin k) → ℝ),
                    RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          ∏ j : Fin K, f j fun (q : Fin (N - b)) => TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                      ∏ j : Fin K,
                        RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.columnPMF residual j)
                          fun (c : TimeProfile.ColumnAssignments residual j) => f j ↑c

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualCondition.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualConditionalExpect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualCondition.type:
∀ {k N K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),

        (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
          ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
            Function.Injective e →
              (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                ∀ (F : (Fin (N - b) → Fin K → Fin k) → ℝ),
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                        F fun (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K) => TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                    RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                      fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => F (TimeProfile.sampleRow η)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualCondition.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualConditionalProbability
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualCondition.type:
∀ {k N K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),

    0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →

        (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
          ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
            Function.Injective e →
              (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                ∀ (A : (Fin (N - b) → Fin K → Fin k) → Prop),
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualLaw._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualLaw._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualLaw._simp.type: ∀ {α : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {f g : (x : α) → β x}, (f = g) = ∀ (x : α), f x = g x

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.type:
{N k K b : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
    RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.value:
fun {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
    (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω =
    RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount_eq_restriction
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  Function.Injective r.row →
    ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
      Function.Injective e →
        (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
          ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
            RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r ω →
              RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω =
                RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount w fun (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K) =>
                  TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount_eq_restriction._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCou.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N)
  (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  (RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω =
      RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount r w +
        RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount w fun (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K) =>
          TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j) →
    (¬RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount r w =
          RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount w fun (q : Fin (N - b)) (j : Fin K) =>
            TimeProfile.sampleEntry ω (e q) j) →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixExp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixExpect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixExp.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective r.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
            ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
              Function.Injective e →
                (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                  ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (F : ℕ → ℝ),
                    RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          F (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω))
                        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                      RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                        fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => F (RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w η)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.type: {N k K b : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.value:
fun {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
    (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) =>
  ∏ j : Fin ↑w.fst,
    ↑(cuts.count ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get w.snd j) - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get w.snd j)) /
      ↑(N - b)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass._proof_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (j : Fin ↑w.fst), ↑j < K

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w =
    ∏ j : Fin ↑w.fst,
      ↑(cuts.count ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get w.snd j) - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r ⟨↑j, ⋯⟩ (List.Vector.get w.snd j)) /
        ↑(N - b)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMas.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
  (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass residual w = RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.type: {N k K b : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.value:
fun {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
    (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) =>
  ↑(N - b) * RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w = ↑(N - b) * RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean_eq
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMea.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b)
  (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
  (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
      RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean residual w = RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixPro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixProbability
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixPro.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective r.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount r j a) ∧
            ∀ (e : Fin (N - b) → Fin N),
              Function.Injective e →
                (∀ (i : Fin N), (∃ (q : Fin (N - b)), e q = i) ↔ ¬∃ (q : Fin b), r.row q = i) →
                  ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (A : ℕ → Prop),
                    RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                        (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          A (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω))
                        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) =
                      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                        fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => A (RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w η)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTai.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTails
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTai.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective r.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      t ≤
                        |↑(RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω) -
                            RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w|)
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                  2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (4 * (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w + t)))) ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                  (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω) ≤
                      RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w / 2)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w) ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                  (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω < 2)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                2 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTai.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTails_of_prefixTails
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTai.type:
RiffleLowerV2.Targets.PrefixTails →
  ∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
    b < N →
      Function.Injective r.row →
        0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
          ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K),
            (∀ (t : ℝ),
                0 < t →
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                        t ≤
                          |↑(RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω) -
                              RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w|)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                    2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (4 * (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w + t)))) ∧
              RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω) ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w / 2)
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                  Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w) ∧
                RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω < 2)
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                  2 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTra.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTransform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTra.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective r.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
        ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (s : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                  (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => s ^ RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω)
                  (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                (1 - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w +
                    RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w * s) ^
                  (N - b) ∧
              (1 - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w +
                    RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w * s) ^
                  (N - b) ≤
                Real.exp (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w * (s - 1))

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTra.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTransform_of_prefixTransform
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixTra.type:
(∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
    0 < N →
      ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (s : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                s ^ RiffleLowerV2.prefixCount w ω) ≤
              (1 - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w + RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w * s) ^ N ∧
            (1 - RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w + RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts w * s) ^ N ≤
              Real.exp (RiffleLowerV2.prefixMean cuts w * (s - 1))) →
  ∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
    b < N →
      Function.Injective r.row →
        0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) →
          ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (s : ℝ),
            0 < s →
              RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => s ^ RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixCount r w ω)
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent r) ≤
                  (1 - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w +
                      RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w * s) ^
                    (N - b) ∧
                (1 - RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w +
                      RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMass cuts r w * s) ^
                    (N - b) ≤
                  Real.exp (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.residualPrefixMean cuts r w * (s - 1))

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCou.type: {n k K : ℕ} → RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K → (Fin n → Fin K → Fin k) → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCou.value:
fun {n k K : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (rows : Fin n → Fin K → Fin k) =>
  {q : Fin n | List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.ofFn (rows q)).toList = List.Vector.toList w.snd}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCou.type:
∀ {n k K : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (rows : Fin n → Fin K → Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.rowArrayPrefixCount w rows =
    {q : Fin n | List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.ofFn (rows q)).toList = List.Vector.toList w.snd}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul_stretchedExp
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.type: ∀ (a ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → Filter.Tendsto (fun (x : ℝ) => x ^ a * Real.exp (-x ^ ε / 8)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul_stretchedExp._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.tendsto_power_mul.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningQ_bounds.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningQ_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningQ_bounds.type:
∀ {M d : ℕ},
  0 < M →
    ∀ (m : Fin d → ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), m j ≤ M) → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningTails.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningTails
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.thinningTails.type:
∀ (M d : ℕ),
  0 < M →
    ∀ (m : Fin d → ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), m j ≤ M) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
              (RiffleLowerV2.probability (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M))
                  fun (ω : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) =>
                  t ≤ |↑(RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningCount m ω) - ↑M * RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m|) ≤
                2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (4 * (↑M * RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m + t)))) ∧
          (RiffleLowerV2.probability (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M))
                fun (ω : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) =>
                ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningCount m ω) ≤ ↑M * RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m / 2) ≤
              Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * (↑M * RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m)) ∧
            (RiffleLowerV2.probability (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M))
                fun (ω : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Permutation M) => RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningCount m ω < 2) ≤
              2 * Real.exp (-(↑M * RiffleLowerV2.Targets.thinningQ M m) / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Nonempty Ω] (f : Ω → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) f = (∑ ω : Ω, f ω) / ↑(Fintype.card Ω)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect._s.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_const
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_co.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Nonempty Ω] (c : ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) fun (x : Ω) => c) = c

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_co.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_const._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_co.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α], (Fintype.card α = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_equiv
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_eq.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [inst_2 : Nonempty Ω] [inst_3 : Nonempty Γ]
  (e : Ω ≃ Γ) (f : Γ → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) fun (ω : Ω) => f (e ω)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Γ) f

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [inst_2 : Nonempty Ω] [inst_3 : Nonempty Γ]
  (f : Ω → Γ),
  (∀ (b c : Γ), Fintype.card { ω : Ω // f ω = b } = Fintype.card { ω : Ω // f ω = c }) →
    ∀ (g : Γ → ℝ),
      (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) fun (ω : Ω) => g (f ω)) =
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Γ) g

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of_equal_fibres._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_expect_of.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False
