RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_pi_expect.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_pi_expect_prod
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_pi_expect.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] {Ω : I → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : I) → Fintype (Ω i)]
  [inst_3 : ∀ (i : I), Nonempty (Ω i)] (f : (i : I) → Ω i → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((i : I) → Ω i)) fun (ω : (i : I) → Ω i) => ∏ i : I, f i (ω i)) =
    ∏ i : I, RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Ω i)) (f i)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_probabili.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_probability
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_probabili.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Nonempty Ω] (A : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) A = ↑(Fintype.card { ω : Ω // A ω }) / ↑(Fintype.card Ω)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_expect
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_e.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [inst_2 : Nonempty Ω] [inst_3 : Nonempty Γ]
  (f : Ω × Γ → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Ω × Γ)) f =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Ω) fun (a : Ω) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.expect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Γ) fun (b : Γ) => f (a, b)

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_expect._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.uniform_product_e.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : DivisionSemiring K] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a

RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.vector_take_eq_if.name: RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.vector_take_eq_iff
RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.vector_take_eq_if.type:
∀ {k d K : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ K) (v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k d),
  List.take d (List.Vector.toList v) = List.Vector.toList w ↔
    ∀ (j : Fin d), List.Vector.get v (Fin.castLE hd j) = List.Vector.get w j

RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation
RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N → (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) → Finset (Fin K) → ℝ → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
    (alpha error : ℝ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) =>
  |RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D - (∑ j ∈ I, TimeProfile.tiltedCost (cuts.profile hN j) alpha) / TimeProfile.logScale N| +
      |RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D -
          (∑ j ∈ I, TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy (cuts.profile hN j) alpha) / TimeProfile.logScale N| ≤
    error

RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.congr_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.congr_si.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I I_1 : Finset (Fin K)),
      I = I_1 →
        ∀ (alpha alpha_1 : ℝ),
          alpha = alpha_1 →
            ∀ (error error_1 : ℝ),
              error = error_1 →
                ∀ (D D_1 : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                  D = D_1 →
                    RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha error D =
                      RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts_1 hN P I_1 alpha_1 error_1 D_1

RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation.eq_1.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (alpha error : ℝ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha error D =
    (|RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D - (∑ j ∈ I, TimeProfile.tiltedCost (cuts.profile hN j) alpha) / TimeProfile.logScale N| +
        |RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D -
            (∑ j ∈ I, TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy (cuts.profile hN j) alpha) / TimeProfile.logScale N| ≤
      error)

RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec
RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N → (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) → Finset (Fin K) → ℝ → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
    (xi alpha : ℝ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) =>
  have C0 := RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D;
  have C1 := RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D;
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → D.count i l = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
          |↑(D.count i l) -
                ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l| ≤
            1) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
            0 <
              ∑ l : Fin k, if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l then TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ^ alpha else 0) ∧
          C0.Nonempty ∧
            C1.Nonempty ∧
              ↑(Finset.image (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊)
                        C0).card ≤
                  2 + ↑I.card * Real.log (1 / xi) ∧
                C0.card =
                    ∏ i : Fin P.cellCount,
                      (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i).factorial / ∏ l : Fin k, (D.count i l).factorial ∧
                  (∀ (b : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b).card ≤ C1.card) ∧
                    (∀ (b : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b).card = C1.card → D.binIndex ≤ b) ∧
                      0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D ∧
                        0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D ∧
                          ↑C1.card = ↑N ^ RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D ∧
                            (∀ x ∈ C1,
                                Real.exp (-1) * ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D) < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ∧
                                  RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D)) ∧
                              ∀ x ∈ C0, ∀ (j : ↥I), xi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I I_1 : Finset (Fin K)),
      I = I_1 →
        ∀ (xi xi_1 : ℝ),
          xi = xi_1 →
            ∀ (alpha alpha_1 : ℝ),
              alpha = alpha_1 →
                ∀ (D D_1 : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                  D = D_1 →
                    RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D =
                      RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts_1 hN P I_1 xi_1 alpha_1 D_1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ (N n : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → 0 < n → ↑n = ↑N ^ (Real.log ↑n / TimeProfile.logScale N)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Types.card_eq_rpow_log_div.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.cellPositionCount_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.cellPositionCount_eq_fiberCard

RiffleLowerV2.Types.cellPositionCount_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.cellPositionCount_le_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.cellPositionCount_le.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (i : Fin P.cellCount), RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i ≤ I.card

RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_error.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_error.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (v : Fin P.cellCount → ℝ) (f : Fin K → ℝ) (e : ℝ),
  (∀ j ∈ I, |v (P.classify (cuts.profile hN j)) - f j| ≤ e) →
    |∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * v i - ∑ j ∈ I, f j| ≤ ↑I.card * e

RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_identity.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Types.cell_sum_identity.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (v : Fin P.cellCount → ℝ),
  ∑ j ∈ I, v (P.classify (cuts.profile hN j)) =
    ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * v i

RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N →
      2 ≤ k →
        (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) →
          Finset (Fin K) → {xi : ℝ} → 0 < xi → xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P
RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi : ℝ} (hxi : 0 < xi) (hxiK : xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k)) (alpha : ℝ) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha) ⋯

RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_count
RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
  (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi : ℝ} (hxi : 0 < xi) (hxiK : xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k)) (alpha : ℝ) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData cuts hN hk P I hxi hxiK alpha).count i l =
    RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i)
      (RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i) l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_spec
RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (hk : 2 ≤ k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi C : ℝ} (hxi : 0 < xi)
      (hxiK : xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k)),
      P.IsRegular xi C →
        ∀ (alpha : ℝ),
          RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha
            (RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData cuts hN hk P I hxi hxiK alpha)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_bounds_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_bounds_of_cutoff
RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_bounds_of_.type: ∀ {p xi : ℝ}, 0 < xi → xi ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ TimeProfile.digitCost p ∧ TimeProfile.digitCost p ≤ Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.digitCost_nonneg.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) =>
  { count := fun (x : Fin P.cellCount) (x_1 : Fin k) => 0, binIndex := 0 }

RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P = { count := fun (x : Fin P.cellCount) (x_1 : Fin k) => 0, binIndex := 0 }

RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_classes_card_o.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_classes_card_one
RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_classes_card_o.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
  (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P ∅ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P)).card = 1 ∧
    (RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P ∅ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P)).card = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_exponents_zero.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_exponents_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Types.empty_exponents_zero.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
  RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P) = 0 ∧
    RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P ∅ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P) = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_eq_cost_log.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_eq_cost_log
RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_eq_cost_log.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (alpha Z : ℝ),
  0 < Z →
    ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
      (∀ (l : Fin k), q l ≠ 0 → 0 < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧ q l = TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha / Z) →
        TimeProfile.shannonEntropy q =
          alpha * ∑ l : Fin k, q l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) + Real.log Z

RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_rounding_err.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_rounding_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_rounding_err.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (c : Fin k → ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n →
    (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) →
      ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
        (∀ (l : Fin k), |↑(c l) - ↑n * q l| ≤ 1) →
          |RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx ↑n - ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx ↑(c l) -
                ↑n * TimeProfile.shannonEntropy q| ≤
            ↑k * (Real.log (↑n + 1) + 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_scale_identi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_scale_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Types.entropy_scale_identi.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) →
    ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
      ↑n * TimeProfile.shannonEntropy q =
        RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx ↑n - ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx (↑n * q l)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_maximal_index.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_maximal_indexFiber
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_maximal_index.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ),
  s.Nonempty →
    ∃ (b : ℕ), ∀ (a : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f a).card ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f b).card

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_prob_ge_inv_c.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_prob_ge_inv_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_prob_ge_inv_c.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), ∃ (l : Fin k), 1 / ↑k ≤ TimeProfile.prob p l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_supported_rou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_supported_rounding
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_supported_rou.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) →
    ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
      ∃ (c : Fin k → ℕ),
        ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n ∧ (∀ (l : Fin k), q l = 0 → c l = 0) ∧ ∀ (l : Fin k), |↑(c l) - ↑n * q l| ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_typeDataSpec.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_typeDataSpec
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_typeDataSpec.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    2 ≤ k →
      ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi C : ℝ},
        0 < xi →
          xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
            P.IsRegular xi C →
              ∀ (alpha : ℝ), ∃ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P), RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_type_partitio.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_type_partition
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exists_type_partitio.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → ∀ {xi : ℝ}, 0 < xi → xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) → ∃ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k), P.IsRegular xi 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.exp_cell_error.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.exp_cell_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.exp_cell_error.type: ∀ {xi C : ℝ}, 0 ≤ xi → xi ≤ 1 / 8 → 0 ≤ C → Real.exp (8 * C * xi) - 1 ≤ 8 * C * Real.exp C * xi

RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_remainder_bou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_remainder_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_remainder_bou.type:
∀ (k m : ℕ) {n L T B : ℝ},
  0 ≤ n →
    1 ≤ L →
      0 < T →
        0 ≤ B →
          n ≤ T * L →
            (↑k * ↑m * B + 1 + ↑m * (2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.log (n + 1) + 2) + Real.log (2 + n * B)) / L ≤
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant k m T B * (Real.log L + 1) / L

RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_type_approxim.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_type_approximation
RiffleLowerV2.Types.finite_type_approxim.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
      2 ≤ N →
        ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
          0 < xi →
            xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
              0 ≤ C →
                P.IsRegular xi C →
                  alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                    ∀ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                      RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D →
                        RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha
                          ((RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeConstant k C * ↑I.card * xi * Real.log (1 / xi) +
                                    ↑k * ↑P.cellCount * Real.log (1 / xi) +
                                  1 +
                                ↑P.cellCount * (2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.log (↑I.card + 1) + 2) +
                              Real.log (2 + ↑I.card * Real.log (1 / xi))) /
                            TimeProfile.logScale N)
                          D

RiffleLowerV2.Types.floor_image_card_bou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.floor_image_card_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Types.floor_image_card_bou.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (g : Ω → ℝ) (M : ℝ),
  0 ≤ M → (∀ x ∈ s, g x ≤ M) → ↑(Finset.image (fun (x : Ω) => ⌊g x⌋₊) s).card ≤ 2 + M

RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_le_one.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.fullPowerSum_pos.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → 0 < TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → Finset Ω → (Ω → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset Ω
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.value: fun {Ω : Type u_1} (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (b : ℕ) => {x ∈ s | f x = b}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber.eq_1.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (b : ℕ), RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f b = {x ∈ s | f x = b}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [DecidableEq Ω] {s : Finset Ω} {f : Ω → ℕ} {b : ℕ},
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f b).Nonempty ↔ b ∈ Finset.image f s

RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty..type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α}, (Finset.filter p s).Nonempty = ∃ a ∈ s, p a

RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber_nonempty..type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} {s : Finset α} {b : β},
  (b ∈ Finset.image f s) = ∃ a ∈ s, f a = b

RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N → (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) → Finset (Fin K) → ℝ → ℝ → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
    (xi alpha : ℝ) =>
  {
    count := fun (i : Fin P.cellCount) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i)
        (RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i),
    binIndex := 0 }

RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_erro.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_erro.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (xi alpha : ℝ) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
  |↑((RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha).count i l) -
        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l| ≤
    1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_none.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_none.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha)).Nonempty

RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_supp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_support
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_supp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (xi alpha : ℝ) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
  TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → (RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha).count i l = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_tota.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_total
RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData_tota.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
            ∑ l : Fin k, (RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha).count i l =
              RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq Ω] → (s : Finset Ω) → (Ω → ℕ) → s.Nonempty → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.value: fun {Ω : Type u_1} [DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty) => Nat.find ⋯

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.congr_si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin.congr_si.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {inst : DecidableEq Ω} [inst_1 : DecidableEq Ω] (s s_1 : Finset Ω) (e_s : s = s_1) (f f_1 : Ω → ℕ),
  f = f_1 → ∀ (hs : s.Nonempty), RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs = RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s_1 f_1 ⋯

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_card_bou.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_card_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_card_bou.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty),
  s.card ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).card * (Finset.image f s).card

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_log_loss.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_log_loss
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_log_loss.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty) {B : ℝ},
  0 < B →
    ↑(Finset.image f s).card ≤ B →
      0 ≤
          Real.log ↑s.card -
            Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).card ∧
        Real.log ↑s.card -
            Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).card ≤
          Real.log B

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_maximal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_maximal
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_maximal.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (b : ℕ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f b).card ≤
    (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).card

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_nonempty.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_nonempty.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).Nonempty

RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_tie.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_tie
RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin_tie.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (s : Finset Ω) (f : Ω → ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (b : ℕ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f b).card =
      (RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber s f (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs)).card →
    RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin s f hs ≤ b

RiffleLowerV2.Types.log_multinomial_quot.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.log_multinomial_quotient
RiffleLowerV2.Types.log_multinomial_quot.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (c : Fin k → ℕ),
  ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n →
    Real.log ↑(n.factorial / ∏ l : Fin k, (c l).factorial) =
      Real.log ↑n.factorial - ∑ l : Fin k, Real.log ↑(c l).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFiber
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFibe.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, 0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) →
    ∀ (b : ℕ),
      RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b =
        RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D)
          (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊) b

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFibe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFiber._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massBin_eq_indexFibe.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_cost_bounds.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_cost_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_cost_bounds.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) {xi : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        (∀ (j : ↥I), xi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N) →
          0 ≤ -Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) ∧
            -Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) ≤ ↑I.card * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_empty.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_empty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_empty.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k ∅), RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_le_one.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N → ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I), RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.massOn_pos.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {I : Finset (Fin K)} (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I),
  (∀ (j : ↥I), 0 < ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N) → 0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x

RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_entr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_entropy_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_entr.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (c : Fin k → ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n →
    (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) →
      ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
        (∀ (l : Fin k), |↑(c l) - ↑n * q l| ≤ 1) →
          |Real.log ↑n.factorial - ∑ l : Fin k, Real.log ↑(c l).factorial - ↑n * TimeProfile.shannonEntropy q| ≤
            (2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.log (↑n + 1) + 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_fact.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_factorial_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_log_fact.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (c : Fin k → ℕ),
  ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n →
    |Real.log ↑n.factorial - ∑ l : Fin k, Real.log ↑(c l).factorial -
          (RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx ↑n - ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.xlogx ↑(c l))| ≤
      (↑k + 1) * (Real.log (↑n + 1) + 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_quotient.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_quotient_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.multinomial_quotient.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (c : Fin k → ℕ), ∑ l : Fin k, c l = n → 0 < n.factorial / ∏ l : Fin k, (c l).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) =>
  ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha =
    ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_le
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_le.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
  0 ≤ xi →
    alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
      (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
        RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha ≤ 3 * ↑k * xi

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_small.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_small
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum_small.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
  0 < xi →
    xi < 1 / 8 →
      alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
        (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
          RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha ≤ 12 * ↑k * xi ^ 2 * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) =>
  ∑ l : Fin k,
    if TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi then
      -if TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l = 0 then 0
        else TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l * Real.log (TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l)
    else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bo.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / 8 →
          alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
            (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum r p xi alpha ∧
                RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum r p xi alpha ≤ 48 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi ^ 2 * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bounds._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedEntropySum_bo.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] (a : α), (a ≤ a) = True

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → Fin k → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k) =>
  if TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi then TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l =
    if TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi then TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower_nonneg.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.value: fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) => ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum r p xi alpha = ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum_le
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum_le.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
  0 ≤ xi →
    alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
      (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
        RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum r p xi alpha ≤ 9 * ↑k * xi ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_le
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_le.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 ≤ xi →
        alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
          (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
            RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha / TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha ≤ 3 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_sm.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_small
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedCost_sm.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / 8 →
          alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
            (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha / TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha ≤
                12 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi ^ 2 * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedSum_le.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedSum_le
RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedTiltedSum_le.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 ≤ xi →
        alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
          (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
            RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum r p xi alpha / TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha ≤ 9 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_card_lower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_card_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_card_lower.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → 1 ≤ ↑k ^ 4 * TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_split
RiffleLowerV2.Types.powerSum_split.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha =
    RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha + RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedSum r p xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ},
  alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
    ∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) ≤ TimeProfile.prob p l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_prob._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_le_p.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
  0 < xi →
    xi < 1 / 8 →
      alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
        ∀ (l : Fin k),
          TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi →
            TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) ≤
              12 * xi ^ 2 * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_small._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Types.power_digitCost_smal.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords.type:
{J : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} → {B : Type u_3} → [Fintype J] → [Fintype A] → [Fintype B] → (J → A) → (A → B → ℕ) → Finset (J → B)
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords.value:
fun {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [Fintype J] [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (cell : J → A) (c : A → B → ℕ) =>
  {f : J → B | ∀ (a : A) (b : B), Fintype.card { j : J // cell j = a ∧ f j = b } = c a b}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords..type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (cell : J → A) (c : A → B → ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords cell c =
    {f : J → B | ∀ (a : A) (b : B), Fintype.card { j : J // cell j = a ∧ f j = b } = c a b}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_.type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (cell : J → A) (c : A → B → ℕ),
  (∀ (a : A), ∑ b : B, c a b = Fintype.card { j : J // cell j = a }) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords cell c).card =
      ∏ a : A, (Fintype.card { j : J // cell j = a }).factorial / ∏ b : B, (c a b).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords_.type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (cell : J → A) (c : A → B → ℕ),
  (∀ (a : A), ∑ b : B, c a b = Fintype.card { j : J // cell j = a }) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords cell c).Nonempty

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.type: (J : Type u_1) → (A : Type u_2) → [Fintype J] → [Fintype A] → (A → ℕ) → Finset (J → A)
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.value:
fun (J : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [Fintype J] [Fintype A] (c : A → ℕ) =>
  {f : J → A | ∀ (a : A), Fintype.card { j : J // f j = a } = c a}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords.eq_1.type:
∀ (J : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] (c : A → ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords J A c = {f : J → A | ∀ (a : A), Fintype.card { j : J // f j = a } = c a}

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card.type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] (c : A → ℕ),
  ∑ a : A, c a = Fintype.card J →
    (RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords J A c).card = (Fintype.card J).factorial / ∏ a : A, (c a).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_card.type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] (c : A → ℕ),
  ∑ a : A, c a = Fintype.card J →
    (RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords J A c).card * ∏ a : A, (c a).factorial = (Fintype.card J).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_none.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords_none.type:
∀ {J : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype A] (c : A → ℕ),
  ∑ a : A, c a = Fintype.card J → (RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedWords J A c).Nonempty

RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) {xi C : ℝ},
  0 < xi →
    xi ≤ 1 →
      P.IsRegular xi C →
        ∀ (q : Fin P.cellCount → Fin k → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → D.count i l = 0) →
            (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → q i l = 0) →
              (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
                  |↑(D.count i l) - ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * q i l| ≤ 1) →
                ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D,
                  |-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) -
                        ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount,
                          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) *
                            ∑ l : Fin k, q i l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤
                    C * xi * ↑I.card + ↑k * ↑P.cellCount * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Semigroup G] (a b c : G), a * (b * c) = a * b * c

RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f g : ι → G),
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Types.raw_word_cost_error..type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocRing α] (a b c : α), a * c - b * c = (a - b) * c

RiffleLowerV2.Types.representativeCost_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.representativeCost_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.representativeCost_e.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          P.IsRegular xi C →
            ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
              P.classify p = i →
                |∑ l : Fin k,
                        RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l *
                          TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l) -
                      ∑ l : Fin k,
                        RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)| ≤
                  C * xi

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_bound.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_bound.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
  0 < xi →
    0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha →
      (∀ (l : Fin k), 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob r l → xi ≤ TimeProfile.prob p l) →
        0 ≤
            ∑ l : Fin k,
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) ∧
          ∑ l : Fin k,
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) ≤
            Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_cell_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_cell_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_cell_.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          0 ≤ C →
            P.IsRegular xi C →
              alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                  P.classify p = i →
                    |∑ l : Fin k,
                            RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight (P.rep i) (P.rep i) xi alpha l *
                              TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) -
                          ∑ l : Fin k,
                            RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight (P.rep i) p xi alpha l *
                              TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)| ≤
                      8 * C * Real.exp C * xi * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_eq_ra.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_eq_raw
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_eq_ra.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) =
    (∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)) /
      RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_trunc.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_truncation_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedCost_trunc.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / 8 →
          alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
            0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha →
              (∀ (l : Fin k), 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob r l → xi ≤ TimeProfile.prob p l) →
                (∀ (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob r l ≤ 2 * xi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * xi) →
                  |∑ l : Fin k,
                          RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l *
                            TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) -
                        TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha| ≤
                    18 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedEntropy_id.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedEntropy_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedEntropy_id.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha →
    (∀ (l : Fin k), 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob r l → 0 < TimeProfile.prob p l) →
      TimeProfile.shannonEntropy (RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha) =
        alpha *
            ∑ l : Fin k,
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) +
          Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedLog_rep_er.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedLog_rep_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedLog_rep_er.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
            ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
              |Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum (P.rep i) (P.rep i) xi alpha) -
                    Real.log (TimeProfile.powerSum (P.rep i) alpha)| ≤
                9 * ↑k ^ 5 * xi ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → Fin k → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k) =>
  if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob r l then TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l =
    if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob r l then TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower_nonn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower_nonn.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) =>
  ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha = ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          P.IsRegular xi C →
            ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
              P.classify p = i → 0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum (P.rep i) p xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos._p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_pos._p.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k → ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), ¬0 < k → False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_rep_ca.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_rep_card_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum_rep_ca.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (r : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi → xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) → alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → 1 ≤ ↑k ^ 4 * RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r r xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → ℝ → Fin k → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l / RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.eq_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight.eq_.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l =
    RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedPower r p xi alpha l / RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_cel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_cell_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_cel.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          0 ≤ C →
            P.IsRegular xi C →
              alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                  P.classify p = i →
                    ∀ (l : Fin k),
                      |RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight (P.rep i) (P.rep i) xi alpha l -
                            RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight (P.rep i) p xi alpha l| ≤
                        (Real.exp (8 * C * xi) - 1) * RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight (P.rep i) p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_non.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_non.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight_sum.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha →
    ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_cost_tr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_cost_transfer
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_cost_tr.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          0 ≤ C →
            P.IsRegular xi C →
              alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                  P.classify p = i →
                    |∑ l : Fin k,
                            RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l *
                              TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l) -
                          TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha| ≤
                      RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationCostConstant k C * xi * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_denomin.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_denominator_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_denomin.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
            0 < ∑ l : Fin k, if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l then TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ^ alpha else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_entropy.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_entropy_transfer
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_entropy.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi C alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          0 ≤ C →
            P.IsRegular xi C →
              alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                  P.classify p = i →
                    |TimeProfile.shannonEntropy (RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i) -
                          TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy p alpha| ≤
                      RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationEntropyConstant k C * xi * Real.log (1 / xi)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_eq_zero.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_eq_zero_of_omitted
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_eq_zero.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
  TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_le_one.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi → xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) → ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_nonneg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_nonneg.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (xi alpha : ℝ) (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
  0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_pos_of_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_pos_of_retained
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_pos_of_.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
            2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l → 0 < RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.retainedTilt_sum.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) {xi alpha : ℝ},
      0 < xi → xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) → ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant.value: fun (k m : ℕ) (T B : ℝ) => ↑k * ↑m * B + 2 + ↑m * (2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.log (T + 1) + 3) + Real.log (2 + T * B)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant_pos.type: ∀ (k m : ℕ) {T B : ℝ}, 0 < T → 0 ≤ B → 0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant k m T B

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_actual_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_actual_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_actual_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) {xi C : ℝ},
  P.IsRegular xi C →
    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → D.count i l = 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, ∀ (j : ↥I), xi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (x j)) / ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_card.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_card.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card =
      ∏ i : Fin P.cellCount,
        (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i).factorial / ∏ l : Fin k, (D.count i l).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_constru.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_constructedTypeData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_constru.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
  (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi : ℝ} (hxi : 0 < xi) (hxiK : xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k)) (alpha : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.constructedTypeData cuts hN hk P I hxi hxiK alpha) =
    RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.initialTypeData cuts hN P I xi alpha)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_empty.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_empty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_empty.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
  RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P ∅ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P) = Finset.univ

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_entropy.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_entropy_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_entropy.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (q : Fin P.cellCount → Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q i l) →
      (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, q i l = 1) →
        (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
            |↑(D.count i l) - ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * q i l| ≤ 1) →
          |Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card -
                ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount,
                  ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) * TimeProfile.shannonEntropy (q i)| ≤
            ↑P.cellCount * (2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.log (↑I.card + 1) + 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_eq_pres.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_eq_prescribedCellWords
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_eq_pres.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D =
    RiffleLowerV2.Types.prescribedCellWords (fun (j : ↥I) => P.classify (cuts.profile hN ↑j)) D.count

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_log_car.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_log_card
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_log_car.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) →
    Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card =
      ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount,
        (Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i).factorial -
          ∑ l : Fin k, Real.log ↑(D.count i l).factorial)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_nonempt.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_nonempty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_nonempt.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_selectB.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_selectBinData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedClass_selectB.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (hC : (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty),
  RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData cuts hN P I D hC) =
    RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.type: {k : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin k → ℝ) → Fin k → ℕ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (l : Fin k) =>
  ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (↑l + 1)⌋₊ - ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q ↑l⌋₊

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount n q l =
    ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (↑l + 1)⌋₊ - ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q ↑l⌋₊

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) → ∀ (l : Fin k), |↑(RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount n q l) - ↑n * q l| ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error_l.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error_lt
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_error_l.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) → ∀ (l : Fin k), |↑(RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount n q l) - ↑n * q l| < 1

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) → ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 → ∑ l : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount n q l = n

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_sum._pr.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (a : ℕ),
  ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q a⌋₊ ≤ ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (a + 1)⌋₊ →
    ¬⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q a⌋₊ +
            (⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (a + 1)⌋₊ - ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q a⌋₊) =
          ⌊RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (a + 1)⌋₊ →
      False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_zero.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_zero
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount_zero.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (l : Fin k), q l = 0 → RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundedCount n q l = 0

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.type: {k : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin k → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.value: fun {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (a : ℕ) => ∑ b ∈ Finset.range a, ↑n * RiffleLowerV2.Types.extendedWeight✝ q b

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (a : ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q a = ∑ b ∈ Finset.range a, ↑n * RiffleLowerV2.Types.extendedWeight✝ q b

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_nonne.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_nonne.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ), (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) → ∀ (a : ℕ), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q a

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_succ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_succ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_succ.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q (↑l + 1) = RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q ↑l + ↑n * q l

RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_total.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_total
RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix_total.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (q : Fin k → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 → RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundingPrefix n q k = ↑n

RiffleLowerV2.Types.rpow_neg_typeJ.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.rpow_neg_typeJ
RiffleLowerV2.Types.rpow_neg_typeJ.type:

  2 ≤ N → ∀ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P), ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D) = Real.exp (-↑D.binIndex)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) →
    (hN : 0 < N) →
      (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) →
        (I : Finset (Fin K)) →
          (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) →
            (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty → RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
    (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (hC : (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty) =>
  { count := D.count,
    binIndex :=
      RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D)
        (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊) hC }

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData_count.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData_count
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData_count.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (hC : (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty),
  (RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData cuts hN P I D hC).count = D.count

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_empty.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_empty
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_empty.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k),
  RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P ∅ (RiffleLowerV2.Types.emptyTypeData P) = Finset.univ

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_exact_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_exact_mass
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_exact_.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
      (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, 0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) →
        ∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D,
          Real.exp (-1) * ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D) < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ∧
            RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x ≤ ↑N ^ (-RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_log_lo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_log_loss
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_log_lo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
  (RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty →
    (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, 0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) →
      (∀ (b : ℕ), (RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b).card ≤ (RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).card) →
        ∀ {B : ℝ},
          0 < B →
            ↑(Finset.image (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊)
                      (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D)).card ≤
                B →
              |Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).card -
                    Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card| ≤
                Real.log B

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_select.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_selectBinData
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedClass_select.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K))
  (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (hC : (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty),
  (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, 0 < RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) →
    RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I (RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData cuts hN P I D hC) =
      RiffleLowerV2.Types.indexFiber (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D)
        (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊)
        (RiffleLowerV2.Types.leastMaxBin (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D)
          (fun (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) => ⌊-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x)⌋₊) hC)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedH_error_of_r.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedH_error_of_raw_entropy
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedH_error_of_r.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) (a e loss : ℝ),
      |Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card - a| ≤ e →
        |Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).card -
                Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card| ≤
            loss →
          |RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D - a / TimeProfile.logScale N| ≤ (e + loss) / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedJ_error_of_r.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedJ_error_of_raw_cost
RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectedJ_error_of_r.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
      (RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty →
        ∀ (a e : ℝ),
          (∀ x ∈ RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D, |-Real.log (RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts x) - a| ≤ e) →
            |RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N D - a / TimeProfile.logScale N| ≤ (e + 1) / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.Types.sum_cellPositionCoun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.sum_cellPositionCount
RiffleLowerV2.Types.sum_cellPositionCoun.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)),
  ∑ i : Fin P.cellCount, RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i = I.card

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_eq_raw.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_eq_raw
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_eq_raw.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (alpha : ℝ),
  TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha =
    (∑ l : Fin k, TimeProfile.prob p l ^ alpha * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)) /
      TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (r p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (xi alpha : ℝ),
  0 < TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha →
    0 < RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha →
      TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha =
        RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedSum r p xi alpha / TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha *
            ∑ l : Fin k,
              RiffleLowerV2.Types.restrictedWeight r p xi alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) +
          RiffleLowerV2.Types.omittedCostSum r p xi alpha / TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_10
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._simp_1_9
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedCost_split._si.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_identi.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_identi.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ},
      alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
        TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy p alpha =
          alpha * TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha + Real.log (TimeProfile.powerSum p alpha)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_term_b.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_term_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Types.tiltedEntropy_term_b.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ},
      alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
        ∀ (l : Fin k),
          (0 ≤
              -if TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l = 0 then 0
                else TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l * Real.log (TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l)) ∧
            (-if TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l = 0 then 0
                else TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l * Real.log (TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l)) ≤
              4 * (TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l))

RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationCostConsta.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationCostConstant
RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationCostConsta.value: fun (k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) => C + 8 * C * Real.exp C + 18 * ↑k ^ 5

RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationEntropyCon.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationEntropyConstant
RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationEntropyCon.value: fun (k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) => 4 * RiffleLowerV2.Types.truncationCostConstant k C + 4 * C + 9 * ↑k ^ 5
