RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeDataSpec_of_coun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeDataSpec_of_counts
RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeDataSpec_of_coun.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) {xi alpha C : ℝ},
      0 < xi →
        xi ≤ 1 →
          P.IsRegular xi C →
            (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount), ∑ l : Fin k, D.count i l = RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) →
              (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k), TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * xi → D.count i l = 0) →
                (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (l : Fin k),
                    |↑(D.count i l) -
                          ↑(RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i) *
                            RiffleLowerV2.retainedTilt P xi alpha i l| ≤
                      1) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
                      0 <
                        ∑ l : Fin k,
                          if 2 * xi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l then TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ^ alpha else 0) →
                    ∀ (hC : (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).Nonempty),
                      (RiffleLowerV2.roundedClass cuts hN P I D).card =
                          ∏ i : Fin P.cellCount,
                            (RiffleLowerV2.cellPositionCount cuts hN P I i).factorial /
                              ∏ l : Fin k, (D.count i l).factorial →
                        RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha
                          (RiffleLowerV2.Types.selectBinData cuts hN P I D hC)

RiffleLowerV2.Types.type_approximation_u.name: RiffleLowerV2.Types.type_approximation_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.Types.type_approximation_u.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
      RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeThreshold ≤ N →
        ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I : Finset (Fin K)) {xi C T alpha : ℝ},
          0 < xi →
            xi < 1 / (4 * ↑k) →
              0 ≤ C →
                0 < T →
                  P.IsRegular xi C →
                    alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
                      ↑I.card ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                        ∀ (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
                          RiffleLowerV2.TypeDataSpec cuts hN P I xi alpha D →
                            RiffleLowerV2.TypeApproximation cuts hN P I alpha
                              (RiffleLowerV2.Types.typeConstant k C * T * xi * Real.log (1 / xi) +
                                RiffleLowerV2.Types.roundConstant k P.cellCount T (Real.log (1 / xi)) *
                                    (Real.log (TimeProfile.logScale N) + 1) /
                                  TimeProfile.logScale N)
                              D

RiffleLowerV2.Types.word_sum_identity.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.cold_identity.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.cold_identity
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.cold_identity.type:
∀ (b theta jp jt hp ht bp bt : ℝ),
  hp = theta * jp - bp →
    ht = 2 * jt - bt →
      2 * (2 * b - 2 * jp - 2 * jt + hp + ht) - (b - jp + hp) =
        (theta + 3) / 2 * b - bp - 2 * bt + (theta - 3) * (jp - b / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.continuousWitness.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.continuousWitness
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.continuousWitness.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta : ℝ},
        0 < eta →
          eta ≤ RiffleLowerV2.lambda1 cuts hN →
            ∃ (s : ℝ) (u : ℝ) (theta : ℝ),
              (s, u) ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) ∧
                theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 ∧
                  eta / 4 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s ∧
                    RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN theta s u ≤ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧
                      (theta = 3 ∨
                          RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN theta s u =
                            RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) ∧
                        7 * eta / 8 - 16 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ RiffleLowerV2.F cuts hN theta s u

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_const._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_const._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_const._simp_1_9
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_endpoint_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {f : Fin K → ℝ} {M r s r' s' : ℝ},
      (∀ (j : Fin K), |f j| ≤ M) →
        r ∈ Set.Icc 0 (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) →
          s ∈ Set.Icc 0 (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) →
            r' ∈ Set.Icc 0 (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) →
              s' ∈ Set.Icc 0 (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) →
                |RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s - RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r' s'| ≤
                  (|r - r'| + |s - s'|) * M

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_le
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {f : Fin K → ℝ} {M r s : ℝ},
      (∀ (j : Fin K), f j ≤ M) →
        0 ≤ r → r ≤ s → s ≤ RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K → RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s ≤ (s - r) * M

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_linear
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ} (f g : Fin K → ℝ) (a r s : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N (fun (j : Fin K) => a * f j - g j) r s =
    a * RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s - RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N g r s

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_linear._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f g : ι → G),
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x - ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x - g x)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_mono
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ {f g : Fin K → ℝ},
      (∀ (j : Fin K), f j ≤ g j) →
        ∀ {r s : ℝ}, r ≤ s → RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s ≤ RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N g r s

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N → ∀ {f : Fin K → ℝ}, (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 ≤ f j) → ∀ {r s : ℝ}, r ≤ s → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_swap
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.empiricalIntegral_.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ} (f : Fin K → ℝ) (r s : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f s r = -RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.endpoint_error_alg.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.endpoint_error_algebra
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.endpoint_error_alg.type:
∀ {theta b b0 j j0 bp bp0 bt bt0 r e : ℝ},
  theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 →
    0 ≤ r →
      0 ≤ e →
        |b - b0| ≤ e →
          |j - j0| ≤ r + 3 * e →
            |bp - bp0| ≤ 3 * (r + 3 * e) →
              |bt - bt0| ≤ r + 2 * e →
                |j - b / 2 - (j0 - b0 / 2)| ≤ r + 4 * e ∧
                  |(theta + 3) / 2 * b - bp - 2 * bt - ((theta + 3) / 2 * b0 - bp0 - 2 * bt0)| ≤ 5 * r + 20 * e

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
  TimeProfile.shannonEntropy (TimeProfile.prob p) =
    ∑ l : Fin k, TimeProfile.prob p l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost._s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_cost._s.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),
  -∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, -f x

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (q : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ q l) →
    ∑ l : Fin k, q l = 1 →
      TimeProfile.shannonEntropy q = ∑ l : Fin k, if 0 < q l then q l * Real.log ((∑ i : Fin k, q i) / q l) else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.entropy_eq_gibbs._.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_5} {s : Finset ι} [inst : SubtractionCommMonoid G] (f : ι → G),

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt.type: ∀ (B : ℝ), ∃ (N0 : ℕ), 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ), N0 ≤ N → B < TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_gt.type: ∀ (n N : ℕ), max 2 n ≤ N → n ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_th.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_threshold
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.exists_logScale_th.type: ∀ (B epsilon : ℝ), 0 < epsilon → ∃ (N0 : ℕ), 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ), N0 ≤ N → B / TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ epsilon / 16

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.final_margins.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.final_margins
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.final_margins.type:
∀ {eta b theta jp jt hp ht bp bt : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 →
      0 ≤ jp →
        0 ≤ hp →
          hp ≤ jp →
            jp ≤ b / 2 - 3 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta →
              theta = 3 ∨ b / 2 - 5 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ jp →
                eta / 2 ≤ (theta + 3) / 2 * b - bp - 2 * bt →
                  hp = theta * jp - bp →
                    ht = 2 * jt - bt →
                      RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ b - jp + hp ∧
                        hp ≤ b - jp - RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧
                          RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ 2 * b - 2 * jp - 2 * jt + hp + ht - (b - jp + hp) / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (c : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ c l) →
    ∀ {theta : ℝ},
      1 ≤ theta →
        (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 < c l → 0 < TimeProfile.prob p l) →
          (∑ l : Fin k, if 0 < c l then c l * Real.log ((∑ i : Fin k, c i) / c l) else 0) ≤
            theta * ∑ l : Fin k, c l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) +
              (∑ l : Fin k, c l) * Real.log (TimeProfile.powerSum p theta)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_10
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Preorder α] (x : α), (x < x) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp_1_9
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.finite_gibbs._simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_columns
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.type:
∀ {k N K mu : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {rho chi density T : ℝ},
  0 < TimeProfile.logScale N →
    0 < rho →
      mu + ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ ≤ K →
        RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K ≤ T →
          3 < density * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N →
            TimeProfile.LocalGood cuts hN chi density rho 0 T →
              ∃ (gL : Fin K) (gR : Fin K),
                mu ≤ ↑gL ∧
                  ↑gL < ↑gR ∧
                    ↑gR < mu + ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ ∧
                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN gL) chi ∧ TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN gR) chi

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_columns._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.type: ∀ {k N K mu : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K), 0 < N → ∀ {rho chi : ℝ} (j : Fin K), mu < ↑j + 1 → ¬mu ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_columns._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.good_bridge_column.type:
∀ {k N K mu : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ {rho : ℝ} {chi : ℝ} (j : Fin K),
      ↑j + 1 ≤ mu + ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ → ¬↑j < mu + ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_bounds.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_bounds.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ TimeProfile.maxCost p ∧ TimeProfile.maxCost p ≤ Real.log ↑k

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_le_tiltedC.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_le_tiltedCost
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.maxCost_le_tiltedC.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, 1 ≤ alpha → TimeProfile.maxCost p ≤ TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_le_one.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_le_one
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_le_one.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {theta : ℝ}, theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → TimeProfile.powerSum p theta ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_pos.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_pos
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.powerSum_pos.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {theta : ℝ}, 1 ≤ theta → 0 < TimeProfile.powerSum p theta

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_bounds.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_bounds.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {theta : ℝ},
      theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → 0 ≤ TimeProfile.psi p theta ∧ TimeProfile.psi p theta ≤ 4 * Real.log ↑k

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_four_ge_two.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_four_ge_two
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_four_ge_two.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 2 * TimeProfile.psi p 2 ≤ TimeProfile.psi p 4

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_sharp_bounds.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_sharp_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_sharp_bounds.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ},
      alpha ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 → 0 ≤ TimeProfile.psi p alpha ∧ TimeProfile.psi p alpha ≤ (alpha - 1) * Real.log ↑k

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_two_le_maxCost.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_two_le_maxCost
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.psi_two_le_maxCost.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), TimeProfile.psi p 2 ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.maxCost p

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi density T s0 u0 theta : ℝ},
        0 < eta →
          0 < rho →
            2 * rho * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 100 →
              Real.log ↑k / TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 1000 →
                RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K ≤ T →
                  3 < density * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                    TimeProfile.LocalGood cuts hN chi density rho 0 T →
                      RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) < RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta →
                        (s0, u0) ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K) →
                          theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 →
                            eta / 4 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s0 →
                              RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN theta s0 u0 ≤
                                  RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s0 / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta →
                                theta = 3 ∨
                                    RiffleLowerV2.J cuts hN theta s0 u0 =
                                      RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN s0 / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta →
                                  7 * eta / 8 - 16 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ RiffleLowerV2.F cuts hN theta s0 u0 →
                                    ∃ (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData),
                                      RiffleLowerV2.WitnessSpec cuts hN eta rho chi W

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness._proo.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness._proof_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.roundWitness._proo.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {N K : ℕ} {rho : ℝ} {s0 : ℝ} {u0 : ℝ},
  min ⌊u0 * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ (K - ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊) + ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊ ≤
      K →
    ¬min ⌊u0 * TimeProfile.logScale N⌋₊ (K - ⌈2 * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N⌉₊) ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {L rho s u : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 < rho →
      0 ≤ s →
        s ≤ u →
          u ≤ ↑K / L →
            s + 2 * rho + 2 / L < ↑K / L →
              have b := ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊;
              have ms := ⌊s * L⌋₊;
              have mu := min ⌊u * L⌋₊ (K - b);
              ms ≤ mu ∧
                mu + b ≤ K ∧ 0 ≤ s - ↑ms / L ∧ s - ↑ms / L < 1 / L ∧ 0 ≤ u - ↑mu / L ∧ u - ↑mu / L ≤ 2 * rho + 2 / L

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {L rho s : ℝ}, ⌊s * L⌋₊ + ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → ¬⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {L rho s : ℝ}, ⌊s * L⌋₊ + ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → ¬⌊s * L⌋₊ ≤ K - ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounded_indices._p.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} {L rho : ℝ} {s : ℝ} {u : ℝ},
  ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → ¬min ⌊u * L⌋₊ (K - ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊) + ⌈2 * rho * L⌉₊ ≤ K → False

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_margins.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_margins
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_margins.type:
∀ {eta theta j0 b0 f0 j b f : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    j0 ≤ b0 / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta →
      theta = 3 ∨ j0 = b0 / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta →
        7 * eta / 8 - 16 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ f0 →
          |j - b / 2 - (j0 - b0 / 2)| ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 10 →
            |f - f0| ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 10 →
              eta / 2 ≤ f ∧
                j ≤ b / 2 - 3 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧ (theta = 3 ∨ b / 2 - 5 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ j)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_terminal_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_terminal_clearance
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.rounding_terminal_.type:
∀ {S s rho eta ell L b betaS Aend : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    0 < ell →
      0 < L →
        eta / 4 ≤ b →
          betaS < RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta →
            Aend = b - betaS →
              Aend ≤ (S - s) * ell →
                2 * rho * ell ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 100 →
                  ell / L ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 400 → s + 2 * rho + 2 / L < S

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.select_tilt.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.select_tilt
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.select_tilt.type:
∀ (j : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
  ContinuousOn j (Set.Icc 3 4) → ∃ theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, (theta = 3 ∨ c ≤ j theta) ∧ (theta = 4 ∨ j theta ≤ c)

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_log
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), TimeProfile.shannonEntropy (TimeProfile.prob p) ≤ Real.log ↑k

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_log._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shannonEntropy_le_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shorten_selection.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shorten_selection
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.shorten_selection.type:
∀ (j f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (s u b eta : ℝ),
  0 < eta →
    s ≤ u →
      eta / 4 ≤ b →
        ContinuousOn (fun (a : ℝ) => j a u) (Set.Icc 3 4) →
          (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, ContinuousOn (j a) (Set.Icc s u)) →
            (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, j a s = 0) →
              (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, 7 * eta / 8 ≤ f a u) →
                (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc s u, -4 * (j a u - j a v) ≤ f a v - f a u) →
                  (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc s u, f 4 u ≤ f 4 v) →
                    ∃ theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4,
                      ∃ v ∈ Set.Icc s u,
                        j theta v ≤ b / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ∧
                          (theta = 3 ∨ j theta v = b / 2 - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta) ∧
                            7 * eta / 8 - 16 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta ≤ f theta v

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, 1 ≤ alpha → ∑ l : Fin k, TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p alpha l = 1

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight._.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.sum_tiltedWeight._.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.terminal_clearance.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.terminal_clearance
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.terminal_clearance.type:
∀ {s S rb eta M L b betaS : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    0 < M →
      0 < L →
        eta / 4 ≤ b →
          betaS < RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta →
            b - betaS ≤ (S - s) * M →
              rb * M ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 100 → M / L ≤ RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 1000 → s + rb + 2 / L < S

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.tiltedCost_eq_sum.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.tiltedCost_eq_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.tiltedCost_eq_sum.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.tiltedCost_nonneg.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {alpha : ℝ}, 1 ≤ alpha → 0 ≤ TimeProfile.tiltedCost p alpha

RiffleLowerV2.Witness.variational_pair.name: RiffleLowerV2.Witness.variational_pair
RiffleLowerV2.Witness.variational_pair.type:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (T eta M : ℝ),
  0 ≤ T →
    0 < eta →
      (∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle T, ContinuousOn (fun (a : ℝ) => f a su.1 su.2) (Set.Icc 3 4)) →
        (∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle T, f 3 su.1 su.2 ≤ M) →
          eta ≤
              sSup
                ((fun (su : ℝ × ℝ) => sInf ((fun (a : ℝ) => f a su.1 su.2) '' Set.Icc 3 4)) ''
                  RiffleLowerV2.triangle T) →
            ∃ (s : ℝ) (u : ℝ), (s, u) ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle T ∧ ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, 7 * eta / 8 ≤ f a s u

RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount.value:

RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount.eq_1.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (W : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),

RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent.type: {N k K : ℕ} → {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → Prop
RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent.value:

∀ {N k K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),

RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.type: {K : ℕ} → ℕ → Fin K → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.value: fun {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (j : Fin K) (t : ℝ) => max 0 (min 1 (t * TimeProfile.logScale N - ↑↑j))

RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction.eq_1.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (j : Fin K) (t : ℝ),

RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},

RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {N : ℕ} (j : Fin K) (m : ℕ), ↑j < m → ¬↑j + 1 ≤ m → False

RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction_grid._proof.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} {N : ℕ} (j : Fin K) (m : ℕ), ¬↑j < m → ¬m ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.columnSet.value: fun (K a b : ℕ) => {j : Fin K | a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b}

RiffleLowerV2.columnSet.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.columnSet.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.columnSet.eq_1.type: ∀ (K a b : ℕ), RiffleLowerV2.columnSet K a b = {j : Fin K | a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b}

RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex.value: fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (i : Fin N) => {e : Fin (N - 1) | ↑e < ↑i ∧ e ∉ G}.card

RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (i : Fin N),

RiffleLowerV2.componentSort.value:
fun {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>

RiffleLowerV2.componentSort.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.componentSort.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.componentSort.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N) (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentSort G π =
    Equiv.trans (Tuple.sort fun (i : Fin N) => toLex (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i, π i)) π

RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.name: RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect
RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → ℝ) → (Ω → Prop) → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.value:
fun {Ω : Type u_1} [Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (B : Ω → Prop) =>
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if B ω then f ω else 0) / RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect.eq_1.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (B : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect P f B =
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if B ω then f ω else 0) / RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability.name: RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability
RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → Prop) → (Ω → Prop) → ℝ

fun {Ω : Type u_1} [Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop) =>
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) / RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.type: {K : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin K → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.value:
fun {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (f : Fin K → ℝ) (r s : ℝ) =>
  ∑ j : Fin K, (RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction N j s - RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction N j r) * f j / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral.eq_1.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (f : Fin K → ℝ) (r s : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s =
    ∑ j : Fin K,
      (RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction N j s - RiffleLowerV2.columnFraction N j r) * f j / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (f : Fin K → ℝ) (r s t : ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r t =
    RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r s + RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f s t

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add._sim.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_add._sim.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f g : ι → M},
  ∑ x ∈ s, f x + ∑ x ∈ s, g x = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x + g x)

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_grid.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_grid
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_grid.type:
∀ {K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (f : Fin K → ℝ) (a b : ℕ),
      a ≤ b →
        RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N a) (RiffleLowerV2.gridTime N b) =
          RiffleLowerV2.gridSum N f a b

RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_self.name: RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_self
RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral_self.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (f : Fin K → ℝ) (r : ℝ), RiffleLowerV2.empiricalIntegral N f r r = 0

RiffleLowerV2.emptyPrefix_mass.name: RiffleLowerV2.emptyPrefix_mass
RiffleLowerV2.emptyPrefix_mass.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K), RiffleLowerV2.prefixMass cuts ⟨⟨0, ⋯⟩, RiffleShuffle.emptyWord k⟩ = 1

RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.name: RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial
RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.type: {N k K d : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → (Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.value:
fun {N k K d : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.falling N (∑ i : Fin d, r i) *
    ∏ j : Fin K,
      (∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) (RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a)) /
        RiffleLowerV2.falling N (∑ i : Fin d, r i)

RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial.eq_1.type:
∀ {N k K d : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ),
  RiffleLowerV2.exactFactorial cuts w r =
    RiffleLowerV2.falling N (∑ i : Fin d, r i) *
      ∏ j : Fin K,
        (∏ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) (RiffleLowerV2.requestedCount w r j a)) /
          RiffleLowerV2.falling N (∑ i : Fin d, r i)

RiffleLowerV2.expect.name: RiffleLowerV2.expect
RiffleLowerV2.expect.type: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → ℝ) → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.expect.value: fun {Ω : Type u_1} [Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) => ∑ ω : Ω, (P ω).toReal * f ω

RiffleLowerV2.expect.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.expect.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.expect.eq_1.type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), RiffleLowerV2.expect P f = ∑ ω : Ω, (P ω).toReal * f ω

RiffleLowerV2.expect_eq_integral.name: RiffleLowerV2.expect_eq_integral
RiffleLowerV2.expect_eq_integral.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect P f = ∫ (ω : Ω), f ω ∂P.toMeasure

RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.name: RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct
RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.type:
{N k K d : ℕ} →
  {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} → (Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) → (Fin d → ℕ) → RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.value:
fun {N k K d : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : Fin d → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (r : Fin d → ℕ)

RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.factorialProduct.eq_1.type:

RiffleLowerV2.falling.eq_1.type: ∀ (n r : ℕ), RiffleLowerV2.falling n r = ↑(n.descFactorial r)

RiffleLowerV2.fixed_expect_eq_average.name: RiffleLowerV2.fixed_expect_eq_average
RiffleLowerV2.fixed_expect_eq_average.type:

RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix.value: fun {k K : ℕ} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) => ⟨Fin.last K, w⟩

RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP.type:

RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.beta cuts hN (W.s N) - RiffleLowerV2.typeJ N G.prefixType

RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData)
      (G G_1 : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      G = G_1 → RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G = RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts_1 hN P W G_1

RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryG
RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N →
      (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) →
        (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) → RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  2 * RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ cuts hN P W G +
      RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType +
    RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) G.tailType

RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.geometryG.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),

      (G G_1 : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      G = G_1 → RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G = RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts_1 hN P W G_1

{k N K : ℕ} →

        (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) → RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.geometryH.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>
  RiffleLowerV2.geometryEllP cuts hN P W G +
    RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) G.prefixType

RiffleLowerV2.geometryH.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryH.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.geometryH.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →

      (G G_1 : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      G = G_1 → RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts hN P W G = RiffleLowerV2.geometryH cuts_1 hN P W G_1

RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ
RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ.type:
{k N K : ℕ} →
  TimeProfile.Cuts k N K →
    0 < N →
      (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) →
        (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) → RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W → ℝ
RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
    (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) =>

RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.geometryZ.congr_simp

∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),

RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.name: RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord
RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.type:
{k K : ℕ} →
  {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} →
    {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData} →
      RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W →
        RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W) →
          RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W) →
            RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W) → RiffleLowerV2.Word k K
RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
    (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
    (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
    (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)) =>
  List.Vector.ofFn fun (j : Fin K) =>
    if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W then x ⟨j, hj⟩
    else
      if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W then v ⟨j, hj⟩
      else if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W then z ⟨j, hj⟩ else List.Vector.get G.ambient j

RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord.eq_1.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData}
  (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W) (x : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W))
  (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W))
  (z : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k (RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W)),
  RiffleLowerV2.joinColdWord G x v z =
    List.Vector.ofFn fun (j : Fin K) =>
      if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.prefixColumns K W then x ⟨j, hj⟩
      else
        if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.bridgeColumns K W then v ⟨j, hj⟩
        else if hj : j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.tailColumns K W then z ⟨j, hj⟩ else List.Vector.get G.ambient j

      D = D_1 →
        ∀ (b b_1 : ℕ), b = b_1 → RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts hN P I D b = RiffleLowerV2.massBin cuts_1 hN P I D_1 b_1

RiffleLowerV2.typeH.name: RiffleLowerV2.typeH
RiffleLowerV2.typeH.type:

RiffleLowerV2.typeH.value:

  Real.log ↑(RiffleLowerV2.selectedClass cuts hN P I D).card / TimeProfile.logScale N

RiffleLowerV2.typeH.congr_simp.name: RiffleLowerV2.typeH.congr_simp
RiffleLowerV2.typeH.congr_simp.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts cuts_1 : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  cuts = cuts_1 →
    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (I I_1 : Finset (Fin K)),
      I = I_1 →
        ∀ (D D_1 : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P),
          D = D_1 → RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts hN P I D = RiffleLowerV2.typeH cuts_1 hN P I_1 D_1

RiffleLowerV2.typeJ.name: RiffleLowerV2.typeJ

fun {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} (N : ℕ) (D : RiffleLowerV2.RoundedTypeData P) =>

RiffleLowerV2.typeJ.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.typeJ.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.typeJ.eq_1.type:

RiffleLowerV2.upperRank.name: RiffleLowerV2.upperRank

RiffleLowerV2.upperRank.value:

  {i : Fin N | List.take (↑w.fst) (List.Vector.toList (RiffleLowerV2.rowWord ω i)) ≤ List.Vector.toList w.snd}.card

RiffleLowerV2.usedCount.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.usedCount.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.usedCount.eq_1.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (r : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k),

RiffleLowerV2.variance.eq_1.name: RiffleLowerV2.variance.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.variance.eq_1.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),

RiffleShuffle.FullWord.value: fun {N k K : ℕ} (P : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) => { x : RiffleShuffle.Word k K // RiffleShuffle.Legal P x }

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_1.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_1
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_1.type: {N k K : ℕ} → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K → ℕ
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_1.value:

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_inst.type: (N k K : ℕ) → SizeOf (RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K)
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile._sizeOf_inst.value: fun (N k K : ℕ) => { sizeOf := fun (m : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) => m._sizeOf_1 }

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.casesOn.type:
{N k K : ℕ} →

            (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k) →
              (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N) →
                motive { count := count, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := total }) →
        motive t
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.casesOn.value:
fun {N k K : ℕ} {motive : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K → Sort u} (t : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K)
    (mk :
      (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) →
        (deck_pos : 0 < N) →
          (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k) →
            (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N) →
              motive { count := count, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := total }) =>
  RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.rec
    (fun (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (deck_pos : 0 < N) (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k)
        (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N) =>
      mk count deck_pos alphabet_two total)
    t

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.count.type: {N k K : ℕ} → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K → Fin K → Fin k → ℕ
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.count.value: fun (N k K : ℕ) (self : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) => self.1

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt.value: fun {N k K : ℕ} (P : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) (j : ℕ) (a : Fin k) => if h : j < K then P.count ⟨j, h⟩ a else 0

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt.eq_1.type:

  P.countAt j a = if h : j < K then P.count ⟨j, h⟩ a else 0

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt_of_ge.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt_of_ge
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt_of_ge.type: ∀ {N k K : ℕ} (P : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) (j : ℕ) (a : Fin k), K ≤ j → P.countAt j a = 0

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt_of_lt.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.countAt_of_lt

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.ctorIdx.value: fun {N k K : ℕ} (x : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K) => 0

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.deck_pos.type: ∀ {N k K : ℕ} (self : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K), 0 < N

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.congr_simp.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.congr_simp
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.congr_simp.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (count count_1 : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (e_count : count = count_1) (deck_pos : 0 < N) (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k)
  (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N),
  { count := count, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := total } =
    { count := count_1, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := ⋯ }

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.inj.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.inj

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.injEq.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.injEq
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (deck_pos : 0 < N) (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k)
  (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N) (count_1 : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (deck_pos_1 : 0 < N)
  (alphabet_two_1 : 2 ≤ k) (total_1 : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count_1 j a = N),

      { count := count_1, deck_pos := deck_pos_1, alphabet_two := alphabet_two_1, total := total_1 }) =

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.noConfusion.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.noConfusion
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.noConfusion.type:
{N k K : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ} →
      {deck_pos : 0 < N} →
        {alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k} →
          {total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N} →
            {count' : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ} →
              {deck_pos' : 0 < N} →
                {alphabet_two' : 2 ≤ k} →
                  {total' : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count' j a = N} →
                    { count := count, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := total } =
                        { count := count', deck_pos := deck_pos', alphabet_two := alphabet_two', total := total' } →
                      (count ≍ count' → P) → P

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.sizeOf_spec
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.mk.sizeOf_spec.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (deck_pos : 0 < N) (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k)
  (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N),
  sizeOf { count := count, deck_pos := deck_pos, alphabet_two := alphabet_two, total := total } =
    1 + sizeOf deck_pos + sizeOf alphabet_two

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusion.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusion
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {N k K : ℕ} →
    {t : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} →
      {N' k' K' : ℕ} →
        {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} →
          N = N' → k = k' → K = K' → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionType P t t'
RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusion.value:
fun {P : Sort u} {N k K : ℕ} {t : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} {N' k' K' : ℕ}
    {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} (eq_1 : N = N') (eq_2 : k = k') (eq_3 : K = K') (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {N' : ℕ} =>
    {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionType P t t')
    (fun {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k' K'} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {k' : ℕ} =>
        {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k' K'} → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionType P t t')
        (fun {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K'} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {K' : ℕ} =>
            {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K'} → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionType P t t')
            (fun {t' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
              ⋯ ▸
                RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.casesOn t
                  fun (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (deck_pos : 0 < N) (alphabet_two : 2 ≤ k)
                    (total : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ a : Fin k, count j a = N) (k_1 : count ≍ count → P) =>
                  k_1 ⋯)
            eq_3 eq_4)
        eq_2 eq_4)
    eq_1 eq_4

RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionTyp.name: RiffleShuffle.PileProfile.noConfusionType

RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusion.name: RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusion
RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {N k K : ℕ} →
    {P_1 : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} →
      {t : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P_1} →
        {N' k' K' : ℕ} →
          {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} →
            {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} →
              N = N' → k = k' → K = K' → P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType P t t'
RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusion.value:
fun {P : Sort u} {N k K : ℕ} {P_1 : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} {t : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P_1}
    {N' k' K' : ℕ} {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} (eq_1 : N = N')
    (eq_2 : k = k') (eq_3 : K = K') (eq_4 : P_1 ≍ P') (eq_5 : t ≍ t') =>
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {N' : ℕ} =>
    {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N' k' K'} →
      {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} → P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType P t t')
    (fun {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k' K'} {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} (eq_4 : P_1 ≍ P')
        (eq_5 : t ≍ t') =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {k' : ℕ} =>
        {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k' K'} →
          {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} →
            P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType P t t')
        (fun {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K'} {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} (eq_4 : P_1 ≍ P')
            (eq_5 : t ≍ t') =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {K' : ℕ} =>
            {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K'} →
              {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} →
                P_1 ≍ P' → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType P t t')
            (fun {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} (eq_4 : P_1 ≍ P')
                (eq_5 : t ≍ t') =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {P' : RiffleShuffle.PileProfile N k K} =>
                {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P'} → t ≍ t' → RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType P t t')
                (fun {t' : RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix P_1} (eq_5 : t ≍ t') =>
                  ⋯ ▸
                    RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.casesOn t
                      fun (rows : Fin N → RiffleShuffle.Word k K)
                        (column_count :
                          ∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), {i : Fin N | List.Vector.get (rows i) j = a}.card = P_1.count j a)
                        (k_1 : rows ≍ rows → P) =>
                      k_1 ⋯)
                ⋯ eq_5)
            eq_3 eq_4 eq_5)
        eq_2 eq_4 eq_5)
    eq_1 eq_4 eq_5

RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionT.name: RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionType
RiffleShuffle.ShuffleMatrix.noConfusionT.type:

TimeProfile.AlmostLike.name: TimeProfile.AlmostLike
TimeProfile.AlmostLike.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → 0 < N → TimeProfile.TimeLaw k → TimeProfile.BorelPartition k → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop
TimeProfile.AlmostLike.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k)
    (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (T rho phi : ℝ) =>
  ∀ (a : ℝ),
    (∃ (z : ℤ), a = rho * ↑z) →
      0 ≤ a →
        a < min (a + rho) T →
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount),
            |↑(TimeProfile.intervalCount cuts hN P a (min (a + rho) T) i) / TimeProfile.logScale N -
                  ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..min (a + rho) T, TimeProfile.cellMass mu P i t| ≤
              phi * (min (a + rho) T - a) + 1 / TimeProfile.logScale N

TimeProfile.AmbientApproximation.name: TimeProfile.AmbientApproximation
TimeProfile.AmbientApproximation.type: {k K : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) → (Fin K → Fin k) → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop
TimeProfile.AmbientApproximation.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (w : ℕ) (r b eTime eMass : ℝ) =>
  |↑w / TimeProfile.logScale N - r| ≤ eTime ∧
    |Real.log (TimeProfile.prefixMass N p x w) / TimeProfile.logScale N - b| ≤ eMass

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsGoodDigit.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (chi : ℝ) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k) =>
  2 * chi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep (P.classify p)) l

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.BorelPartition k → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.cas.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.casesOn
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.cas.type:
{k : ℕ} →
  {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} →
    {chi C : ℝ} →
      {motive : P.IsRegular chi C → Sort u} →
        (t : P.IsRegular chi C) →
          ((psi_oscillation :
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                  P.classify p = i →
                    P.classify p' = i →
                      ∀ theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4, |TimeProfile.psi p theta - TimeProfile.psi p' theta| ≤ C * chi) →
              (maxCost_oscillation :
                  ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
                    P.classify p = i → P.classify p' = i → |TimeProfile.maxCost p - TimeProfile.maxCost p'| ≤ C * chi) →
                (good_digit :
                    ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
                      P.classify p = i →
                        2 * chi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l →
                          chi < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧
                            |TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) -
                                  TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤
                              C * chi) →
                  (exceptional_digit :
                      ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
                        P.classify p = i → TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * chi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * chi) →
                    motive ⋯) →
            motive t
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.cas.value:
fun {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ} {motive : P.IsRegular chi C → Sort u} (t : P.IsRegular chi C)
    (mk :
      (psi_oscillation :
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
            P.classify p = i →
              P.classify p' = i →
                ∀ theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4, |TimeProfile.psi p theta - TimeProfile.psi p' theta| ≤ C * chi) →
        (maxCost_oscillation :
            ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
              P.classify p = i → P.classify p' = i → |TimeProfile.maxCost p - TimeProfile.maxCost p'| ≤ C * chi) →
          (good_digit :
              ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
                P.classify p = i →
                  2 * chi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l →
                    chi < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧
                      |TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) -
                            TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤
                        C * chi) →
            (exceptional_digit :
                ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
                  P.classify p = i → TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * chi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * chi) →
              motive ⋯) =>
  TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.rec
    (fun
        (psi_oscillation :
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
            P.classify p = i →
              P.classify p' = i → ∀ theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4, |TimeProfile.psi p theta - TimeProfile.psi p' theta| ≤ C * chi)
        (maxCost_oscillation :
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
            P.classify p = i → P.classify p' = i → |TimeProfile.maxCost p - TimeProfile.maxCost p'| ≤ C * chi)
        (good_digit :
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
            P.classify p = i →
              2 * chi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l →
                chi < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧
                  |TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) -
                        TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤
                    C * chi)
        (exceptional_digit :
          ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
            P.classify p = i → TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * chi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * chi) =>
      mk psi_oscillation maxCost_oscillation good_digit exceptional_digit)
    t

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.exc.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.exceptional_actual_le
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.exc.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},
  P.IsRegular chi C → ∀ {p : TimeProfile.Simplex k} {l : Fin k}, ¬P.IsGoodDigit chi p l → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * chi

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.goo.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.good_digit
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.goo.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},

    ∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),

          chi < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧
            |TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) - TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.goo.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.good_digitCost_error
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.goo.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},

        P.IsGoodDigit chi p l →

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.max.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.maxCost_oscillation
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.max.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.max.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.maxCost_rep_error
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.max.type:

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk.name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
      P.classify p = i →
        P.classify p' = i → ∀ theta ∈ Set.Icc 2 4, |TimeProfile.psi p theta - TimeProfile.psi p' theta| ≤ C * chi) →
    (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p p' : TimeProfile.Simplex k),
        P.classify p = i → P.classify p' = i → |TimeProfile.maxCost p - TimeProfile.maxCost p'| ≤ C * chi) →
      (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
          P.classify p = i →
            2 * chi < TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l →
              chi < TimeProfile.prob p l ∧
                |TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) - TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l)| ≤
                  C * chi) →
        (∀ (i : Fin P.cellCount) (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (l : Fin k),
            P.classify p = i → TimeProfile.prob (P.rep i) l ≤ 2 * chi → TimeProfile.prob p l ≤ 3 * chi) →
          P.IsRegular chi C

TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk..name: TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk._flat_ctor
TimeProfile.BorelPartition.IsRegular.mk..type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {chi C : ℝ},

TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusion.name: TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusion
TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusion.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {k N K : ℕ} →
    {t : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} →
      {k' N' K' : ℕ} →
        {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k' N' K'} → k = k' → N = N' → K = K' → t ≍ t' → TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType P t t'
TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusion.value:
fun {P : Sort u} {k N K : ℕ} {t : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} {k' N' K' : ℕ} {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k' N' K'}
    (eq_1 : k = k') (eq_2 : N = N') (eq_3 : K = K') (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {k' : ℕ} =>
    {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k' N' K'} → t ≍ t' → TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType P t t')
    (fun {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k N' K'} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {N' : ℕ} =>
        {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k N' K'} → t ≍ t' → TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType P t t')
        (fun {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K'} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {K' : ℕ} =>
            {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K'} → t ≍ t' → TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType P t t')
            (fun {t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (eq_4 : t ≍ t') =>
              ⋯ ▸
                TimeProfile.Cuts.casesOn t
                  fun (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (sum_count : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ l : Fin k, count j l = N)
                    (k_1 : count ≍ count → P) =>
                  k_1 ⋯)
            eq_3 eq_4)
        eq_2 eq_4)
    eq_1 eq_4

TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType.name: TimeProfile.Cuts.noConfusionType

fun (P : Sort u) {k N K : ℕ} (t : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {k' N' K' : ℕ} (t' : TimeProfile.Cuts k' N' K') =>
  TimeProfile.Cuts.casesOn t fun (count : Fin K → Fin k → ℕ) (sum_count : ∀ (j : Fin K), ∑ l : Fin k, count j l = N) =>
    TimeProfile.Cuts.casesOn t'
      fun (count_1 : Fin K' → Fin k' → ℕ) (sum_count : ∀ (j : Fin K'), ∑ l : Fin k', count_1 j l = N') =>
      (count ≍ count_1 → P) → P

TimeProfile.LocalGood.name: TimeProfile.LocalGood
TimeProfile.LocalGood.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → 0 < N → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop
TimeProfile.LocalGood.value:
fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (chi gamma rho r T : ℝ) =>
  ∀ (a : ℝ),
    r ≤ a →
      a + rho ≤ T →
        gamma * rho * TimeProfile.logScale N ≤
          ↑{j : Fin K |
                a ≤ TimeProfile.columnTime N j ∧
                  TimeProfile.columnTime N j ≤ a + rho ∧ TimeProfile.GoodColumn (cuts.profile hN j) chi}.card

fun (P : Sort u) {T : ℝ} (t : TimeProfile.TimeMesh T) {T' : ℝ} (t' : TimeProfile.TimeMesh T') =>
  TimeProfile.TimeMesh.casesOn t
    fun (cellCount : ℕ) (cellCount_pos : 0 < cellCount) (boundary : Fin (cellCount + 1) → ℝ)
      (strictMono_boundary : StrictMono boundary) (boundary_zero : boundary 0 = 0)
      (boundary_last : boundary (Fin.last cellCount) = T) =>
    TimeProfile.TimeMesh.casesOn t'
      fun (cellCount_1 : ℕ) (cellCount_pos : 0 < cellCount_1) (boundary_1 : Fin (cellCount_1 + 1) → ℝ)
        (strictMono_boundary : StrictMono boundary_1) (boundary_zero : boundary_1 0 = 0)

TimeProfile.cE.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (M : ℕ) =>

TimeProfile.cE.eq_1.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (M : ℕ),

TimeProfile.cE_terminal.type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k), TimeProfile.cE N p K = 0

TimeProfile.cF.type: {k K : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) → (Fin K → Fin k) → ℕ → ℕ → WithBot ℝ
TimeProfile.cF.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (w v : ℕ) =>
  min (TimeProfile.logExponent N √(TimeProfile.sideMaximum N p x w v TimeProfile.leftProbability))
    (TimeProfile.logExponent N √(TimeProfile.sideMaximum N p x w v TimeProfile.rightProbability))

TimeProfile.cL.type: {k K : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) → (Fin K → Fin k) → ℝ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
TimeProfile.cL.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (b : ℝ) (w M : ℕ) =>
  b - (∑ j ∈ TimeProfile.positions K w M, TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (p j) (x j))) / TimeProfile.logScale N

TimeProfile.cL.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.cL.eq_1
TimeProfile.cL.eq_1.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (b : ℝ) (w M : ℕ),
  TimeProfile.cL N p x b w M =
    b -
      (∑ j ∈ TimeProfile.positions K w M, TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob (p j) (x j))) / TimeProfile.logScale N

TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent.name: TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent
TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (b : ℝ) {w M : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    w ≤ M →
      M ≤ K →
        TimeProfile.LegalPrefix p x M →
          Real.log (TimeProfile.prefixMass N p x M) / TimeProfile.logScale N =
            TimeProfile.cL N p x b w M + (Real.log (TimeProfile.prefixMass N p x w) / TimeProfile.logScale N - b)

TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent._proo.type: ∀ {K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) {w M : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

TimeProfile.cL_exact_mass_exponent._simp.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

TimeProfile.cL_extension_le.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (b : ℝ) {w v M : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    w ≤ v → v ≤ M → M ≤ K → TimeProfile.LegalPrefix p x M → TimeProfile.cL N p x b w M ≤ TimeProfile.cL N p x b w v

TimeProfile.cL_split.name: TimeProfile.cL_split
TimeProfile.cL_split.type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (b : ℝ) {w v M : ℕ},

              TimeProfile.logScale N

TimeProfile.finite_gibbs.name: TimeProfile.finite_gibbs
TimeProfile.finite_gibbs.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (c : Fin k → ℝ),
  (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 ≤ c l) →
    ∀ {theta : ℝ},
      1 ≤ theta →
        (∀ (l : Fin k), 0 < c l → 0 < TimeProfile.prob p l) →
          (∑ l : Fin k, if 0 < c l then c l * Real.log ((∑ i : Fin k, c i) / c l) else 0) ≤
            theta * ∑ l : Fin k, c l * TimeProfile.digitCost (TimeProfile.prob p l) +
              (∑ l : Fin k, c l) * Real.log (TimeProfile.powerSum p theta)

TimeProfile.intervalCount.name: TimeProfile.intervalCount

TimeProfile.intervalCount.value:

    (i : Fin P.cellCount) =>
  {j : Fin K |
      a ≤ TimeProfile.columnTime N j ∧ TimeProfile.columnTime N j ≤ b ∧ P.classify (cuts.profile hN j) = i}.card

TimeProfile.intervalCount.congr_simp.name: TimeProfile.intervalCount.congr_simp

    ∀ (hN : 0 < N) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (a a_1 : ℝ),
      a = a_1 →
        ∀ (b b_1 : ℝ),
          b = b_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : Fin P.cellCount),
              i = i_1 → TimeProfile.intervalCount cuts hN P a b i = TimeProfile.intervalCount cuts_1 hN P a_1 b_1 i_1

TimeProfile.inv_card_le_pileMax.name: TimeProfile.inv_card_le_pileMax
TimeProfile.inv_card_le_pileMax.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 1 / ↑k ≤ TimeProfile.pileMax p

TimeProfile.leftProbability.name: TimeProfile.leftProbability

TimeProfile.leftSideRows.name: TimeProfile.leftSideRows

fun {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (x : Fin K → Fin k) (j : Fin K)

TimeProfile.logExponent.name: TimeProfile.logExponent

TimeProfile.maxCost.name: TimeProfile.maxCost

TimeProfile.maxCost.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.maxCost.eq_1

TimeProfile.maxCost_bounds.name: TimeProfile.maxCost_bounds

TimeProfile.pileMax.name: TimeProfile.pileMax

TimeProfile.positions.name: TimeProfile.positions
TimeProfile.positions.value: fun (K a b : ℕ) => {j : Fin K | a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b}

TimeProfile.positions.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.positions.eq_1
TimeProfile.positions.eq_1.type: ∀ (K a b : ℕ), TimeProfile.positions K a b = {j : Fin K | a ≤ ↑j ∧ ↑j < b}

TimeProfile.powerSum.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.powerSum.eq_1

TimeProfile.powerSum_le_one.name: TimeProfile.powerSum_le_one

TimeProfile.powerSum_pos.name: TimeProfile.powerSum_pos

TimeProfile.prefixRows.name: TimeProfile.prefixRows

TimeProfile.prefixWeight.name: TimeProfile.prefixWeight

TimeProfile.prefixWeight.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.prefixWeight.eq_1

TimeProfile.prefixWeight_pos.name: TimeProfile.prefixWeight_pos

TimeProfile.prefixWeight_pos._simp_1_2.name: TimeProfile.prefixWeight_pos._simp_1_2
TimeProfile.prefixWeight_pos._simp_1_2.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

TimeProfile.prob_le_pileMax.name: TimeProfile.prob_le_pileMax

fun {k : ℕ} (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (t theta : ℝ) =>

TimeProfile.rightSideRows.name: TimeProfile.rightSideRows

TimeProfile.rowCount.value: fun {k N K : ℕ} (rows : Fin N → Fin K → Fin k) (B : (Fin K → Fin k) → Prop) => (TimeProfile.rowsSatisfying rows B).card

TimeProfile.sampleRow.name: TimeProfile.sampleRow

TimeProfile.sampleRow.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.sampleRow.eq_1

TimeProfile.sample_entry_count_pos.name: TimeProfile.sample_entry_count_pos
TimeProfile.sample_entry_count_pos.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (sample : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) (row : Fin N) (j : Fin K),

TimeProfile.sample_row_legal.name: TimeProfile.sample_row_legal

TimeProfile.shannonEntropy.name: TimeProfile.shannonEntropy
TimeProfile.shannonEntropy.value: fun {k : ℕ} (q : Fin k → ℝ) => -∑ l : Fin k, if q l = 0 then 0 else q l * Real.log (q l)

TimeProfile.shannonEntropy.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.shannonEntropy.eq_1

TimeProfile.sideMaximum.name: TimeProfile.sideMaximum
TimeProfile.sideMaximum.type: {k K : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) → (Fin K → Fin k) → ℕ → ℕ → (TimeProfile.Simplex k → Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ
TimeProfile.sideMaximum.value:
fun {k K : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (p : Fin K → TimeProfile.Simplex k) (x : Fin K → Fin k) (w v : ℕ)

TimeProfile.sum_prob.name: TimeProfile.sum_prob
TimeProfile.sum_prob.type: ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), ∑ l : Fin k, TimeProfile.prob p l = 1

TimeProfile.tiltedCost.name: TimeProfile.tiltedCost

TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy.name: TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy

TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.name: TimeProfile.tiltedWeight
TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.type: {k : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ → Fin k → ℝ
TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.value:
fun {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (theta : ℝ) (l : Fin k) =>

TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.eq_1.name: TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.eq_1
TimeProfile.tiltedWeight.eq_1.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) (theta : ℝ) (l : Fin k),
  TimeProfile.tiltedWeight p theta l = TimeProfile.prob p l ^ theta / TimeProfile.powerSum p theta

    (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K)

∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ {I : Finset (Fin K)} (v : RiffleLowerV2.WordOn k I) (jL jR : ↥I),
      jL ≠ jR →
        ∀ {chi : ℝ},
          0 ≤ chi →
            chi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑jL) (v jL)) / ↑N →
              chi ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑jR) (v jR)) / ↑N →
                (∀ (j : ↥I), j ≠ jL → j ≠ jR → 1 / ↑k ≤ ↑(cuts.count (↑j) (v j)) / ↑N) →
                  chi ^ 2 * ↑k ^ (-↑I.card) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.massOn cuts v

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.grid_integral_assembly
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (time : Fin K → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (g : Fin K → ℝ) {L T rho M A B a b : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ T →
      0 < rho →
        0 ≤ M →
          0 ≤ A →
            0 ≤ B →
              (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ F t ∧ F t ≤ M) →
                (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 ≤ g j) →
                  0 ≤ a →
                    a ≤ b →
                      b ≤ T →
                        (∀ (q : ℕ),
                            a ≤ ↑q * rho →
                              (↑q + 1) * rho ≤ b →
                                ∫ (t : ℝ) in ↑q * rho..(↑q + 1) * rho, F t ≤
                                  (∑
                                          j ∈
                                            RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow✝ time (↑q * rho)
                                              ((↑q + 1) * rho),
                                          g j) /
                                        L +
                                      A * rho +
                                    B / L) →
                          ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, F t ≤
                            (∑ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow✝ time a b, g j) / L + A * T +
                                2 * M * rho +
                              B * (↑⌊T / rho⌋₊ + 1) / L

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.interval_integral_le_constant
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type:
∀ {F : ℝ → ℝ} {a b M : ℝ},
  a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable F MeasureTheory.volume a b → (∀ (t : ℝ), F t ≤ M) → ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, F t ≤ M * (b - a)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.representative_grid_block
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {T rho phi M omega a : ℝ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
  (mu : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (f : TimeProfile.Simplex k → ℝ),
  0 < rho →
    0 ≤ phi →
      0 ≤ M →
        0 ≤ omega →
          (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ M) →
            (∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), |f p - f (P.rep (P.classify p))| ≤ omega) →
              TimeProfile.AlmostLike cuts ⋯ mu P T rho phi →
                0 ≤ a →
                  (∃ (z : ℤ), a = rho * ↑z) →
                    a + rho ≤ T →
                      ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..a + rho, ∫ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k), f p ∂↑(mu t) ≤
                        (∑
                                j ∈
                                  RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.timePositions N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T) a
                                    (a + rho),
                                f (P.rep (P.classify (cuts.profile ⋯ j)))) /
                              TimeProfile.logScale N +
                            omega * rho +
                          M * (1 / TimeProfile.logScale N + ↑P.cellCount * (phi * rho + 2 / TimeProfile.logScale N))

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type: {K : ℕ} → (Fin K → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → Finset (Fin K)
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.value: fun {K : ℕ} (time : Fin K → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) => {j : Fin K | a < time j ∧ time j ≤ b}

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow_nonneg
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (time g : Fin K → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 ≤ g j) → ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow✝ time a b, g j

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.GridQuadrature.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sum_grid_samples_le
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.C.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (time g : Fin K → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin K), 0 ≤ g j) →
    ∀ {rho a b : ℝ},
      0 < rho →
        ∀ {lo hi : ℕ},
          a ≤ ↑lo * rho →
            ↑hi * rho ≤ b →
              ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ico lo hi,
                  ∑ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow✝ time (↑q * rho) ((↑q + 1) * rho), g j ≤
                ∑ j ∈ RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Compat.sampleWindow✝ time a b, g j

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.E.type: ∀ (x : ℝ), max 0 (min 1 x) = max 0 x - max 0 (x - 1)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.common_F_error
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {T e : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (cuts : RiffleLowerV2.Targets.HorizonCuts k N T) (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k),
  0 ≤ e →
    RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileIntervalErrors T cuts ⋯ μ e →
      ∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)),
        ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4,
          |RiffleLowerV2.F cuts ⋯ a su.1 su.2 -
                RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T)) a su.1 su.2| ≤
            13 / 2 * e

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.common_lambda_error
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {T e : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N),
      0 ≤ T →
        ∀ (cuts : RiffleLowerV2.Targets.HorizonCuts k N T) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
          (μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k),
          RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
            0 ≤ e →
              RiffleLowerV2.Targets.ProfileIntervalErrors T cuts ⋯ μ e →
                |RiffleLowerV2.lambda1 cuts ⋯ -
                      RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N (TimeProfile.horizonDepth N T))| ≤
                  13 / 2 * e

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.empiricalF_bound
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) {T : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K ≤ T →
          ∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle (RiffleLowerV2.horizon N K),
            ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, |RiffleLowerV2.F cuts ⋯ a su.1 su.2| ≤ 4 + 20 * (Real.log ↑k * T)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.macroF_bound
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {T H : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        0 ≤ H →
          H ≤ T →
            RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
              ∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle H,
                ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4, |RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ H a su.1 su.2| ≤ 4 + 20 * (Real.log ↑k * T)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.macroF_clip_le
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {T S : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        0 ≤ S →
          S ≤ T →
            RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
              ∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle T,
                ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc 3 4,
                  RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ T a su.1 su.2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ S a (min su.1 S) (min su.2 S)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.macroF_horizon_eq
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {T S : ℝ},
  0 ≤ T →
    0 ≤ S →
      S ≤ T →
        RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
          ∀ su ∈ RiffleLowerV2.triangle S,
            ∀ (a : ℝ),
              RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ S a su.1 su.2 =
                RiffleLowerV2.macroF μ T a su.1 su.2 + 2 * TimeProfile.integratedPsi μ 2 S T

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.macroLambda_horizon
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {μ : TimeProfile.TimeLaw k} {P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k} {T S : ℝ},
      0 ≤ T →
        0 ≤ S →
          S ≤ T →
            RiffleLowerV2.ScalarIntegrable μ P T →
              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ S - RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ T ∧
                RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ S - RiffleLowerV2.macroLambda1 μ T ≤ 8 * Real.log ↑k * (T - S)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.scalar_bounds
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {T a b M : ℝ},
  0 ≤ T →
    IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume 0 T →
      (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ f t ∧ f t ≤ M) →
        0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ T → 0 ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, f t ∧ ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, f t ≤ M * (b - a)

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.scalar_clip_le
_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {T S a b : ℝ},

        0 ≤ S → S ≤ T → 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ T → ∫ (t : ℝ) in min a S..min b S, f t ≤ ∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, f t

_private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.M.name: _private.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.Margin.0.RiffleLowerV2.ProfileTransfer.scalar_mono

    2 ≤ k →
      ∀ (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {a : ℝ},
        a ∈ Set.Icc 2 4 →
          0 ≤ TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy p a ∧
            TimeProfile.tiltedEntropy p a ≤ TimeProfile.tiltedCost p a ∧
              TimeProfile.tiltedCost p a ≤ Real.log ↑k ∧
